Distant sea and castle hints. Each bird fully separable. Their song evokes enchanting serenity without visual musical notes. No people, no fourth bird.
Enchanting otherworldly peace
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: the Adar Rhiannon ; "birds of Rhiannon", are specifically three magical birds, whose song can "wake the dead and lull the living to sleep". They also have a non-rational effect on space as they can be remote but seem very near.

statement.id: Adar Rhiannon (burung-burung Rhiannon), tiga burung ajaib Mabinogi; membangunkan orang mati, menidurkan yang hidup; jauh tetapi tampak dekat; Britania.
statement.en: Adar Rhiannon (birds of Rhiannon), three magical birds of the Mabinogi; wake the dead, lull the living; remote yet near; Britain.

basis_claims.quote: In Harlech you will be feasting seven years, the birds of Rhiannon singing unto you the while.

statement.id: Terjemahan Lady Guest: tujuh tahun berpesta di Harlech diiringi nyanyian burung Rhiannon.
statement.en: Lady Guest translation: seven years feasting at Harlech with the birds of Rhiannon singing.

basis_claims.quote: and the birds seemed to them to be at a great distance from them over the sea, yet they appeared as distinct as if they were close by

statement.id: Burung tampak jauh di atas laut tetapi jelas seolah dekat.
statement.en: The birds seemed far over the sea yet distinct as if close.

aitvaras.depicted_variant: Indoor black rooster with meteor tail
visual_requirements: A single BLACK rooster with anatomically normal rooster head, scarlet comb, feathered body and two bird feet, but a magnificent long FIERY METEOR tail visibly trailing embers. Inside rustic Lithuanian wooden grain store, a small pile of gold and wheat beneath. Flaming tail rather than fire breathing or a burning human.
Mischievous dangerous household fortune
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: An Aitvaras looks like a white or black rooster with a fiery tail like a meteor. An Aitvaras is said to hatch from an egg of a 9- to 15-year-old rooster. If an Aitvaras dies, it becomes a spark.

statement.id: Aitvaras tampak seperti ayam jantan putih atau hitam dengan ekor menyala seperti meteor; konon ia menetas dari telur ayam jantan berumur 9 hingga 15 tahun, dan jika mati ia menjadi percikan api.
statement.en: An aitvaras looks like a white or black rooster with a meteor-like fiery tail; it is said to hatch from the egg of a 9- to 15-year-old rooster, and when it dies it becomes a spark.

basis_claims.quote: In many cases, this Lithuanian creature is described as a bird with the appearance of a dragon outdoors. An Aitvaras will lodge itself in a house and most often refuse to leave. It brings both good and bad luck to the inhabitants of the house, providing its adopted home with stolen gold and grain, often getting the household into trouble.

statement.id: Makhluk Lituania ini sering digambarkan sebagai burung yang di luar rumah berpenampilan naga; ia menetap di rumah dan biasanya menolak pergi, membawa keberuntungan dan kesialan bagi penghuninya dengan memasok emas dan gandum curian yang sering menyusahkan keluarga itu.
statement.en: This Lithuanian creature is often described as a bird with a dragon's appearance outdoors; it lodges in a house, usually refuses to leave, and brings both good and bad luck, supplying stolen gold and grain that often get the household into trouble.

basis_claims.quote: Der Aitvaras bewegt sich fliegend und er ist zumeist feurig, kann aber sein Aussehen ändern. Er bringt Getreide und anderen Reichtum, den er aber mitunter dem Nachbarn entwendet. Wird er verzürnt, brennt er das Haus nieder.

statement.id: Aitvaras bergerak dengan terbang dan umumnya berapi, tetapi dapat mengubah penampilannya; ia membawa gandum dan kekayaan lain yang kadang dicuri dari tetangga, dan jika dibuat marah ia membakar rumah.
statement.en: The aitvaras moves by flying and is mostly fiery but can change its appearance; it brings grain and other wealth, sometimes stolen from neighbours, and if angered burns the house down.

visual_requirements: Finnish supernatural moose
Natural moose head, palmate antlers and four legs
Swift strong elusive presence

basis_claims.quote: Hiiden hirvi (lit. 'Hiisi's moose') is a mythical moose in Finnish mythology which must be hunted by skiing. This myth describes the creation of skis and the origin of the moose.

statement.id: Hiiden hirvi ("rusa besar milik Hiisi") adalah rusa besar (moose) mitos dalam mitologi Finlandia yang harus diburu dengan bermain ski; mitos ini menceritakan penciptaan ski dan asal-usul rusa besar.
statement.en: Hiiden hirvi ("Hiisi's moose") is a mythical moose of Finnish mythology that must be hunted on skis; the myth describes the creation of skis and the origin of the moose.

basis_claims.quote: The protagonist arrives at a location where women laugh, children cry and dogs bark. They tell the protagonist this is because Hiiden hirvi just passed through the area and ruined the food. The protagonist starts their chase of the moose but one of the skis break and the moose escapes.

statement.id: Dalam versi Karelia Putih dan Olonets, sang tokoh tiba di tempat perempuan tertawa, anak-anak menangis, dan anjing menggonggong, karena Hiiden hirvi baru saja lewat dan merusak makanan; ia mulai memburu rusa itu, tetapi salah satu skinya patah dan rusa itu lolos.
statement.en: In White Karelian and Olonets versions the hero reaches a place where women laugh, children cry and dogs bark, because Hiiden hirvi has just passed through and spoiled the food; the hero begins the chase, but one ski breaks and the moose escapes.

basis_claims.quote: Hiie põder (ka hiie hirv; soome keeles hiiden hirvi) on üleloomulik loom soome eeposes "Kalevala". Seda looma on kirjeldatud kui raskesti püütavat, kiiret ja tugevat.

statement.id: Hiie põder (juga hiie hirv; bahasa Finlandia hiiden hirvi) adalah hewan gaib dalam epos Finlandia Kalevala, yang digambarkan sulit ditangkap, cepat, dan kuat.
statement.en: Hiie põder (also hiie hirv; Finnish hiiden hirvi) is a supernatural animal of the Finnish epic Kalevala, described as hard to catch, swift and strong.

visual_requirements: Black pony variant
Natural horse body
Wicked unpredictable nocturnal presence

basis_claims.quote: (Irish for spirit/ghost; plural púcaí), puca (Old English for goblin), also pwca, pooka, pookah, phouka, and puck, is a creature of Celtic, English, and Channel Islands folklore. Considered to be bringers both of good and bad fortune, they could help or hinder rural and marine communities.

statement.id: Púca (Irlandia, Irish; púcaí), juga pwca, pooka, phouka, puck, makhluk cerita rakyat Kelt (Celtic), Inggris (English), Kepulauan Channel (Channel Islands); pembawa untung dan sial; di Irlandia dan Britania.
statement.en: The púca (Irish; púcaí), also pwca, pooka, phouka, puck, is a creature of Celtic, English and Channel Islands folklore, bringing good and bad fortune.

basis_claims.quote: Púcaí can have dark or white fur or hair. The creatures were said to be shape-changers that could take the appearance of horses, goats, cats, dogs, and hares. They may also take a human disguise, which includes various animal features, such as animal ears or a tail.

statement.id: Púcaí berbulu gelap atau putih, berubah menjadi kuda, kambing, kucing, anjing, kelinci, atau menyamar manusia bertelinga atau berekor hewan.
statement.en: Púcaí have dark or white fur and shift into horses, goats, cats, dogs, hares, or humans with animal ears or tails.

basis_claims.quote: were wicked-minded, black-looking, bad things ... that would come in the form of wild colts, with chains hanging about them", and that did much to harm unwary travellers.

statement.id: Menurut Thomas Keightley, anak dekat Killarney bercerita púca jahat dan hitam, muncul sebagai anak kuda liar berantai, mencelakai pelancong.
statement.en: Per Thomas Keightley, a boy near Killarney said pookas were wicked black things coming as wild colts with chains, harming travellers.

basis_claims.quote: Die bevorzugte Erscheinungsform ist die eines schwarzen Ponys.

statement.id: Wujud kesukaannya kuda poni hitam (schwarzen Ponys).
statement.en: Its preferred form is a black pony (schwarzen Ponys).

visual_requirements: Hideous hairy dwarfish household monster
Unmistakably grotesque anatomy rather than human portrait
Malicious clammy house-spirit presence

basis_claims.quote: A boggart is a supernatural being from English folklore. The dialectologist Elizabeth Wright described the boggart as "a generic name for an apparition"; folklorist Simon Young defines it as "any ambivalent or evil solitary supernatural spirit."

statement.id: Boggart makhluk gaib cerita rakyat Inggris (English folklore); Elizabeth Wright: nama umum penampakan; Simon Young: roh penyendiri ambivalen atau jahat; di Inggris Raya.
statement.en: The boggart is a supernatural being of English folklore; Elizabeth Wright: a generic name for an apparition; Simon Young: any ambivalent or evil solitary spirit.

basis_claims.quote: Boggarts are found indoors and outdoors, as a household spirit, or a malevolent spirit defined by local geography, a genius loci inhabiting topographical features. The 1867 book Lancashire Folklore by Harland and Wilkinson makes a distinction between "house boggarts" and other types.

statement.id: Boggart di dalam dan luar rumah, roh rumah atau genius loci; Lancashire Folklore (1867) Harland dan Wilkinson membedakan house boggarts.
statement.en: Boggarts live indoors and outdoors, as household spirits or a genius loci; Lancashire Folklore (1867) by Harland and Wilkinson distinguishes house boggarts.

basis_claims.quote: Typical descriptions show boggarts to be malevolent. It is said that the boggart crawls into people's beds at night and puts a clammy hand on their faces. Sometimes he strips the bedsheets off them. The household boggart may follow a family wherever they flee.

statement.id: Boggart jahat, merangkak ke ranjang, menaruh tangan lembap di wajah, menarik seprai, mengikuti keluarga yang pindah.
statement.en: Boggarts are malevolent, creeping into beds, laying a clammy hand on faces, stripping sheets, following families who flee.

basis_claims.quote: Les boggarts (ou bwcas, bogan, bogle, boggle) sont des créatures du folklore britannique. Ils y sont décrits comme des nains hideux, velus et malveillants.

statement.id: Boggart (bwcas, bogan, bogle) makhluk folklore Britania (britannique), kerdil buruk rupa, berbulu, jahat.
statement.en: Boggarts (bwcas, bogan, bogle) are creatures of British (britannique) folklore, ugly, hairy, spiteful dwarfs.

visual_requirements: Huge bird with iron beak
Copper claws
Buyan and Alatyr context
Protective tempest grandeur

basis_claims.quote: Gagana is a miraculous bird with an iron beak and copper claws featured in Russian folklore. She is said to live on the Buyan Island. The bird is often mentioned in incantations. It is also said this bird guards the Alatyr, alongside Garafena the snake.

statement.id: Gagana adalah burung ajaib berparuh besi dan bercakar tembaga dalam cerita rakyat Rusia; ia tinggal di Pulau Buyan, sering disebut dalam mantra, dan menjaga Alatyr bersama ular Garafena.
statement.en: Gagana is a miraculous bird with an iron beak and copper claws in Russian folklore; she lives on Buyan Island, is often named in incantations, and guards the Alatyr with Garafena the snake.

basis_claims.quote: William Ralston Shedden-Ralston, citing Alexander Afanasyev's notes on Slavic folklore, writes that on the mythical island of Buyan there lives "The Tempest Bird", "the oldest and largest of all the birds", said to possess "an iron beak" and "copper claws".

statement.id: William Ralston Shedden-Ralston, mengutip catatan Alexander Afanasyev, menulis bahwa di pulau mitis Buyan hidup "Burung Badai", burung tertua dan terbesar, berparuh besi dan bercakar tembaga.
statement.en: William Ralston Shedden-Ralston, citing Alexander Afanasyev's notes, writes that on the mythical island of Buyan lives "The Tempest Bird", the oldest and largest of birds, with an iron beak and copper claws.

gamayun.depicted_variant: Late nineteenth-century artistic woman-headed black-bird Gamayun, not unsupported claim of traditional oral folklore
visual_requirements: Woman head on black bird body
Avian wings legs talons and tail
Prophetic singing
Sorrowful wisdom

basis_claims.quote: is a prophetic bird in Russian folklore. It is a symbol of wisdom and knowledge and lives on an island in the mythical east, close to paradise.

statement.id: Gamayun adalah burung bernubuat dalam cerita rakyat Rusia, lambang kebijaksanaan dan pengetahuan, yang tinggal di pulau di timur yang mitis, dekat surga.
statement.en: Gamayun is a prophetic bird in Russian folklore, a symbol of wisdom and knowledge living on an island in the mythical east, close to paradise.

basis_claims.quote: The Gamayun is normally depicted as a large black bird with a woman's head. She is said to spread divine messages and prophecies, which she imparts through her songs

statement.id: Gamayun biasanya digambarkan sebagai burung hitam besar berkepala perempuan yang menyebarkan pesan ilahi dan ramalan melalui nyanyiannya.
statement.en: Gamayun is usually depicted as a large black bird with a woman's head, spreading divine messages and prophecies through her songs.

basis_claims.quote: During the Silver Age of Russian Poetry, it often appeared as the source of tragic prophecies, such as in Alexander Blok's Gamayun, the Prophetic Bird.

statement.id: Pada Zaman Perak puisi Rusia, Gamayun sering tampil sebagai sumber nubuat tragis, misalnya dalam sajak Alexander Blok "Gamayun, the Prophetic Bird".
statement.en: During the Silver Age of Russian poetry it often appeared as the source of tragic prophecies, as in Alexander Blok's "Gamayun, the Prophetic Bird".

basis_claims.quote: Die Beliebtheit des Gamajun stieg in der russischen Kultur Ende des 19. und Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts an, als Wiktor Wasnezow das Gemälde „Gamajun, der prophetische Vogel“ malte.

statement.id: Popularitas Gamayun dalam budaya Rusia meningkat pada akhir abad ke-19 dan awal abad ke-20, ketika Wiktor Wasnezow melukis "Gamajun, der prophetische Vogel".
statement.en: Gamayun's popularity in Russian culture rose in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, when Wiktor Wasnezow painted "Gamajun, the Prophetic Bird".

basis_claims.quote: Несмотря на распространённое заблуждение, сведений о существовании птицы гамаюн в русском традиционном фольклоре нет

statement.id: Meskipun ada anggapan keliru yang tersebar luas, tidak ada data tentang keberadaan burung gamayun dalam folklor tradisional Rusia.
statement.en: Despite a widespread misconception, there is no evidence of the gamayun bird in traditional Russian folklore.

herensuge.depicted_variant: Documented single-headed giant serpent variant of Basque Herensuge
visual_requirements: Giant serpent form
One head in documented variant
Aralar cave context
Ravenous devilish menace

basis_claims.quote: Herensuge is the name for a mythical dragon in the Basque language. In Basque mythology, dragons appear sparingly, sometimes with seven heads. Herensuge often also appear in the form of a serpent.

statement.id: Herensuge adalah nama naga mitis dalam bahasa Basque; dalam mitologi Basque naga jarang muncul, kadang berkepala tujuh, dan Herensuge sering juga berwujud ular.
statement.en: Herensuge is the Basque name for a mythical dragon; dragons appear rarely in Basque mythology, sometimes with seven heads, and Herensuge often also takes the form of a serpent.

basis_claims.quote: Ses noms varient, mais la permanence du suffixe « suge » (couleuvre, serpent) suffit à justifier sa nature. C'est en effet un serpent.

statement.id: Namanya beragam, tetapi akhiran suge ("ular") yang selalu ada menunjukkan sifatnya sebagai ular.
statement.en: Its names vary, but the constant suffix suge ('snake') shows its serpent nature.

visual_requirements: Brazilian river mermaid with fish tail
Dark skin, black hair and green eyes
Amazonian freshwater
Enchanting dangerous singing spirit

basis_claims.quote: is a figure from Brazilian mythology based on Tupi and Guaraní mythology.

statement.id: Iara adalah tokoh mitologi Brasil yang berakar pada mitologi Tupi dan Guaraní.
statement.en: Iara is a figure of Brazilian mythology based on Tupi and Guaraní mythology.

basis_claims.quote: The Iara may have developed from the lore of the carnivorous fish-man Ipupiara ... Conflation with the European myth of the siren, or a beautiful mermaid probably is part of the Iara myth as the seductress of the Amazon River.

statement.id: Iara mungkin berkembang dari kisah Ipupiara, manusia ikan pemakan daging, lalu bercampur dengan mitos siren atau putri duyung Eropa sebagai penggoda Sungai Amazon.
statement.en: Iara may have grown from the lore of the carnivorous fish-man Ipupiara, later blended with the European siren or mermaid as the seductress of the Amazon.

basis_claims.quote: Some commentators believe the original version of Iara must have been dark-skinned and black-haired, black-eyed, like the indigenous populations. However the Iara in the 19th century were described as blonde and blue-eyed or green-eyed, or even green haired.

statement.id: Sebagian penulis meyakini Iara versi asli berkulit gelap, berambut dan bermata hitam seperti penduduk asli, tetapi pada abad ke-19 ia digambarkan pirang dengan mata biru atau hijau, bahkan berambut hijau.
statement.en: Some believe the original Iara was dark-skinned with black hair and eyes like the indigenous people, but in the 19th century she was described as blonde with blue or green eyes, or even green hair.

basis_claims.quote: ist in der brasilianischen Mythologie eine Sirene.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Brasil, Iara adalah sejenis siren.
statement.en: In Brazilian mythology Iara is a siren.

basis_claims.quote: Sie hat grüne Augen und lebt in den Flüssen oder Seen, wo sie nachts, vor allem bei Mondschein, unwiderstehliche Lieder singt.

statement.id: Ia bermata hijau dan tinggal di sungai atau danau, tempat ia menyanyikan lagu yang tak tertahankan pada malam hari, terutama saat bulan bersinar.
statement.en: She has green eyes and lives in rivers or lakes, where at night, especially by moonlight, she sings irresistible songs.

basis_claims.quote: Man sagt, sie habe eine so schöne und rührende Stimme, dass sie die Männer damit verzaubert, die ihr in ihr Reich am Grunde des Wassers folgen.

statement.id: Suaranya begitu indah dan menyentuh sehingga memikat para lelaki, yang lalu mengikutinya ke kerajaannya di dasar air.
statement.en: Her voice is so beautiful and moving that it enchants men, who follow her to her realm at the bottom of the water.

incubus.depicted_variant: Bat form entering at night, not handsome human seducer
visual_requirements: Documented bat nocturnal-entry variant
Full bat anatomy
Sinister nightmare-spirit aura

basis_claims.quote: An incubus ... incubi) is a male demon who is described in various folklore as appearing in the dreams of female humans in order to seduce them.

statement.id: Incubus (jamak: incubi) adalah iblis lelaki yang dalam berbagai cerita rakyat muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayu mereka.
statement.en: An incubus (plural incubi) is a male demon said in various folklore to appear in women's dreams to seduce them.

basis_claims.quote: Historically, folkloric belief in incubi was motivated by distressing nighttime phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

statement.id: Kepercayaan pada incubi didorong gejala malam yang meresahkan, terutama mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur.
statement.en: Belief in incubi was driven by distressing night phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

basis_claims.quote: The Late Latin word incubus ("a nightmare induced by a demon") is derived from Latin incubō ("nightmare, what lies down on one whilst one sleeps") and further from incubāre ("to lie upon, to hatch").

statement.id: Kata Latin Akhir incubus, "mimpi buruk yang ditimbulkan iblis", berasal dari incubō, "yang menindih orang tidur", dan incubāre, "berbaring di atas".
statement.en: The Late Latin incubus, 'a demon-induced nightmare', comes from incubō, 'what lies on one while asleep', and incubāre, 'to lie upon'.

basis_claims.quote: どちらも、自分と性交したくてたまらなくさせるために、襲われる人の理想の異性像で、服を着ず下半身は裸で現れる。そのため、その誘惑を拒否することは非常に困難だった。人の形態をとるだけでなく、標的となった人間の寝室には蝙蝠に化けて侵入するともされている。

statement.id: Incubus dan succubus muncul sebagai sosok lawan jenis idaman korbannya sehingga godaannya sangat sulit ditolak, dan selain berwujud manusia mereka konon menyusup ke kamar korban dalam wujud kelelawar.
statement.en: Incubi and succubi appear as their victim's ideal partner, so their temptation is very hard to refuse, and besides human form they are said to slip into the victim's bedroom as bats.

visual_requirements: Hay and old household-tool constructed body
Treasure-bearing Estonian familiar
Flight and sparks
Uncanny tirelessly working aura

basis_claims.quote: also pisuhänd, puuk, tulihänd, vedaja, is a magical creature in Estonian mythology, a treasure-bearer. In Votic, a similar creature is called lemmüz. In Finnish mythology, there is a treasure guardian called Kratti or Aarni.

statement.id: Kratt, juga pisuhänd, puuk, tulihänd, vedaja, adalah makhluk ajaib pembawa harta dalam mitologi Estonia; dalam mitologi Finlandia ada penjaga harta bernama Kratti atau Aarni.
statement.en: The kratt, also pisuhänd, puuk, tulihänd, vedaja, is a magical treasure-bearer of Estonian mythology; Finnish mythology has a treasure guardian called Kratti or Aarni.

basis_claims.quote: A kratt was a creature formed from hay or of old household implements by its master, who then had to give the Devil three drops of blood to bring life to the kratt.

statement.id: Kratt dibuat tuannya dari jerami atau perkakas rumah tangga lama, lalu tuannya harus memberi Iblis tiga tetes darah untuk menghidupkannya.
statement.en: A kratt was formed by its master from hay or old household tools, who then had to give the Devil three drops of blood to bring it to life.

basis_claims.quote: The kratt was notable for doing everything the master ordered it to and was mostly used for stealing and bringing various goods for the kratt's owner. It was said to be able to fly around. An interesting aspect of the kratt is that it was necessary for it to constantly keep working, otherwise it would turn dangerous to its owner.

statement.id: Kratt melakukan semua perintah tuannya, terutama mencuri dan membawa barang; ia dapat terbang; ia harus terus bekerja, bila tidak menjadi berbahaya bagi pemiliknya.
statement.en: The kratt did all its master ordered, mostly stealing and fetching goods; it could fly; it had to keep working or it would turn dangerous to its owner.

basis_claims.quote: Impossible tasks took so long to complete that it caused the kratt, which was made of hay, to catch fire and burn to pieces, thus solving the issue of how to get rid of the problematic creature.

statement.id: Tugas mustahil seperti membuat tangga dari roti begitu lama sehingga kratt dari jerami itu terbakar habis; dalam astronomi rakyat bola api dianggap kratt yang diberi tugas mustahil.
statement.en: Impossible tasks such as a ladder of bread took so long that the hay kratt caught fire and burned to pieces; in folk astronomy a fireball was a kratt given an impossible job.

basis_claims.quote: on eesti folklooris nõiduslik olend, kes tule- või sädemejoana ringi lennates mitmesugust vara (vilja, rõivaid, raha jne) kokku veab.

statement.id: Kratt adalah makhluk sihir dalam cerita rakyat Estonia yang terbang sebagai pancaran api atau percikan sambil mengangkut berbagai harta (gandum, pakaian, uang, dan lain-lain).
statement.en: The kratt is a magical being of Estonian folklore that flies about as a streak of fire or sparks carrying goods (grain, clothes, money and so on).

la-guita-xica.depicted_variant: Patum de Berga mule-dragon green-body variant
visual_requirements: Green horse/mule-bodied long-necked dragon
Black face and fangs
Protective dangerous Catalan festival spirit

basis_claims.quote: is a dragon that appears amongst the legends of Catalonia beginning in 1890.

statement.id: La Guita Xica adalah naga yang muncul dalam legenda Katalonia sejak 1890.
statement.en: La Guita Xica is a dragon that appears in the legends of Catalonia from 1890.

basis_claims.quote: The name La Mulassa comes from an older term, mulassas, meaning 'monstrous mules,' which was used in Catalan mythology to refer to mule-dragon hybrids. La Guita Xica was originally considered a demon, but has become a protective spirit over the past century.

statement.id: Nama La Mulassa berasal dari istilah mulassas, "bagal raksasa", untuk hibrida bagal-naga dalam mitologi Katalan; La Guita Xica awalnya dianggap iblis tetapi dalam seabad terakhir menjadi roh pelindung.
statement.en: The name La Mulassa comes from mulassas, 'monstrous mules', used in Catalan mythology for mule-dragon hybrids; La Guita Xica was first considered a demon but over the last century became a protective spirit.

basis_claims.quote: Originally La Guita Xica was considered a threatening force but it is now considered a protective dragon that defends the people of Catalonia and the Eucharist's festivals of Patum de Berga.  During the festivals, large representations of the dragon are built in the town squares, spitting fireworks.

statement.id: Kini ia dianggap naga pelindung rakyat Katalonia dan pesta Ekaristi Patum de Berga, tempat figur naga besar dibuat di alun-alun dan menyemburkan kembang api.
statement.en: It is now seen as a protective dragon of the Catalan people and of the Eucharistic festival of the Patum de Berga, where large dragon figures are built in the squares and spit fireworks.

basis_claims.quote: It has a green body similar to that of an equine, and a very long neck and fangs.

statement.id: Tubuhnya hijau seperti kuda, dengan leher sangat panjang dan taring.
statement.en: It has a green horse-like body, a very long neck and fangs.

basis_claims.quote: 祭りのパレードに登場するギータの人形は、巨大な緑色の身体、非常に長い首と真っ黒な顔、大きな牙とずる賢そうな輝く目を持つ、蛇に似た形状のドラゴンとして表現される。しかしギータが参加する人々を悪魔・悪霊から守っているという。

statement.id: Figur Guita dalam pawai Patum berupa naga mirip ular bertubuh hijau raksasa, berleher sangat panjang, berwajah hitam, bertaring besar, dan bermata licik berkilau, tetapi ia dikatakan melindungi peserta dari iblis dan roh jahat.
statement.en: The Guita figure in the Patum parade is a snake-like dragon with a huge green body, very long neck, black face, big fangs and sly shining eyes, yet it is said to protect the participants from devils and evil spirits.

lamia-basque-mythology.depicted_variant: River lamia with clearly visible ducklike webbed feet
visual_requirements: Basque female lamia with duck-webbed feet
Golden comb
Nocturnal spring or stream
Enigmatic generous nature-spirit aura

basis_claims.quote: The lamia (or lamina) (plural: lamiak or laminak) is a siren or nereid-like creature in Basque mythology. Lamiak are typically portrayed as living in and around rivers.

statement.id: Lamia atau lamina (jamak lamiak atau laminak) adalah makhluk mirip siren atau nereid dalam mitologi Basque yang biasanya tinggal di dalam dan di sekitar sungai.
statement.en: The lamia or lamina (plural lamiak or laminak) is a siren- or nereid-like creature of Basque mythology, usually living in and around rivers.

basis_claims.quote: Mythology in coastal areas includes itsaslamiak, a variety of lamiak who live in the sea and have fish-like tails, similar to a mermaid.

statement.id: Di daerah pesisir dikenal itsaslamiak, lamia yang tinggal di laut dan berekor ikan seperti putri duyung.
statement.en: Coastal areas know the itsaslamiak, sea-dwelling lamiak with fish tails like mermaids.

basis_claims.quote: Le plus souvent, les laminak sont dépeints soit comme des lutins mâles, des nains (ipotxak ou nanoak), soit comme des femmes de taille normale dont le bas du corps est pourvu de caractéristiques animales (pieds palmés, pattes de poules, sabots de chèvre ou queue de poisson).

statement.id: Laminak paling sering digambarkan sebagai kurcaci laki-laki atau perempuan bertubuh biasa yang bagian bawahnya berciri hewan: kaki berselaput, kaki ayam, kuku kambing, atau ekor ikan.
statement.en: Laminak are most often shown either as male goblins or dwarfs or as normal-sized women whose lower body has animal features: webbed feet, hen's feet, goat hooves or a fish tail.

basis_claims.quote: Créatures essentiellement nocturnes, les laminak vivent sous terre, dans des grottes ou auprès des sources et des ruisseaux.

statement.id: Laminak terutama makhluk malam yang tinggal di bawah tanah, di gua, atau dekat mata air dan sungai kecil.
statement.en: Laminak are mainly nocturnal and live underground, in caves or by springs and streams.

basis_claims.quote: Los seres humanos las ven peinándose el cabello con un peine de oro o, con menos frecuencia, tendiendo y secando su hermoso paño.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, manusia melihat mereka menyisir rambut dengan sisir emas atau, lebih jarang, menjemur kain mereka yang indah.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, people see them combing their hair with a golden comb or, less often, spreading out their beautiful cloth to dry.

basis_claims.quote: En muchas narraciones se la describe como una mujer hermosa que presenta algún rasgo no humano, como patas de gallina, de cabra, de pato o cola de pez, según la zona y la tradición oral concreta.

statement.id: Dalam banyak cerita ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik dengan satu ciri bukan manusia, seperti kaki ayam, kambing, atau bebek, atau ekor ikan, tergantung daerahnya.
statement.en: In many tales she is a beautiful woman with some non-human feature, such as hen's, goat's or duck's feet or a fish tail, depending on the area.

liderc.depicted_variant: Csodacsirke miracle chicken hatched from black hen's egg
visual_requirements: Miracle chicken variant
Black chicken anatomy
Gold-hoarding malevolent familiar

basis_claims.quote: is a unique supernatural being of Hungarian folklore. It has three known varieties, which often borrow traits from one another. The first, more traditional form of the lidérc is as a miracle chicken, csodacsirke in Hungarian, which hatches from the first egg of a black hen kept warm under the arm of a human.

statement.id: Lidérc adalah makhluk gaib khas cerita rakyat Hungaria dengan tiga ragam yang sering saling meminjam ciri; bentuk pertama yang lebih tradisional adalah anak ayam ajaib (csodacsirke) yang menetas dari telur pertama ayam hitam yang dihangatkan di bawah ketiak manusia.
statement.en: The lidérc is a unique supernatural being of Hungarian folklore with three varieties that often borrow traits from one another; the first, more traditional form is a miracle chicken (csodacsirke) hatched from a black hen's first egg kept warm under a person's arm.

basis_claims.quote: The lidérc attaches itself to people to become their lover. ... it fondles her, sits on her body, and sometimes sucks her blood, making her weak and sick after a time. From this source comes a Hungarian word for nightmare -- lidércnyomás, which literally means "lidérc pressure", from the pressure on the body while the being sits on it.

statement.id: Lidérc melekat pada manusia untuk menjadi kekasihnya; ia menggerayangi korbannya, duduk di tubuhnya, kadang mengisap darahnya hingga perempuan itu lemah dan sakit; dari sinilah kata Hungaria untuk mimpi buruk, lidércnyomás, "tekanan lidérc".
statement.en: The lidérc attaches itself to people as their lover; fondling its victim, sitting on her body and sometimes sucking her blood until she grows weak and ill; hence the Hungarian word for nightmare, lidércnyomás, "lidérc pressure".

basis_claims.quote: The lidérc hoards gold and thus makes its owner rich. To dispose of this form of the lidérc, it must be persuaded to perform an impossible task, such as haul sand with rope, or water with a sieve. It can also be destroyed by locking it into a tree hollow.

statement.id: Lidérc menimbun emas sehingga pemiliknya kaya; untuk menyingkirkannya, ia harus dibujuk mengerjakan tugas mustahil, seperti mengangkut pasir dengan tali atau air dengan saringan, atau dimusnahkan dengan dikurung dalam lubang pohon.
statement.en: The lidérc hoards gold and so makes its owner rich; to get rid of it, it must be persuaded to do an impossible task, such as hauling sand with a rope or water with a sieve, or it can be destroyed by locking it in a tree hollow.

basis_claims.quote: A lidérc (lüdérc, lúdvérc, lederc, lidroc, lidröc, inglice stb) a magyar mitológia démona, mely a néphagyományban szélesen elterjedt.

statement.id: Lidérc (juga lüdérc, lúdvérc, lederc, lidroc, lidröc, inglice, dan lain-lain) adalah demon mitologi Hungaria yang tersebar luas dalam tradisi rakyat.
statement.en: The lidérc (also lüdérc, lúdvérc, lederc, lidroc, lidröc, inglice and so on) is a demon of Hungarian mythology widespread in folk tradition.

basis_claims.quote: Az elnevezések különbözőek lehetnek, de minden nép folklórja megegyezik abban, bármilyen hasznos is lehet, gonosz természete miatt minél hamarabb meg kell szabadulni tőle.

statement.id: Namanya bisa berbeda-beda, tetapi folklor semua bangsa sepakat bahwa betapapun bergunanya, karena sifatnya yang jahat ia harus disingkirkan secepat mungkin.
statement.en: The names may differ, but every people's folklore agrees that, however useful it may be, because of its evil nature it must be got rid of as soon as possible.

visual_requirements: An enormous long serpentine dragoness with huge predatory mouth, no human face or body. Its tail coils down over a Balkan crop field while its head rises into black hail-bearing thunderclouds. Sinuous scaled body clearly connects head and tail. No human woman, no unrelated armored wings, no deity.
Destructive voracious storm terror
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: is a female mythological creature recorded in the folklore of Bulgarians, Macedonians, and Serbs. Ale are considered demons of bad weather whose main purpose is to lead hail-producing thunderclouds in the direction of fields, vineyards, or orchards to destroy the crops, or loot and take them away.

statement.id: Ala adalah makhluk mitologis perempuan dalam folklor orang Bulgaria, Makedonia, dan Serbia; ale dianggap iblis cuaca buruk yang tujuan utamanya menggiring awan guntur pembawa hujan es ke ladang, kebun anggur, atau kebun buah untuk menghancurkan atau menjarah panen.
statement.en: The ala is a female mythological being in Bulgarian, Macedonian and Serbian folklore; ale are demons of bad weather whose main aim is to lead hail-producing thunderclouds over fields, vineyards or orchards to destroy or loot the crops.

basis_claims.quote: A given ala may look like a black wind, a gigantic creature of indistinct form, a huge-mouthed, humanlike, or snakelike monster, a dragoness, or a raven. An ala may also assume various human or animal shapes, and can even possess a person's body.

statement.id: Ala bisa berwujud angin hitam, makhluk raksasa yang bentuknya tak jelas, monster bermulut besar yang mirip manusia atau ular, naga betina, atau gagak; ia juga bisa mengambil berbagai rupa manusia atau hewan dan merasuki tubuh seseorang.
statement.en: An ala may look like a black wind, a gigantic creature of unclear form, a huge-mouthed humanlike or snakelike monster, a dragoness or a raven; she may also take human or animal shapes and possess a person's body.

basis_claims.quote: Ale are said to live in the clouds, or in a lake, spring, hidden remote place, forest, inhospitable mountain, cave, or gigantic tree.

statement.id: Ale dikatakan tinggal di awan, atau di danau, mata air, tempat terpencil tersembunyi, hutan, gunung yang tak ramah, gua, atau pohon raksasa.
statement.en: Ale are said to live in the clouds or in a lake, spring, hidden remote place, forest, inhospitable mountain, cave or gigantic tree.

statement.en: The Luisón (Paraguayan Guarani Luisõ; Spanish Luisón or Lobizón) is one of the seven legendary beasts of Paraguay, the seventh and last son of Tau and Kerana; the myth is also known in Argentina and holds that in a family of seven sons the last will become a Luisón.

basis_claims.quote: In the original version of the myth, Luisón was the seventh and last child of Tau and Kerana, and thus was the most accursed. He appeared to be a giant dog, and was said to be extremely ugly, even horrendous looking.

statement.en: In the original myth, as the seventh child of Tau and Kerana he was the most accursed, looking like a giant, hideous dog.

statement.en: The maned wolf, a slender long-legged wolf-like canid with a shambling gait, fitted the werewolf image brought by settlers and was eventually blended with local Guarani myths.

basis_claims.quote: Interpretation of the bauk's attributes leads to the conclusion that the bauk is actually a description of real bears, which were already regionally extinct in some parts of Serbia and known only as legend.

statement.id: Penafsiran sifat-sifat bauk mengarah pada kesimpulan bahwa ia sebenarnya gambaran beruang sungguhan yang di sebagian Serbia sudah punah dan hanya dikenal sebagai legenda.
statement.en: Interpreting the bauk's traits suggests it is really a description of actual bears, already extinct in parts of Serbia and known only as legend.

basis_claims.quote: Сама ријеч баук је првобитно била коришћена као хипокоризам за медвједа.

statement.id: Kata bauk semula dipakai sebagai hipokorisme (sebutan sayang) untuk beruang.
statement.en: The word bauk was originally used as a hypocorism for the bear.

basis_claims.quote: Глагол бауљати, која означава неспретан ход, долази од имена овог митолошког бића. Ономатопеја која се користи за ријеч баук је бау, а еуфемизам ове ријечи је баја.

statement.id: Kata kerja bauljati, yang berarti berjalan canggung, berasal dari nama makhluk ini; bunyi tiruannya "bau", dan eufemismenya baja.
statement.en: The verb bauljati, meaning a clumsy walk, comes from this creature's name; its onomatopoeia is "bau" and its euphemism baja.

visual_requirements: Exactly TWO distinct quadrupedal fabulous beasts. Bicorn is FAT and round-bodied, a cow-panther hybrid with human-like FACE and exactly two horns, four animal legs and long tail. Chichevache is contrasting extremely THIN and lean cow-like creature with clearly narrow ribs. Both nonhuman animal bodies shown entirely in a medieval courtyard. No people, eating, gore, signs or text.
Strange satirical medieval bestiary
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: Bicorn and Chichevache are fabulous beasts that appear in European satirical works of the Middle Ages and Renaissance. Bicorn is a creature—part panther, part cow, with a human-like face—that devours kind-hearted and devoted husbands and (because of their abundance) is plump and well fed.

statement.id: Bicorn dan Chichevache adalah binatang dongeng dalam karya satire Eropa Abad Pertengahan dan Renaisans; Bicorn, setengah macan tutul setengah sapi berwajah manusia, memangsa suami yang baik dan setia sehingga gemuk karena mangsanya melimpah.
statement.en: Bicorn and Chichevache are fabulous beasts of European satire in the Middle Ages and Renaissance; Bicorn, part panther, part cow with a human face, devours kind and devoted husbands and is fat because they are plentiful.

basis_claims.quote: Chichevache, on the other hand, devours obedient wives and (because of their scarcity) is thin and starving.

statement.id: Chichevache sebaliknya memangsa istri yang patuh sehingga kurus kelaparan karena mangsanya langka.
statement.en: Chichevache instead devours obedient wives and is thin and starving because they are scarce.

basis_claims.quote: Chaucer may have borrowed the French term chichifache ("thin face") and blended it with vache ("cow") to make the similar term chichevache ("thin or meagre cow").

statement.id: Chaucer mungkin meminjam istilah Prancis chichifache ("wajah kurus") dan memadukannya dengan vache ("sapi") menjadi chichevache ("sapi kurus").
statement.en: Chaucer may have borrowed the French chichifache ('thin face') and blended it with vache ('cow') into chichevache ('thin cow').

basis_claims.quote: Двурог, помимо обладания двумя рогами, имеет тело наполовину коровы и наполовину пантеры, а также человеческое лицо.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Rusia menyebut Bicorn, selain bertanduk dua, bertubuh setengah sapi setengah macan tutul dan berwajah manusia.
statement.en: The Russian article says the Bicorn, besides its two horns, has a body half cow, half panther and a human face.

visual_requirements: One Zilant, a legendary winged SNAKE of Tatar folklore: elongated coiling scaly serpent torso, one dragonlike head and two featherless reptilian wings. Low crouching avian-like hind legs only if supported; favor clear coiled snake without unnecessary limbs. Tatar riverside hill setting. Not a heraldic logo, no human rider, no extra heads.
Proud ominous winged serpent
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary creature, something between a dragon and a wyvern in Tatar mythology.

statement.id: Zilant adalah makhluk legendaris di antara naga dan wyvern dalam mitologi Tatar.
statement.en: Zilant is a legendary creature between a dragon and a wyvern in Tatar mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Since 1730, it has been the official symbol of Kazan, the capital city of the Republic of Tatarstan in Russia. This winged snake is mentioned in legends about the foundation of Kazan.

statement.id: Sejak 1730 Zilant menjadi lambang resmi Kazan, ibu kota Republik Tatarstan di Rusia, dan ular bersayap ini disebut dalam legenda pendirian Kazan.
statement.en: Since 1730 Zilant has been the official symbol of Kazan, capital of the Republic of Tatarstan in Russia, and this winged snake appears in legends of Kazan's founding.

basis_claims.quote: ist als geflügelte Schlange mit dem Vorderteil eines Drachen ein Fabelwesen, das ein Teil der tatarischen und russischen Folklore ist.

statement.id: Zilant adalah makhluk dongeng berupa ular bersayap dengan bagian depan seekor naga, bagian dari cerita rakyat Tatar dan Rusia.
statement.en: The Zilant is a fabulous winged snake with the forepart of a dragon, part of Tatar and Russian folklore.

visual_requirements: The divine Biscione serpent of Milan, one sinuous blue-green scaled serpent upright in a spiral. Its open mouth shows a SMALL FULLY CLOTHED child emerging peacefully upward, waist at mouth, upper body outside and arms raised, clearly a symbolic rebirth interpretation rather than attack. Creature dominates; tiny child secondary. No injury, biting, blood or gore. Medieval Milan stone courtyard backdrop, no car logos or text.
Mysterious solemn heraldic power
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: The biscione (English: "big grass snake"), less commonly known also as the vipera, is in heraldry a charge consisting of a divine serpent with a child in its mouth; the serpent may be variously described as being in the act of swallowing the child, or the child may be emerging from its mouth.

statement.id: Biscione ("ular rumput besar"), juga disebut vipera, dalam heraldik adalah gambar ular ilahi dengan seorang anak di mulutnya, yang ditafsirkan sedang menelan anak itu atau anak itu keluar dari mulutnya.
statement.en: The biscione ('big grass snake'), also called vipera, is a heraldic charge of a divine serpent with a child in its mouth, read either as swallowing the child or as the child emerging from its mouth.

basis_claims.quote: It is a historic symbol of the city of Milan, originally on the coat-of-arms of the Visconti and Sforza dynasties.

statement.id: Ia lambang bersejarah kota Milan, semula pada lambang dinasti Visconti dan Sforza.
statement.en: It is a historic symbol of Milan, originally on the arms of the Visconti and Sforza dynasties.

basis_claims.quote: One of the oldest depictions of the Biscione is in the Great Hall of the Visconti Castle of Angera. The hall was painted at the end of the 13th century with frescoes celebrating Archbishop Ottone Visconti's victory against the rival family of the Della Torre.

statement.id: Salah satu gambaran tertua biscione ada di Aula Besar Kastel Visconti di Angera, yang dilukis fresko pada akhir abad ke-13 untuk merayakan kemenangan Uskup Agung Ottone Visconti atas keluarga Della Torre.
statement.en: One of the oldest depictions of the biscione is in the Great Hall of the Visconti Castle at Angera, frescoed in the late 13th century to celebrate Archbishop Ottone Visconti's victory over the Della Torre.

drape-legend.depicted_variant: One French LOU DRAPE (Drapé), ghastly supernatural HORSE with markedly elongated continuous back and rump, same one natural horse head, four equine legs and one tail
visual_requirements: One French LOU DRAPE (Drapé), ghastly supernatural HORSE with markedly elongated continuous back and rump, same one natural horse head, four equine legs and one tail. Show full exceptionally long body side-on beside medieval Aigues-Mortes walls and Camargue marshes at night. Ominous death-symbol kidnapping horse aura, eerie pale pelt artist-chosen. No riders, children, violence, wings, horns, human face or extra legs.
drape-legend.aura: One French LOU DRAPE (Drapé), ghastly supernatural HORSE with markedly elongated continuous back and rump, same one natural horse head, four equine legs and one tail. Show full exceptionally long body side-on beside medieval Aigues-Mortes walls and Camargue marshes at night. Ominous death-symbol kidnapping horse aura, eerie pale pelt artist-chosen. No riders, children, violence, wings, horns, human face or extra legs.

basis_claims.quote: Lou Drapé (lo drapet in the classical norm of Occitan, lou or lo meaning "the") is a legendary folkloric horse of the town of Aigues-Mortes in the Gard region, in the Petite Camargue marsh area of France.

statement.id: Lou Drapé (lo drapet dalam ejaan Oksitan baku) adalah kuda legendaris dari cerita rakyat kota Aigues-Mortes di Gard, di daerah rawa Petite Camargue, Prancis.
statement.en: Lou Drapé (lo drapet in standard Occitan) is a legendary folk horse of the town of Aigues-Mortes in the Gard, in the Petite Camargue marshes of France.

basis_claims.quote: Lou Drapé could be a version of the drac legend of Occitania, an evil creature that can assume the shape of a horse. The image of this ghastly horse is a symbol of death. It is used to scare children, like the bogeyman or the big bad wolf in other regions of France.

statement.id: Lou Drapé mungkin versi legenda drac Occitania, makhluk jahat yang dapat berwujud kuda; kuda pucat ini lambang kematian dan dipakai menakuti anak seperti momok atau serigala jahat di daerah lain Prancis.
statement.en: Lou Drapé may be a version of the Occitan drac, an evil creature that can take horse shape; this ghastly horse is a symbol of death, used to scare children like the bogeyman or big bad wolf elsewhere in France.

basis_claims.quote: It is said that when lou Drapé is out, it gathers all the lost children on its back, one after the other; and that its rump gradually lengthens from a standard size to one long enough to fit fifty and a hundred children, which he then takes who knows where.

statement.id: Menurut Collin de Plancy, saat keluar Lou Drapé mengumpulkan semua anak yang tersesat di punggungnya satu per satu, dan pantatnya memanjang hingga muat lima puluh sampai seratus anak, yang dibawanya entah ke mana.
statement.en: According to Collin de Plancy, when out, Lou Drapé gathers all the lost children on its back one by one, its rump lengthening until it holds fifty or a hundred children, whom it takes who knows where.

drekavac.depicted_variant: One South Slavic DREKAVAC choosing Arilje documented variant: a creature with a distinctly CATLIKE HEAD, unnaturally LONG NECK and extremely LONG LEGS
visual_requirements: One South Slavic DREKAVAC choosing Arilje documented variant: a creature with a distinctly CATLIKE HEAD, unnaturally LONG NECK and extremely LONG LEGS. Natural quadruped feline arrangement, four long legs, one head and one tail; no human torso or human face. Gaunt eerie spindlelike night creature alone at Serbian woodland edge, neck stretched and mouth open screeching, ominous nocturnal aura. No humanoid child, horns, wings or gore.
drekavac.aura: One South Slavic DREKAVAC choosing Arilje documented variant: a creature with a distinctly CATLIKE HEAD, unnaturally LONG NECK and extremely LONG LEGS. Natural quadruped feline arrangement, four long legs, one head and one tail; no human torso or human face. Gaunt eerie spindlelike night creature alone at Serbian woodland edge, neck stretched and mouth open screeching, ominous nocturnal aura. No humanoid child, horns, wings or gore.

basis_claims.quote: Drekavac (literally "the screamer" or "the screecher"), also called drekalo, krekavac, zdrekavac or zrikavac, is a mythical creature in South Slavic mythology. The name is derived from the verb "drečati" ("to screech").

statement.id: Drekavac (harfiah "si penjerit"), juga disebut drekalo, krekavac, zdrekavac, atau zrikavac, adalah makhluk mitos Slavia Selatan; namanya diturunkan dari kata kerja drečati ("menjerit").
statement.en: Drekavac (literally "the screamer"), also called drekalo, krekavac, zdrekavac or zrikavac, is a South Slavic mythical creature; the name comes from the verb drečati ("to screech").

basis_claims.quote: In the vicinity of Arilje it has been depicted in form of a long-necked long-legged creature with a cat-like head.

statement.id: Di sekitar Arilje ia digambarkan sebagai makhluk berleher dan berkaki panjang dengan kepala seperti kucing.
statement.en: Around Arilje it is depicted as a long-necked, long-legged creature with a cat-like head.

basis_claims.quote: It was popularly believed to be visible only at night, especially during the twelve days of Christmas (called unbaptised days in Serbo-Croatian) and in early spring, when other demons and mythical creatures were believed to be more active.

statement.id: Ia dipercaya hanya tampak pada malam hari, terutama pada dua belas hari Natal ("hari tanpa baptis") dan awal musim semi, ketika setan dan makhluk mitos lain dianggap lebih aktif.
statement.en: It was believed to be visible only at night, especially in the twelve days of Christmas ("unbaptised days") and early spring, when other demons and mythical beings were thought more active.

fenodyree.depicted_variant: One Manx FENODYREE in documented SATYRLIKE form: hairy robust upper humanoid body completely densely covered in shaggy brown fur, two arms and exactly two goatlike hind legs ending in cloven hooves
visual_requirements: One Manx FENODYREE in documented SATYRLIKE form: hairy robust upper humanoid body completely densely covered in shaggy brown fur, two arms and exactly two goatlike hind legs ending in cloven hooves. Modest opaque rustic loincloth, no genital exposure. One clearly visible goatlike tail as restrained satyr interpretation, two small goat horns. Carrying a large stone block beside Manx dry-stone wall and mown meadow, helpful industrious powerful aura. No ordinary human portrait, wings, weapons or violence.
fenodyree.aura: One Manx FENODYREE in documented SATYRLIKE form: hairy robust upper humanoid body completely densely covered in shaggy brown fur, two arms and exactly two goatlike hind legs ending in cloven hooves. Modest opaque rustic loincloth, no genital exposure. One clearly visible goatlike tail as restrained satyr interpretation, two small goat horns. Carrying a large stone block beside Manx dry-stone wall and mown meadow, helpful industrious powerful aura. No ordinary human portrait, wings, weapons or violence.

basis_claims.quote: in the folklore of the Isle of Man, is a hairy supernatural creature, a sort of sprite or fairy (Manx: ferrishyn ), often carrying out chores to help humans, like the brownies of the larger areas of Scotland and England.

statement.id: Makhluk gaib berbulu folklor Pulau Man (Isle of Man), sejenis peri (Manx: ferrishyn), membantu manusia seperti brownie di Skotlandia (Scotland) dan Inggris (England).
statement.en: A hairy supernatural being of Isle of Man folklore, a fairy (Manx ferrishyn) helping humans like brownies of Scotland and England.

basis_claims.quote: performing arduous tasks such as transporting great blocks of stone, or clipping meadow grass with stupendous speed. For his talent in the grass-cutting skill, he has earned the nickname yn foldyr gastey or "the nimble mower"

statement.id: Mengangkut balok batu dan memotong rumput sangat cepat; dijuluki yn foldyr gastey.
statement.en: Carries stone blocks and mows grass at great speed; nicknamed yn foldyr gastey.

basis_claims.quote: He was transformed into a grotesque satyr-like appearance as punishment, after falling in love with a human girl from Glen Aldyn and skipping attendance of the royal high festivities of the harvest

statement.id: Mantan ksatria Istana Peri (Knight of the Fairy Court) dihukum menjadi mirip satir karena mencintai gadis Glen Aldyn dan melewatkan pesta panen.
statement.en: A former Knight of the Fairy Court punished with a satyr-like form for loving a Glen Aldyn girl and missing the harvest festival.

grande-goule.depicted_variant: 1677 Jean Gargot effigy anatomy interpreted as living Poitiers cellar dragon
visual_requirements: Enormous toothy maw
Two eagle-talon legs and bat wings
Ringed body dorsal spines scorpion-pincer tail
Abbey flood cellar setting

basis_claims.quote: The Grande Goule or Grande-Goule (Poitevin dialect: Grand'Goule ... is a folklore dragon that continues to be celebrated in the Poitou region (city of Poitiers) in France.

statement.id: Grande Goule atau Grand'Goule (dialek Poitevin) adalah naga cerita rakyat yang masih dirayakan di Poitou (kota Poitiers), Prancis.
statement.en: The Grande Goule or Grand'Goule (Poitevin dialect) is a folk dragon still celebrated in Poitou (the city of Poitiers), France.

basis_claims.quote: La bête, décrite comme un dragon monstrueux, aurait vécu au temps de sainte Radegonde, donc au VIe siècle de notre ère. Elle vivait au fond du Clain, et, lors de la montée des eaux, entrait dans les caves labyrinthiques qui traversaient le sol poitevin.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, binatang ini naga mengerikan dari masa Santa Radegonda (abad ke-6) yang tinggal di dasar sungai Clain dan saat air naik memasuki ruang bawah tanah berliku di bawah Poitiers.
statement.en: According to the French article, the beast was a monstrous dragon of the time of St Radegund (6th century) that lived at the bottom of the Clain and, when the water rose, entered the maze of cellars under Poitiers.

basis_claims.quote: According to legend, the monster haunted the cellars of the Abbey of Sainte-Croix at Poitiers, and used to devour the nuns who descended there, until St. Radegund expelled it.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, monster itu menghantui ruang bawah tanah Biara Sainte-Croix di Poitiers dan memangsa para biarawati yang turun ke sana sampai Santa Radegonda mengusirnya.
statement.en: By legend the monster haunted the cellars of the Abbey of Sainte-Croix at Poitiers and devoured the nuns who went down there until St Radegund drove it out.

basis_claims.quote: A sculpture by cabinetmaker Jean Gargot in 1677, commissioned  by the Abbey of Sainte-Croix at Poitiers, has survived into the modern age, and now housed in the Musée Sainte-Croix, in Poitiers.

statement.id: Patung karya tukang kayu Jean Gargot tahun 1677, pesanan Biara Sainte-Croix, masih ada dan kini disimpan di Musée Sainte-Croix, Poitiers.
statement.en: A sculpture by the cabinetmaker Jean Gargot from 1677, commissioned by the Abbey of Sainte-Croix, survives and is now in the Musée Sainte-Croix, Poitiers.

basis_claims.quote: グラン・グール（ポワトゥー方言: Grand'Goule、「大口」・「大きな獣の口」の意。 Grande Goule、Grande-Gouleとも）は、フランス・ポワトゥー州（ポワティエ市）の伝承におけるドラゴン。

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Jepang juga menyebut Grand'Goule, "mulut besar", naga dalam tradisi Poitou (Poitiers), Prancis.
statement.en: The Japanese article also calls the Grand'Goule, 'big mouth', a dragon of the lore of Poitou (Poitiers), France.

additional_sources.basis: Municipal heritage booklet p8/9: winged dragon terrifying maw in Clain and Abbey cellar.
Description of1677 museum effigy: annulated body, bat wings, dorsal spine, two eagle-like talon legs, scorpion-like serrated pincer tail.

graoully.depicted_variant: Metz folkloric two-legged beak-snouted winged Graouli
visual_requirements: Duck-beak-like toothy muzzle
Two short clawed legs and great bat wings
Reptilian scaled body and tail
Roman Metz amphitheatre poison menace

basis_claims.quote: In French folklore, Graoully (spelled as Graouli, Graouilly, Graouille or Graully) is a creature with the appearance of a dragon. According to legend, it lived in the arena of the Roman amphitheater in Metz, France. Legends state that Saint Clement of Metz fought against Graoully and vanquished the beast.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Prancis, Graoully (juga Graouli, Graouilly, Graouille, atau Graully) adalah makhluk berwujud naga yang menurut legenda tinggal di arena amfiteater Romawi di Metz, dan Santo Klemens dari Metz melawan serta mengalahkannya.
statement.en: In French folklore Graoully (also Graouli, Graouilly, Graouille or Graully) is a dragon-like creature that by legend lived in the arena of the Roman amphitheatre at Metz, and Saint Clement of Metz fought and overcame it.

basis_claims.quote: Mais des serpents installés dans l'amphithéâtre empoisonnent l'air de leur souffle venimeux et interdisent ainsi l'accès à la ville.

statement.id: Ular-ular di amfiteater meracuni udara dengan napas berbisa sehingga orang tidak bisa memasuki kota.
statement.en: Serpents in the amphitheatre poisoned the air with their venomous breath and so barred access to the city.

additional_sources.basis: French folklore association describes Graouli as dragon with duck beak and two legs.
Scholarly geography article describes two legs, wide wings and tooth-filled mouth in Graouilly depiction.

humbaba.depicted_variant: Hairy monstrous anthropomorphic Cedar Forest guardian
visual_requirements: Hairy giant ogre body
Lion claws
Monstrous ridged face
Cedar forest guardian

basis_claims.quote: He was portrayed as an anthropomorphic figure comparable to an ogre or giant.

statement.id: Humbaba digambarkan sebagai sosok mirip manusia yang dibandingkan dengan ogre atau raksasa.
statement.en: Humbaba is depicted as an anthropomorphic figure comparable to an ogre or giant.

basis_claims.quote: guardian of the great Cedar Forest who is killed by Gilgamesh and Enkidu in The Epic of Gilgamesh.

statement.id: Humbaba menjaga Hutan Aras dan dibunuh Gilgamesh serta Enkidu dalam eposnya.
statement.en: Humbaba guards the Cedar Forest and is killed by Gilgamesh and Enkidu in the epic.

basis_claims.quote: He is depicted as a hairy giant with lion's claws and a monster's face.

statement.id: Humbaba digambarkan berbulu, bercakar singa, dan berwajah monster.
statement.en: Humbaba is depicted as hairy, with lion’s claws and a monstrous face.

visual_requirements: Wingless green dragon-sized lizard
Very wide mouth and sharp fangs
Smoke from nose
Frightening Catalan tradition

basis_claims.quote: The Marraco (Catalan: Lo Marraco, Catalan pronunciation: [məˈraku])  is a dragon or frightening creature in Catalan myth in the city of Lleida. It possessed a mouth wide enough to swallow a human whole according to tales told to frighten children.

statement.id: Marraco (bahasa Katalan: Lo Marraco) adalah naga atau makhluk menakutkan dalam mitos Katalan di kota Lleida; menurut cerita untuk menakuti anak, mulutnya cukup lebar untuk menelan manusia bulat-bulat.
statement.en: The Marraco (Catalan: Lo Marraco) is a dragon or frightening creature of Catalan myth in the city of Lleida; in tales told to frighten children, its mouth was wide enough to swallow a person whole.

basis_claims.quote: Amb el nom de lo Marraco es coneix a la ciutat de Lleida un lluert de la mida d'un drac, amb una boca especialment ampla i grossa amb la qual es menja els xumets dels infants, com a símbol del seu creixement.

statement.id: Di Lleida, Lo Marraco dikenal sebagai kadal sebesar naga dengan mulut sangat lebar yang memakan dot bayi, sebagai lambang pertumbuhan anak.
statement.en: In Lleida, Lo Marraco is known as a dragon-sized lizard with a very wide mouth that eats babies' dummies, as a symbol of their growing up.

basis_claims.quote: One recorded post-medieval precursor of "Lo Marraco de Lleida" was the drac or dragon figure used by the city during the procession of the Assumption of Mary for the year in 1551.

statement.id: Salah satu pendahulu Lo Marraco de Lleida yang tercatat adalah figur naga yang dipakai kota itu dalam prosesi Maria Diangkat ke Surga tahun 1551.
statement.en: A recorded precursor of Lo Marraco de Lleida was the dragon figure the city used in the procession of the Assumption of Mary in 1551.

basis_claims.quote: Tiene un tamaño de 8,5 m de largo por 2,90 m de ancho y 3,75 de alzada. Su peso supera las dos toneladas. Es un dragón sin alas, de color verde con colmillos muy afilados y saca humo por la nariz.

statement.id: Figur itu panjangnya 8,5 m, lebar 2,90 m, tinggi 3,75 m, dan beratnya lebih dari dua ton; berupa naga hijau tanpa sayap bertaring tajam yang mengeluarkan asap dari hidung.
statement.en: The figure is 8.5 m long, 2.90 m wide and 3.75 m high and weighs over two tonnes; it is a wingless green dragon with very sharp fangs that blows smoke from its nose.

visual_requirements: Warsaw female fish-tail guardian
Sword in right hand and shield left
Vistula river
Resolute protective presence

basis_claims.quote: is a symbol of Warsaw, represented on the city's coat of arms as well as in a number of statues and other imagery.

statement.id: Putri Duyung Warsawa adalah lambang Warsawa, ditampilkan pada lambang kota serta dalam sejumlah patung dan gambar lain.
statement.en: The Mermaid of Warsaw is a symbol of Warsaw, shown on the city's coat of arms and in many statues and other images.

basis_claims.quote: The City's literature and tour guides say the mermaid decided to stay after stopping on a riverbank near the Old Town. Fishermen noticed something was creating waves, tangling nets, and releasing their fish. They planned to trap the animal, then heard her singing and fell in love.
basis_claims.locator: The legend of the Warsaw mermaid

statement.id: Menurut literatur dan pemandu wisata kota, putri duyung itu memutuskan menetap setelah singgah di tepi sungai dekat Kota Tua; para nelayan melihat sesuatu membuat gelombang, mengusutkan jaring, dan melepaskan ikan, lalu berniat menangkapnya, tetapi jatuh cinta setelah mendengar nyanyiannya.
statement.en: City literature and guides say the mermaid chose to stay after stopping on a riverbank near the Old Town; fishermen saw something making waves, tangling nets and freeing their fish, planned to trap it, then heard her sing and fell in love.

basis_claims.quote: A rich merchant trapped and imprisoned the mermaid. Hearing her cries, the fishermen rescued her. Ever since, the mermaid, armed with a sword and a shield, has been ready to help protect the city and its residents.
basis_claims.locator: The legend of the Warsaw mermaid

statement.id: Seorang saudagar kaya menangkap dan mengurung putri duyung itu; mendengar tangisnya, para nelayan menyelamatkannya, dan sejak itu ia, bersenjata pedang dan perisai, siap membantu melindungi kota dan warganya.
statement.en: A rich merchant caught and imprisoned the mermaid; hearing her cries, the fishermen rescued her, and ever since, armed with sword and shield, she has stood ready to protect the city and its people.

basis_claims.quote: In der linken Hand hält sie einen Schild, in der rechten ein Schwert.

statement.id: Di tangan kiri (linken Hand) ia memegang perisai (Schild), di tangan kanan sebilah pedang (Schwert).
statement.en: In her left hand (linken Hand) she holds a shield (Schild), in her right a sword (Schwert).

basis_claims.quote: Die aktuelle Gestalt einer Frau mit einem Fischschwanz stammt aus dem Jahre 1622. Diese Anordnung gilt bis heute.

statement.id: Wujud saat ini, perempuan berekor ikan, berasal dari tahun 1622 dan berlaku sampai sekarang.
statement.en: The current form, a woman with a fish tail, dates from 1622 and is still in use today.

minhocao-legendary-creature.depicted_variant: Giant earthworm-like Minhocao, not fish hypothesis
visual_requirements: Giant wormlike Brazilian creature
Limbless worm body
Damp terrain and deep trench
Earth-uprooting immense presence

basis_claims.quote: is a creature from Brazilian folklore that is variously claimed to be a large fish or resembling a worm

statement.id: Minhocão adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Brasil yang diklaim berupa ikan besar atau menyerupai cacing.
statement.en: The Minhocão is a creature of Brazilian folklore variously said to be a large fish or worm-like.

basis_claims.quote: The Minhocão was described to European explorers and naturalists in the 19th century by locals in Brazil.

statement.id: Penduduk Brasil menceritakan Minhocão kepada penjelajah dan naturalis Eropa pada abad ke-19.
statement.en: Locals in Brazil described the Minhocão to European explorers and naturalists in the 19th century.

basis_claims.quote: He determined 'Minhocão' to be an augmentative of 'minhoca', Portuguese for earthworm.

statement.id: Ia menyimpulkan Minhocão adalah bentuk pembesar dari minhoca, kata Portugis untuk cacing tanah.
statement.en: He concluded that Minhocão is an augmentative of minhoca, Portuguese for earthworm.

basis_claims.quote: It was said to uproot trees and leave deep trenches in its path, and to prefer damp conditions.

statement.id: Ia konon mencabut pohon, meninggalkan parit dalam di jalurnya, dan menyukai tempat lembap.
statement.en: It was said to uproot trees, leave deep trenches in its path and prefer damp conditions.

morvarc-h.depicted_variant: Black fire-breathing horse galloping on waves
visual_requirements: Black Breton sea horse
Gallops on waves
Fire from nostrils
Wild formidable marine presence

basis_claims.quote: is the name of a fabulous horse of Breton legend found in two folktales reworked in the 19th and 20th centuries. Though its name appears in older sources, it was invented or reinterpreted by Charles Guyot, who named it Morvark in his version of the legend of the city of Ys in 1926. It belongs to the "Queen of the North" Malgven, who gives it to her husband King Gradlon.

statement.id: Morvarc'h (kuda laut, Breton), legenda Bretagne (Breton, Prancis); Charles Guyot, Morvark, kota Ys, 1926; milik Malgven, Ratu Utara (Queen of the North), untuk Raja (King) Gradlon. Dua dongeng digubah ulang abad ke-19 dan ke-20 (19th, 20th).
statement.en: Morvarc'h (sea horse, Breton), of Breton legend; Charles Guyot, Morvark, city of Ys, 1926; Malgven's, Queen of the North, given to King Gradlon. Two folktales reworked in the 19th and 20th centuries.

basis_claims.quote: Endowed with the ability to gallop on the waves, Morvarc'h is described as having a black coat and as breathing flames through its nostrils.

statement.id: Berlari di atas ombak, bulu hitam, menyemburkan api.
statement.en: Gallops on the waves, black coat, breathes flames.

basis_claims.quote: The name Morvarc'h means "sea horse" or "marine horse" in Breton. It appears in Grégoire de Rostrenen's [fr] dictionary, published in 1732.

statement.id: Morvarc'h berarti kuda laut; kamus Grégoire de Rostrenen, 1732.
statement.en: Morvarc'h means sea horse; Grégoire de Rostrenen's dictionary, 1732.

basis_claims.quote: Dotado de la facultad de galopar sobre las olas, Morvarc'h está descrito como cubierto de sombras y expira llamas por las fosas nasales.

statement.id: Artikel es: berlari di atas ombak dan menyemburkan api dari hidung.
statement.en: es article: gallops on the waves and breathes flames from its nostrils.

visual_requirements: Demonic Buryat bird-of-prey/carrion form
Ugly full avian body
Dangerous death/epidemic omen aura

basis_claims.quote: is a mythological bird in Turkic and, Mongolic mythology.

statement.id: Muu shuvuu adalah burung mitologis dalam mitologi Turkik dan Mongol.
statement.en: Muu shuvuu is a mythological bird in Turkic and Mongolic mythology.

basis_claims.quote: They would look like young girls but have a sharp beak, which they try to cover either in a veil or with their hands. With their beaks, they would try to suck out the blood of the bodies of their victims.

statement.id: Mereka tampak seperti gadis muda tetapi berparuh tajam yang ditutupi kerudung atau tangan, dan dengan paruh itu mereka mengisap darah korban.
statement.en: They look like young girls but have sharp beaks, hidden behind a veil or their hands, with which they suck their victims' blood.

basis_claims.quote: They were especially dangerous to travellers or lonely hunters.

statement.id: Mereka terutama berbahaya bagi pejalan dan pemburu yang sendirian.
statement.en: They were especially dangerous to travellers and lone hunters.

basis_claims.quote: персонаж бурятской мифологии, демоническое существо в облике уродливой, хищной или падальной птицы.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Buryat, Muu Shubuun adalah makhluk iblis berwujud burung buruk rupa, pemangsa, atau pemakan bangkai.
statement.en: In Buryat mythology Muu Shubuun is a demonic being in the form of an ugly bird of prey or carrion bird.

basis_claims.quote: В традиционных верованиях бурят Муу Шубуун выступает как персонификация эпидемий, внезапной смерти, сглаза и всевозможных несчастий.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan Buryat ia personifikasi wabah, kematian mendadak, mata jahat, dan segala kemalangan.
statement.en: In Buryat belief it personifies epidemics, sudden death, the evil eye and all kinds of misfortune.

basis_claims.quote: «дурная птица», «злая птица», «птица болезни»

statement.id: Namanya berarti "burung buruk", "burung jahat", atau "burung penyakit".
statement.en: Its name means "bad bird", "evil bird" or "bird of sickness".

nuggle.depicted_variant: Horse disguise with conspicuous wheel-like tail
visual_requirements: Shetland male water horse
Wheel-like tail
Watermill/loch context
Mischievous gentle trickster
nuggle.aura: Gentle yet sly nocturnal water trickster

basis_claims.quote: is a mythical water horse of primarily Shetland folklore where it is also referred to as a shoepultie or shoopiltee on some parts of the islands. A nocturnal creature that is always of a male gender

statement.id: Nuggle (njuggle, neugle), kuda air folklor Shetland, shoepultie atau shoopiltee; nokturnal, selalu jantan; Kepulauan Orkney (Orkney), loch.
statement.en: Nuggle (njuggle, neugle), water horse of Shetland folklore, shoepultie or shoopiltee; nocturnal, always male; Orkney, lochs.

basis_claims.quote: He is easily recognised by his distinctive wheel-like tail and, unlike his evil counterparts the each-uisge or the nuckelavee, has a fairly gentle disposition being more prone to playing pranks and making mischief rather than having malicious intents.

statement.id: Ekor seperti roda; tak seperti each-uisge atau nuckelavee, wataknya lembut dan suka iseng.
statement.en: Wheel-like tail; unlike the each-uisge or nuckelavee, gentle and prankish.

basis_claims.quote: The entity was capable of assuming many disguises but generally favoured the form of an attractive horse; he never assumed a human form.

statement.id: Menyamar dalam banyak wujud, biasanya kuda menarik, tak pernah manusia; dekat kincir air.
statement.en: Assumes many disguises, usually an attractive horse, never human; near watermills.

basis_claims.quote: If the nuggle had successfully tricked an unsuspecting passer-by into mounting him, usually by pretending to be tame and standing tranquilly at the side of a path, he would immediately make for the nearest deep water.

statement.id: Memperdaya orang menungganginya lalu lari ke air terdalam.
statement.en: Tricks a passer-by into mounting, then heads for deep water.

basis_claims.quote: Jessie Saxby suggests fear of the nuggle prevented children venturing too close to deep water or watermills

statement.id: Jessie Saxby: ketakutan akan nuggle menjauhkan anak dari air dalam dan kincir air.
statement.en: Jessie Saxby: fear of the nuggle kept children from deep water and watermills.

fiery-serpents-in-slavic-folklore.depicted_variant: One East Slavic FIERY SERPENT explicitly its AIRBORNE WINGED SERPENT variant: one long glowing fiery snake body and head, one pair of wings, no arms or legs
visual_requirements: One East Slavic FIERY SERPENT explicitly its AIRBORNE WINGED SERPENT variant: one long glowing fiery snake body and head, one pair of wings, no arms or legs. Flying diagonally over remote Russian village roofs on cold night, orange embers and sparks trailing, ominous seductive malevolent spirit atmosphere. No human lover, women, ordinary human form, extra heads or limbs, no text.
fiery-serpents-in-slavic-folklore.aura: One East Slavic FIERY SERPENT explicitly its AIRBORNE WINGED SERPENT variant: one long glowing fiery snake body and head, one pair of wings, no arms or legs. Flying diagonally over remote Russian village roofs on cold night, orange embers and sparks trailing, ominous seductive malevolent spirit atmosphere. No human lover, women, ordinary human form, extra heads or limbs, no text.

basis_claims.quote: among other names, are evil beings in Russian folklore, often shapeshifted demons or spirits.

statement.id: Ular api (Rusia ognennyi zmei, Ukraina vohnyanyy zmiy) adalah makhluk jahat dalam cerita rakyat Rusia, sering iblis atau roh yang berubah wujud.
statement.en: Fiery serpents (Russian ognennyi zmei, Ukrainian vohnyanyy zmiy) are evil beings in Russian folklore, often shapeshifted demons or spirits.

basis_claims.quote: In East Slavic tradition, the "fiery serpent" is said to generally resemble a fiery shaft (Russian: коромысло, "fiery carrying pole"), a flaming broom, or a glowing ball of blue fire, releasing sparks during its flight. This has been connected to the astronomical phenomena of bolides, shooting stars (meteors) or meteorites.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi Slavia Timur, ular api umumnya mirip batang menyala ("pikulan api"), sapu yang terbakar, atau bola api biru yang memercikkan bunga api saat terbang; hal ini dikaitkan dengan bola api meteor, bintang jatuh, atau meteorit.
statement.en: In East Slavic tradition the fiery serpent generally resembles a fiery shaft ("fiery carrying pole"), a flaming broom or a glowing ball of blue fire throwing sparks in flight; this has been linked to bolides, shooting stars or meteorites.

basis_claims.quote: вступает сексуальные отношения с женщинами, результатом чего является болезнь и смерть женщины, также обладает двойственным внешним обликом — в воздухе имеет вид огненного крылатого змея, на земле — человека.

statement.id: Ular api (Огненный змей) menjalin hubungan seksual dengan perempuan, yang berakibat sakit dan kematian sang perempuan, dan berwujud ganda: di udara ular api bersayap, di bumi manusia.
statement.en: The fiery serpent has sexual relations with women, resulting in their illness and death, and has a double form: a fiery winged serpent in the air, a man on the ground.

guivre.depicted_variant: One medieval French GUIVRE, a long serpentine body with a fierce DRAGON HEAD, two small forehead horns, no wings and no visible legs, selecting documented limbless variant
visual_requirements: One medieval French GUIVRE, a long serpentine body with a fierce DRAGON HEAD, two small forehead horns, no wings and no visible legs, selecting documented limbless variant. Coiled on damp forest edge beside small pool, aggressive alert head showing venomous breath as restrained vapor. Entire snake body and tail visible, ominous dangerous beast aura. guivre.aura: One medieval French GUIVRE, a long serpentine body with a fierce DRAGON HEAD, two small forehead horns, no wings and no visible legs, selecting documented limbless variant. Coiled on damp forest edge beside small pool, aggressive alert head showing venomous breath as restrained vapor. Entire snake body and tail visible, ominous dangerous beast aura. No human-like face, extra heads, limbs or armor.

basis_claims.quote: In legend they are portrayed as serpentine creatures who possessed venomous breath and prowled the countryside of Medieval France.

statement.id: Dalam legenda mereka digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip ular bernapas racun yang berkeliaran di pedesaan Prancis abad pertengahan.
statement.en: In legend they are serpentine creatures with venomous breath that prowled the countryside of medieval France.

basis_claims.quote: Guivres (alternatively givres) were said to possess a long, serpentine body and a dragon's head. The hind feet are not as visible if present at all. The guivre had horns in its forehead in some accounts, as well.

statement.id: Guivre bertubuh panjang seperti ular dan berkepala naga, kaki belakangnya hampir tak terlihat kalaupun ada, dan dalam sebagian kisah bertanduk di dahi.
statement.en: Guivres had a long serpentine body and a dragon's head, hind feet barely visible if present at all, and in some accounts horns on the forehead.

basis_claims.quote: Documentation points to their residence as being in small bodies of water like pools and lakes, forests, and any damp place.

statement.id: Guivre tinggal di perairan kecil seperti kolam dan danau, di hutan, dan di tempat lembap.
statement.en: Guivres lived in small bodies of water like pools and lakes, in forests and in any damp place.

visual_requirements: One HIRCOCERVUS legendary GOAT-STAG hybrid, combining billy-goat shaggy chest, chin beard and muzzle with stag body, branched deer antlers, four slender deer-goat legs ending in cloven hooves and short deer tail. One natural animal head, not two heads. Whole animal in clear three-quarter profile in ancient Mediterranean woodland meadow. Calm wondrous elusive hybrid aura, anatomically plausible painterly animal. No human body, wings, extra horns separate from antlers or saddle.
