basis_claims.quote: The hircocervus (Latin: hircus, "billy goat" + cervus, "stag") or tragelaph (Greek: τράγος, romanized: tragos, "billy goat" + έλαφος, elaphos, "stag"), also known as a goat-stag, was a legendary creature imagined to be half-goat, half-stag.

statement.id: Hircocervus (Latin: hircus, "kambing jantan" + cervus, "rusa jantan") atau tragelaphos (Yunani), juga disebut kambing-rusa, adalah makhluk legendaris yang dibayangkan setengah kambing setengah rusa.
statement.en: The hircocervus (Latin hircus, 'billy goat' + cervus, 'stag') or tragelaph (Greek), also called goat-stag, was a legendary creature imagined as half goat, half stag.

basis_claims.quote: In Plato's Republic, Socrates speaks of his own image-making as similar to that of painters who paint goat-stags, combining the features of different things together (488a).

statement.id: Dalam Republik karya Platon, Sokrates menyamakan caranya membuat gambaran dengan pelukis yang melukis kambing-rusa, menggabungkan ciri berbagai hal (488a).
statement.en: In Plato's Republic, Socrates likens his image-making to painters who paint goat-stags by combining features of different things (488a).

visual_requirements: Elephant-trunk nose
Yellow basilisk eyes
Dark rough slate skin
Ardennes slate quarry

basis_claims.quote: The Karnabo resembles a man but with an elephant's trunk for a nose and the eyes of a basilisk.  The breath of the creature is said to be able to paralyse men and kill animals.

statement.id: Karnabo mirip manusia tetapi berhidung belalai gajah dan bermata basilisk; napasnya konon dapat melumpuhkan manusia dan membunuh hewan.
statement.en: The Karnabo looks like a man but with an elephant's trunk for a nose and a basilisk's eyes; its breath can paralyse people and kill animals.

basis_claims.quote: Il a une tête presque humaine, mais possède une trompe de laquelle sort son sifflement strident, des yeux jaune de basilic et une peau sombre et rugueuse comme les parois de l'ardoisière ou il vit.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, kepalanya hampir manusia, tetapi berbelalai yang mengeluarkan siulan melengking, bermata kuning basilisk, dan berkulit gelap kasar seperti dinding tambang sabak tempatnya tinggal.
statement.en: According to the French article, its head is almost human, but it has a trunk that gives out a shrill whistle, yellow basilisk eyes and dark, rough skin like the walls of its slate quarry.

knucker.depicted_variant: Documented winged sea-serpent interpretation of Sussex knucker
visual_requirements: Winged water dragon/sea-serpent form
One long serpent body and tail
Deep Sussex knuckerhole
Frost mist and predatory menace

basis_claims.quote: Knucker is a dialect word for a sort of water dragon, living in knuckerholes in Sussex, England. The word comes from the Old English nicor which means "water monster" and is used in the poem Beowulf. It may also be related to the word "nixie"

statement.id: Naga air dialek Sussex, Inggris (England), di knuckerhole; dari kata Inggris Kuno (Old English) nicor, monster air, dalam Beowulf.
statement.en: A water dragon of Sussex dialect, England, in knuckerholes; from Old English nicor, water monster, used in Beowulf.

basis_claims.quote: The knucker is said to have wings, and is sometimes described as a sea serpent.

statement.id: Knucker bersayap, kadang digambarkan sebagai ular laut.
statement.en: The knucker has wings and is sometimes described as a sea serpent.

basis_claims.quote: It was believed that knuckers could be found at knuckerholes in various places in Sussex, including Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham and Worthing. A knucker hole is a very deep round pool, which is considered to be infinitely deep.

statement.id: Knuckerhole di Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham, Worthing; kolam bundar dalam tak berdasar.
statement.en: Knuckerholes at Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham, Worthing; deep round bottomless pools.

basis_claims.quote: Bei frostigen Lufttemperaturen bildet sich dünner Nebel über dem Wasser, was zur Legendenbildung um die Knucker beigetragen hat.

statement.id: Kabut tipis di atas air saat udara beku turut melahirkan legenda knucker.
statement.en: Thin mist over the water in frost helped give rise to the knucker legends.

visual_requirements: Colombian hideous female jungle monster
Exactly one leg ending in cloven cow hoof
Frightening forest protector

basis_claims.quote: The Patasola or "single leg" is one of many legends in Colombian folklore about female monster from jungle, appearing to male hunters or loggers in the middle of the wilderness if they think about women.

statement.id: Patasola atau "satu kaki" adalah legenda cerita rakyat Kolombia tentang monster perempuan hutan yang mendatangi pemburu atau penebang kayu di tengah belantara bila mereka memikirkan perempuan.
statement.en: The Patasola, or "single leg", is a Colombian folk legend of a female jungle monster who appears to hunters or loggers in the wilderness when they think about women.

basis_claims.quote: There, the Patasola reveals it's true, hideous appearance as a one-legged creature with ferocious vampire-like lust for human flesh and blood

statement.id: Di sana ia menampakkan wujud aslinya yang mengerikan: makhluk berkaki satu yang haus daging dan darah manusia seperti vampir.
statement.en: There it reveals its true, hideous form: a one-legged creature with a vampire-like lust for human flesh and blood.

basis_claims.quote: According to popular belief, it inhabits mountain ranges, virgin forests, and other heavily wooded or jungle-like areas.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, ia menghuni pegunungan, hutan perawan, dan kawasan berhutan lebat.
statement.en: Popular belief places it in mountain ranges, virgin forests and other densely wooded areas.

basis_claims.quote: The patasola is usually regarded as protective of nature and the forest animals and unforgiving when humans enter their domain to alter or destroy them.

statement.id: Patasola biasanya dianggap pelindung alam dan satwa hutan, dan tidak mengampuni manusia yang masuk untuk merusaknya.
statement.en: The Patasola is usually seen as a protector of nature and forest animals, unforgiving toward people who enter to damage them.

basis_claims.quote: is her one leg which terminates in a cleaved bovine-like hoof

statement.id: Kaki tunggalnya berakhir dengan kuku belah seperti kuku sapi.
statement.en: Her single leg ends in a cloven, cow-like hoof.

basis_claims.quote: The sea bishop or bishop-fish is a legendary creature first recorded in the 16th century. According to legend, it was taken to the King of Poland, who wished to keep it. It was also shown to a group of Catholic bishops, to whom the bishop-fish gestured, appealing to be released. They granted its wish, at which point it made the sign of the cross and disappeared into the sea.

statement.id: Uskup laut atau ikan uskup adalah makhluk legendaris yang pertama tercatat pada abad ke-16; menurut legenda ia dibawa kepada Raja Polandia yang ingin memeliharanya, lalu diperlihatkan kepada para uskup Katolik, memberi isyarat minta dilepaskan, dan setelah dibebaskan membuat tanda salib lalu lenyap ke laut.
statement.en: The sea bishop or bishop-fish is a legendary creature first recorded in the 16th century; by legend it was brought to the King of Poland, who wished to keep it, shown to Catholic bishops, gestured to be freed, and once released made the sign of the cross and vanished into the sea.

basis_claims.quote: Another was supposedly captured in the ocean near Germany in 1531. It refused to eat and died after three days. It was described and pictured in the fourth volume of Conrad Gesner's famous Historiae animalium, published in 1551–1558 and 1587.

statement.id: Seekor lagi konon ditangkap di laut dekat Jerman pada 1531, menolak makan, dan mati setelah tiga hari; ia dideskripsikan dan digambar dalam jilid keempat Historiae animalium karya Conrad Gesner (1551–1558 dan 1587).
statement.en: Another was supposedly caught in the sea off Germany in 1531, refused to eat and died after three days; it was described and pictured in volume four of Conrad Gesner's Historiae animalium (1551–1558 and 1587).

basis_claims.quote: 巨大な魚の姿をしているが、尾鰭が脚、胸鰭が鉤爪のついた腕のように発達しており、頭は円錐形。人間のように直立歩行で移動する。

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jepang, ia berwujud ikan besar dengan sirip ekor seperti kaki, sirip dada seperti lengan bercakar, kepala kerucut, dan berjalan tegak seperti manusia.
statement.en: According to the Japanese article, it looks like a huge fish whose tail fin forms legs and pectoral fins clawed arms, with a conical head, walking upright like a man.

basis_claims.quote: The Bisterne Dragon is a legend from the New Forest in England. The story takes place primarily in Bisterne, but also features Burley and Lyndhurst, and is one of the area's most famous pieces of folklore.

statement.id: Naga Bisterne (Bisterne Dragon), legenda New Forest, Inggris (England); Bisterne, Burley, Lyndhurst.
statement.en: Bisterne Dragon, a New Forest legend, England; Bisterne, Burley, Lyndhurst.

basis_claims.quote: The local tradition is that a dragon had his den at Burley Beacon, about 3 miles (4.8 km) east of Bisterne, at Burley. There are several versions of the tale, one being that the creature "flew" every morning to Bisterne, where it would be supplied with milk.

statement.id: Sarang di Burley Beacon, 3 mil timur Bisterne; terbang tiap pagi untuk diberi susu.
statement.en: Den at Burley Beacon, 3 miles east of Bisterne; flew each morning to be given milk.

basis_claims.quote: with the dragon finally dying outside the village of Lyndhurst, his corpse turning into a hill (now known as Boltons Bench)

statement.id: Naga mati di luar Lyndhurst, tubuhnya menjadi bukit Boltons Bench; zirah berlapis kaca.
statement.en: The dragon died outside Lyndhurst, its corpse becoming the hill Boltons Bench; armour covered with glass.

basis_claims.quote: Blue Ben is a legendary dragon from Kilve in western Somerset, England. The skull of a fossilized Ichthyosaur on display in a local museum is sometimes pointed out as belonging to him.

statement.id: Blue Ben, naga legenda dari Kilve, Somerset barat, Inggris (England); tengkorak Ichthyosaur.
statement.en: Blue Ben, a legendary dragon of Kilve, western Somerset, England; an Ichthyosaur skull.

basis_claims.quote: Blue Ben typically dwells in the shale caves along the Somerset coast, regularly bathing in the nearby waters to cool himself after breathing fire.

statement.id: Tinggal di gua serpih pesisir Somerset, berendam setelah menyemburkan api.
statement.en: Dwells in shale caves of the Somerset coast, bathing after breathing fire.

basis_claims.quote: The Devil, who had watched Blue Ben for some time, decided to capture him for use as a mount. The Devil rode the dragon mercilessly through the fires of Hell until the dragon escaped.

statement.en: The bluecap is a fairy or ghost of English folklore living in mines as a small blue flame, leading respectful miners to minerals.

basis_claims.quote: Like knockers or kobolds, bluecaps can also forewarn miners of cave-ins. They are mostly associated with the Anglo-Scottish borders.

basis_claims.quote: The miners would sometimes talk of having seen a flickering bluecap settle on a full tub of coal, transporting it as though "impelled by the sturdiest sinews".

basis_claims.quote: In British folklore and urban legend, British big cats refers to the subject of reported sightings of non-native, wild big cats in the United Kingdom. Many of these creatures have been described as "panthers", "pumas", or "black cats".

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Britania (British folklore), British big cats: penampakan kucing besar liar non-asli di Britania Raya (United Kingdom), panther, puma, black cats.
statement.en: In British folklore, British big cats are reported sightings of non-native wild big cats in the United Kingdom: panthers, pumas, black cats.

basis_claims.quote: The existence of a population of "true big cats" in Britain, however, especially a breeding population, has been rejected by experts and the British government owing to a lack of convincing evidence for the presence of such animals.

statement.id: Populasi kucing besar sejati ditolak ahli dan pemerintah Britania (British government).
statement.en: A population of true big cats is rejected by experts and the British government.

basis_claims.quote: Su existencia no ha sido comprobada, pero existen muchas teorías que intentan explicar cómo estos animales pudieron haber llegado a Gran Bretaña, incluyendo que son animales liberados después de que el Acta de animales salvajes peligrosos de 1976 entrara en vigor, o que son fauna superviviente de La Edad de Hielo.

statement.id: Keberadaannya belum terbukti; teori: dilepas setelah Dangerous Wild Animals Act 1976 atau fauna sisa Zaman Es (Edad de Hielo); Britania Raya (Gran Bretaña).
statement.en: Their existence is unproven; theories: released after the Dangerous Wild Animals Act 1976, or surviving Ice Age (Edad de Hielo) fauna in Great Britain (Gran Bretaña).

basis_claims.quote: A hydrus has no set appearance. Normally it is considered to be a water snake. Other animals the hydrus has been thought of as include a bird, a dragon, and a mongoose.

statement.id: Wujud hydrus tidak tetap; biasanya ia dianggap ular air, tetapi juga digambarkan sebagai burung, naga, atau luwak.
statement.en: The hydrus has no fixed look; it is usually taken to be a water snake, but also shown as a bird, a dragon or a mongoose.

basis_claims.quote: Pliny the Elder described the hydrus as a amphibious serpent with stronger venom than any other snake. He also says that the hydrus' liver can be used as an antidote to its bite.

statement.id: Plinius Tua menggambarkan hydrus sebagai ular amfibi dengan bisa lebih kuat dari ular mana pun, dan hatinya dapat dipakai sebagai penawar gigitannya.
statement.en: Pliny the Elder described the hydrus as an amphibious serpent with venom stronger than any other snake's, whose liver can serve as an antidote to its bite.

basis_claims.quote: They were said to be found in the Nile River. It is said that the hydrus hated crocodiles, and would intentionally roll in the mud and seek out a crocodile while it slept with its mouth open.

statement.id: Hydrus konon hidup di Sungai Nil dan membenci buaya; ia sengaja berguling di lumpur lalu mencari buaya yang tidur dengan mulut terbuka.
statement.en: They were said to live in the Nile and to hate crocodiles; the hydrus would roll in mud on purpose and seek out a crocodile sleeping with its mouth open.

statement.en: Konrul is pictured as a giant bird able to carry off an elephant, a peacock with a dog's head and lion's claws, sometimes with a human face.

basis_claims.quote: In one account a hero rescues Konrul's offspring by killing a serpent that was crawling up the tree to feed upon them. As a reward, Konrul gives him three of her feathers which the hero uses to call her for help by burning them. Later, Konrul carries him to a distant land.

statement.en: In one tale a hero saves Konrul's young by killing a serpent climbing their tree; in reward Konrul gives him three feathers to burn when he needs help, and later carries him to a distant land.

basis_claims.quote: In Armenian and Turkish folklores, the Lake Van Monster (Turkish: Van Gölü Canavarı, Armenian: Վանա լճի հրեշ, romanized: Vana lchi hresh) is a lake monster said to live in Lake Van in eastern Turkey.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Armenia dan Turki, Monster Danau Van (Turki Van Gölü Canavarı, Armenia Vana lchi hresh) adalah monster danau yang konon tinggal di Danau Van, Turki timur.
statement.en: In Armenian and Turkish folklore the Lake Van Monster (Turkish Van Gölü Canavarı, Armenian Vana lchi hresh) is a lake monster said to live in Lake Van in eastern Turkey.

basis_claims.quote: The Armenian chroniclers Movses Khorenatsi and Anania Shirakatsi wrote about vishaps (water dragons in Armenian mythology) living in Lake Van. According to the myth, the god Vahagn, the vishapakagh ("reaper of vishaps"), would plunge into Lake Van to drag out any vishap that had grown large enough to devour the world.

statement.id: Penulis kronik Armenia Movses Khorenatsi dan Anania Shirakatsi menulis tentang vishap (naga air mitologi Armenia) di Danau Van; menurut mitos dewa Vahagn, sang vishapakagh ("penuai vishap"), terjun ke danau untuk menyeret keluar vishap yang cukup besar untuk melahap dunia.
statement.en: The Armenian chroniclers Movses Khorenatsi and Anania Shirakatsi wrote of vishaps (Armenian water dragons) in Lake Van; in myth the god Vahagn, the vishapakagh ("reaper of vishaps"), plunged into the lake to drag out any vishap large enough to devour the world.

basis_claims.quote: Russell writes that into the modern period, the Armenians of the Van basin would refer to the sudden storms that arise on the lake as vishap kami

statement.id: James Russell menulis bahwa hingga zaman modern orang Armenia di lembah Van menyebut badai mendadak di danau itu vishap kami ("angin naga").
statement.en: James Russell writes that into modern times Armenians of the Van basin called the lake's sudden storms vishap kami ("dragon wind").

basis_claims.quote: is a supposed lake monster which in Russian folklore is said to inhabit Lake Brosno near Andreapol in western Russia. It is described as resembling a dragon and is the subject of a number of regional legends, some which are said to date back to the 13th century.

statement.id: Naga Brosno (Brosnya, Бросня) adalah monster danau yang menurut cerita rakyat Rusia menghuni Danau Brosno dekat Andreapol di Rusia barat, digambarkan mirip naga, dan menjadi pokok sejumlah legenda daerah yang sebagian disebut berasal dari abad ke-13.

basis_claims.quote: It was rumored in the 18th and 19th centuries that the giant creature emerged to the lake's surface in the evening, but immediately submerged when people approached.

statement.en: In the 18th and 19th centuries it was rumoured that the giant creature surfaced in the evening but dived at once when people approached.

basis_claims.quote: Согласно легендам и многочисленным заявлениям местных жителей, озеро Бросно — место обитания «дракона», мифического животного. Местные жители периодически говорят, что видели большого ящера или слышали, «как он дышит под водой».

statement.id: Menurut legenda dan banyak pernyataan penduduk setempat, Danau Brosno adalah tempat tinggal "naga", binatang mitis; penduduk kadang mengaku melihat kadal besar atau mendengar "ia bernapas di bawah air".
statement.en: According to legends and many local accounts, Lake Brosno is the home of a "dragon", a mythical animal; locals periodically say they saw a large lizard or heard "it breathing under water".

statement.id: Di Inggris (England) abad pertengahan: beruang seram di hutan; nama dari Inggris Pertengahan bugge, Welsh Kuno bwg, Skots Kuno bogill.
statement.en: In medieval England: a creepy bear in the woods; name from Middle English bugge, Old Welsh bwg, Old Scots bogill.

visual_requirements: One monstrous nonhuman water beast standing on lakeshore at night, with exactly SIX clearly separated thick animal legs arranged THREE per side, exactly one animal head, gnarled DEER ANTLERS and bright BLUE EYES. Whole body unobstructed, three-quarter side view allows counting all six legs. One tail, no second creature, no hidden limbs, no humans.
Loud ferocious nocturnal water terror
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: is a demonic mythical creature in Slavic mythology. Belief in it existed in Syrmia.

statement.id: Bukavac adalah makhluk mitis bersifat iblis dalam mitologi Slavia; kepercayaan kepadanya ada di Syrmia.
statement.en: Bukavac is a demonic mythical creature of Slavic mythology; belief in it existed in Syrmia.

basis_claims.quote: Bukavac was sometimes imagined as a six-legged monster with gnarled horns and bright blue eyes.  It lives in lakes and pools, coming out of the water during the night to make a loud noise (hence the name: buka – noise). It would jump onto people and animals and strangle them.

statement.id: Bukavac kadang dibayangkan sebagai monster berkaki enam bertanduk bengkok dan bermata biru terang; ia tinggal di danau dan kolam, keluar pada malam hari dengan suara gaduh (dari buka, kebisingan), melompat ke manusia dan hewan lalu mencekiknya.
statement.en: Bukavac was sometimes imagined as a six-legged monster with gnarled horns and bright blue eyes; it lives in lakes and pools, comes out at night making a loud noise (buka, noise), and jumps on people and animals to strangle them.

basis_claims.quote: Букавац иногда описывается, как шестиногий монстр с оленьими рогами.

statement.id: Bukavac kadang digambarkan sebagai monster berkaki enam bertanduk rusa.
statement.en: Bukavac is sometimes described as a six-legged monster with deer antlers.

visual_requirements: A monstrous Căpcăun ogre with unmistakable DOG HEAD and long canine muzzle atop a huge hulking nonhuman body, coarse animal fur, large clawed hands, two arms and two legs for the basic variant. Two eyes only for this selected basic form. No ordinary human face, no dog helmet. In Romanian mountain forest, no children or victims.
Cannibal ogre threat without gore
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: A Căpcăun is a creature in Romanian folklore, depicted as an ogre who kidnaps children or young ladies (mostly princesses). It represents evil, as do its counterparts Zmeu and the Balaur.

statement.id: Căpcăun adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Rumania, raksasa pemakan manusia yang menculik anak atau gadis muda, terutama putri raja, dan melambangkan kejahatan seperti Zmeu dan Balaur.
statement.en: The Căpcăun is a creature of Romanian folklore, an ogre who kidnaps children or young ladies, mostly princesses, and embodies evil like the Zmeu and the Balaur.

basis_claims.quote: The Romanian word appears to have meant "Dog-head" (căp being a form of cap, meaning "head", and căun a derivative of câine, "dog"). According to Romanian folkloric phantasy, the căpcăun has a dog head, sometimes with four eyes, with eyes in the nape, or with four legs, but whose main characteristic is anthropophagy.

statement.id: Kata Rumania ini tampaknya berarti "kepala anjing" (căp dari cap, "kepala", dan căun dari câine, "anjing"); căpcăun berkepala anjing, kadang bermata empat, bermata di tengkuk, atau berkaki empat, dan ciri utamanya memakan manusia.
statement.en: The Romanian word seems to mean 'dog-head' (căp from cap, 'head', and căun from câine, 'dog'); the căpcăun has a dog's head, sometimes four eyes, eyes in the nape or four legs, and its main trait is cannibalism.

basis_claims.quote: In most Romanian publications of other European works the names of creatures such as Ogres or Trolls are usually translated as căpcăun.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Rumania karya Eropa lain, nama makhluk seperti ogre atau troll biasanya diterjemahkan sebagai căpcăun.
statement.en: In Romanian translations of other European works, creatures such as ogres or trolls are usually rendered as căpcăun.

visual_requirements: A chort in true form: small hairy monstrous body, two natural HORNS growing from skull, two split CLOVEN HOOVES, skinny visible TAIL. Long animal snout, coarse fur and hooked fingers, not handsome human devil. Full body beside Slavic swamp willow, no red superhero suit, pitchfork or human costume.
Malign cunning trickster demon
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: is an anthropomorphic malign spirit or demon in Slavic folk tradition. Chorts are often depicted identically to Christian devils, with horns, hooves, and a skinny tail. In Slavic mythology, a singular chort is sometimes identified as a son of the god Chernobog and the goddess Mara. In folk Christianity, they are considered lesser minions of Satan.

statement.id: Chort (bahasa Rusia чёрт, bahasa Polandia czart, bahasa Ceko čert) adalah roh jahat atau iblis berwujud manusia dalam tradisi rakyat Slavia, sering digambarkan seperti iblis Kristen dengan tanduk, kuku belah, dan ekor kurus; dalam mitologi Slavia satu chort kadang disebut putra dewa Chernobog dan dewi Mara, dan dalam Kristen rakyat mereka dianggap antek rendahan Iblis (Satan).
statement.en: A chort is an anthropomorphic malign spirit or demon in Slavic folk tradition, often depicted like Christian devils with horns, hooves and a skinny tail; a single chort is sometimes a son of Chernobog and Mara, and in folk Christianity chorts are lesser minions of Satan.

basis_claims.quote: W wierzeniach ludowych czart wyobrażany jest jako chromy. Zamieszkuje bagna, lasy i zbiorniki wodne, objawia się także w wirach powietrznych

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan rakyat, czart dibayangkan pincang; ia tinggal di rawa, hutan, dan perairan, dan juga menampakkan diri dalam pusaran angin.
statement.en: In folk belief the czart is imagined as lame; it lives in swamps, forests and bodies of water, and also appears in whirlwinds.

basis_claims.quote: The true form of Čert is often a smallish hairy man with a tail, horns and one or two hoofs. But he is a shapeshifter and he tries to trick characters in his nicer forms

statement.id: Wujud asli čert sering berupa laki-laki kecil berbulu dengan ekor, tanduk, dan satu atau dua kuku belah, tetapi ia pengubah wujud yang menipu tokoh dengan rupa yang lebih menarik.
statement.en: The true form of the čert is often a smallish hairy man with a tail, horns and one or two hooves, but he is a shapeshifter who tricks characters in nicer forms.

draconcopedes.depicted_variant: Woman-headed great serpent of medieval bestiary
visual_requirements: One immense coiled SERPENT with a human WOMAN HEAD attached directly to its powerful scaled snake neck, fully serpentine body and tapering tail. No human torso, breasts, arms, legs or clothing; use documented maiden-faced dragon-body variant. Medieval forest setting, clearly nonhuman overall shape. No ordinary human portrait or angel wings.
Seductive uncanny medieval beast
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: Vincent of Beauvais (c. 1190–1264) describes this beast as a vast serpentine creature with the head, face and breasts of a woman.

statement.id: Vincent dari Beauvais (sekitar 1190–1264) menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk ular yang sangat besar dengan kepala, wajah, dan dada perempuan.
statement.en: Vincent of Beauvais (c. 1190–1264) describes it as a vast serpentine creature with a woman's head, face and breasts.

basis_claims.quote: Draconcopedes serpentes magni sunt, et potentes, facies virgineas habentes humanis similes, in draconum corpus desinentes

statement.id: Dalam Speculum naturale ia menulis bahwa draconcopedes adalah ular besar dan kuat berwajah gadis seperti manusia yang berujung pada tubuh naga.
statement.en: In the Speculum naturale he writes that draconcopedes are great and powerful serpents with maidenly human-like faces, ending in a dragon's body.

basis_claims.quote: Le dracontopode est un serpent ou un dragon possédant une tête humaine, éventuellement avec un torse et des bras humains, souvent présent dans les bestiaires médiévaux.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, dracontopode adalah ular atau naga berkepala manusia, kadang dengan dada dan lengan manusia, yang sering muncul dalam bestiari abad pertengahan.
statement.en: According to the French article, the dracontopode is a serpent or dragon with a human head, sometimes with a human torso and arms, often found in medieval bestiaries.

basis_claims.quote: Con il termine dracontopode o draconcopode (dal latino dracontopedis, draconcopedis o draconcopodis, letteralmente "dai piedi di drago") si indicava, in epoca medievale, un essere leggendario dal volto umano e dal corpo di serpente

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Italia disebut dracontopode atau draconcopode, dari bahasa Latin dracontopedis, draconcopedis, atau draconcopodis, harfiah "berkaki naga", untuk makhluk legendaris abad pertengahan berwajah manusia dan bertubuh ular.
statement.en: In Italian it is the dracontopode or draconcopode, from Latin dracontopedis, draconcopedis or draconcopodis, literally 'dragon-footed', a medieval legendary being with a human face and a serpent's body.

ichneumon-medieval-zoology.depicted_variant: Medieval Egyptian mongoose ichneumon, mud-armored at rest
visual_requirements: Slender mongoose quadruped
Cracked protective mud armor
Normal snout and one natural tail
Alert brave dragon-enemy aura

basis_claims.quote: In medieval literature, the ichneumon or echinemon was the enemy of the dragon. When it sees a dragon, the ichneumon covers itself with mud, and closing its nostrils with its tail, attacks and kills the dragon.

statement.id: Dalam sastra abad pertengahan, ichneumon atau echinemon adalah musuh naga: ketika melihat naga, ia melumuri diri dengan lumpur, menutup lubang hidungnya dengan ekor, lalu menyerang dan membunuh naga itu.
statement.en: In medieval literature the ichneumon or echinemon was the dragon's enemy: on seeing a dragon it coats itself in mud, closes its nostrils with its tail, and attacks and kills the dragon.

basis_claims.quote: The ichneumon was also considered by some to be the enemy of the crocodile and the asp, and attacks them in the same way. The name was used for the pharaoh's rat, mongoose, or Egyptian mongoose (Herpestes ichneumon), which attacks snakes; it can also mean otter.

statement.id: Sebagian penulis juga menganggapnya musuh buaya dan ular aspis yang diserang dengan cara sama; nama ini dipakai untuk luwak Mesir (Herpestes ichneumon) yang menyerang ular, dan juga dapat berarti berang-berang.
statement.en: Some also thought it the enemy of the crocodile and the asp, attacking them the same way; the name was used for the Egyptian mongoose (Herpestes ichneumon), which attacks snakes, and can also mean otter.

basis_claims.quote: The ichneumon is shaped similarly to a ferret, although much slimmer in its shape, and the head is elongated. Also, it is an animal that can move swiftly and is able to jump a couple of yards with a single leap.

statement.id: Bentuknya mirip musang ferret tetapi jauh lebih ramping dengan kepala memanjang, bergerak cepat dan dapat melompat beberapa meter sekali loncat.
statement.en: It is shaped like a ferret but much slimmer, with an elongated head, moves swiftly and can leap a couple of yards in one bound.

visual_requirements: Snail-like serpent body with giant spiral shell
Long hairy grasping tentacles
Slimy cave creature beneath Hastingues
Predatory ambusher terror

basis_claims.quote: Lou Carcolh, or the Carcolh, is a mythical beast from French folklore. It is described as a large, slimy, snail-like serpent with hairy tentacles and a large shell. It is said to live in a cavern beneath Hastingues, a town in the Les Landes region in southwestern France.

statement.id: Lou Carcolh adalah binatang mitis cerita rakyat Prancis berupa ular mirip siput yang besar dan berlendir, bertentakel berbulu dan bercangkang besar, yang konon tinggal di gua di bawah Hastingues, Landes, Prancis barat daya.
statement.en: Lou Carcolh is a mythical beast of French folklore, a large, slimy, snail-like serpent with hairy tentacles and a big shell, said to live in a cave beneath Hastingues in the Landes, south-west France.

basis_claims.quote: It is described to have a slime that could sometimes be seen long before the creature itself arrived, and its tentacles had a great reach that would be used to grab and drag prey into its cave without leaving.

statement.id: Lendirnya kadang terlihat jauh sebelum makhluk itu tiba, dan tentakelnya yang sangat panjang dipakai untuk meraih dan menyeret mangsa ke guanya tanpa ia keluar.
statement.en: Its slime could sometimes be seen long before it arrived, and its long-reaching tentacles grabbed prey and dragged it into its cave without its leaving.

basis_claims.quote: Concernant le Carcolh, la Revue de Gascogne de 1903 évoque un ... Escargot monstrueux qui a son gîte dans une vaste et sombre caverne au-dessus de laquelle est bâtie, d'après les traditions, la ville de Hastingues.

statement.id: Revue de Gascogne tahun 1903 menyebut siput raksasa yang tinggal di gua besar dan gelap yang di atasnya, menurut tradisi, berdiri kota Hastingues.
statement.en: The Revue de Gascogne of 1903 mentions a monstrous snail living in a vast, dark cave over which, by tradition, the town of Hastingues is built.

basis_claims.quote: Также считается, что солнечный свет пугает улитку, поэтому она не показывается на поверхности.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Rusia menyebut cahaya matahari menakutkan siput ini sehingga ia tidak muncul ke permukaan.
statement.en: The Russian article says sunlight frightens the snail, so it never comes to the surface.

lusca.depicted_variant: Documented colossal octopus Lusca, not composite shark/dragon variant
visual_requirements: One colossal octopus variant
Large mantle animal eyes and sucker-lined arms
Andros blue hole cave
Dangerous sea-monster mystery

basis_claims.quote: In Caribbean folklore, the Lusca is a name given to an alleged sea monster said to exist in the region of the blue holes nearby Andros, an island in The Bahamas.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Karibia, Lusca adalah monster laut yang konon hidup di kawasan blue hole dekat Andros, sebuah pulau di Bahama.
statement.en: In Caribbean folklore the Lusca is a sea monster said to live around the blue holes near Andros, an island in the Bahamas.

basis_claims.quote: The first reported sighting of something resembling the traditional description of the Lusca in the area was in 1872, when J. S. George of Nassau in the Bahamas wrote to the American Naturalist describing a "colossal octopus" found dead on the beach.

statement.id: Laporan pertama yang mirip gambaran Lusca muncul pada 1872, ketika J. S. George dari Nassau menulis ke American Naturalist tentang "gurita raksasa" yang ditemukan mati di pantai.
statement.en: The first report resembling the Lusca came in 1872, when J. S. George of Nassau wrote to the American Naturalist about a "colossal octopus" found dead on the beach.

basis_claims.quote: It is described as a giant octopus, a giant cuttlefish, or a half shark, half octopus.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai gurita raksasa, sotong raksasa, atau setengah hiu setengah gurita.
statement.en: It is described as a giant octopus, a giant cuttlefish, or half shark, half octopus.

visual_requirements: Spotted leopardlike feline bestiary animal
Mottled coat
Bloodthirsty demonic predatory presence

basis_claims.quote: Pard (Ancient Greek: πάρδος) is the Ancient Greek word for the leopard, which is listed in medieval bestiaries and in Pliny the Elder's book Natural History.

statement.id: Pard (Yunani Kuno: πάρδος) adalah kata Yunani Kuno untuk macan tutul, yang tercantum dalam bestiari abad pertengahan dan Naturalis Historia karya Plinius Tua.
statement.en: Pard (Ancient Greek πάρδος) is the Ancient Greek word for the leopard, listed in medieval bestiaries and in Pliny the Elder's Natural History.

basis_claims.quote: In the seventh-century book Etymologies, Isidore of Seville describes their coats as being mottled like a giraffe's. He goes on to describe them as being "headlong for blood" by being capable of killing their prey in a single leap.

statement.id: Dalam Etymologiae abad ke-7, Isidorus dari Sevilla menggambarkan bulunya berbintik seperti jerapah dan menyebutnya haus darah karena dapat membunuh mangsa dalam satu lompatan.
statement.en: In the 7th-century Etymologies, Isidore of Seville describes their coats as mottled like a giraffe's and calls them 'headlong for blood', able to kill prey in one leap.

basis_claims.quote: It was not until the 13th century that pards acquired their mythical reputation for being bloodthirsty and almost demonic creatures, primarily thanks to the MS Bodley 764 Bestiary. In this source, their spots were said to symbolize sins, the devil, or even the variety of vices in mankind.

statement.id: Baru pada abad ke-13 pard mendapat reputasi mitis sebagai makhluk haus darah yang hampir iblis, terutama berkat Bestiari MS Bodley 764, yang menyebut bintik-bintiknya melambangkan dosa, iblis, atau aneka kebejatan manusia.
statement.en: Only in the 13th century did pards gain their mythic reputation as bloodthirsty, almost demonic creatures, chiefly through the MS Bodley 764 Bestiary, in which their spots symbolised sins, the devil or the many vices of mankind.

basis_claims.quote: El pardus es un animal de los bestiarios medievales. Fueron felinos con pelaje manchado y eran extremadamente rápidos (lo que recuerda a un guepardo). Se creía que se apareaban con los leones para producir leopardos.

statement.id: Pardus adalah hewan bestiari abad pertengahan, kucing besar berbulu bintik yang sangat cepat, yang dipercaya kawin dengan singa untuk menghasilkan leopard.
statement.en: The pardus is an animal of medieval bestiaries, a spotted, extremely fast feline believed to mate with lions to produce leopards.

visual_requirements: Original wingless scaly four-legged underwater-panther creature
Humanlike face and long fish-finned tail
Multicolour historic mural interpretation
No later invented bird wings

basis_claims.quote: is a later name applied to the creature[s] from Native American mythology depicted in a mural painted by Native Americans high on cliffsides above the Mississippi River.

statement.id: Piasa adalah nama belakangan untuk makhluk mitologi penduduk asli Amerika yang dilukis pada mural tinggi di tebing di atas Sungai Mississippi.
statement.en: Piasa is a later name for the creature(s) of Native American mythology shown in a mural painted high on cliffs above the Mississippi River.

basis_claims.quote: Its original location was at the end of a chain of limestone bluffs in Madison County, Illinois, at present-day Alton, Illinois.

statement.id: Lokasi aslinya di ujung deretan tebing kapur di Madison County, kini Alton, Illinois.
statement.en: Its original site was at the end of a chain of limestone bluffs in Madison County, at present-day Alton, Illinois.

basis_claims.quote: The original petrographs were described by French explorers Marquette and Louis Jolliet (1673) and described as a multicolored human-faced creature with a long tail terminating in fish-like fin.

statement.id: Lukisan aslinya digambarkan penjelajah Prancis Marquette dan Louis Jolliet (1673) sebagai makhluk berwajah manusia, berwarna-warni, dengan ekor panjang bersirip ikan.
statement.en: French explorers Marquette and Louis Jolliet (1673) described the original paintings as a multicoloured human-faced creature with a long fish-finned tail.

basis_claims.quote: Contemporary sketch of one of the beasts, which is wingless (and matching the description of a scaly quadruped with a man-like face and a long tail terminating in fishlike fins) is identifiable as the underwater panther type.

statement.id: Sketsa sezaman menunjukkan makhluk tanpa sayap, berkaki empat dan bersisik, yang dapat dikenali sebagai jenis panter bawah air.
statement.en: A contemporary sketch shows a wingless, scaly four-legged beast identifiable as the underwater panther type.

basis_claims.quote: deeming the attached legend of the chieftain Ouatoga (who fended his tribe from the bird, protected by a divine invisible shield) to be fakelore, i.e., a piece of fiction by John Russell (1836, 1848)

statement.id: Para ahli folklor menganggap legenda kepala suku Ouatoga yang melawan burung itu sebagai cerita rakyat palsu karangan John Russell (1836, 1848).
statement.en: Folklorists consider the legend of chieftain Ouatoga fighting the bird to be fakelore invented by John Russell (1836, 1848).

basis_claims.quote: The mural has been restored with replicas a number of times in the 20th century

statement.id: Pada abad ke-20 mural ini beberapa kali dipulihkan dengan replika.
statement.en: The mural was restored with replicas several times in the 20th century.

visual_requirements: A grotesque swamp demon whose entire visible body is covered in DENSE COARSE ANIMAL HAIR, with distorted animalistic broad face and large shaggy limbs, long straight head hair, source-described red cap with fern twig. Nonhuman monstrous silhouette, modest wrapped cloth covers chest. Wading by river thickets, no human baby, no conventional beautiful woman or costume-only fur coat.
Malicious wild swamp menace
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: Dziwożona (or Mamuna or Boginka) is a female swamp demon in Slavic mythology known for being malicious and dangerous. Most at risk of becoming one of these demons after death were thought to be midwives, old maids, unmarried mothers, pregnant women who die before childbirth, as well as abandoned children born out of wedlock.

statement.id: Dziwożona (juga Mamuna atau Boginka) adalah demon rawa perempuan dalam mitologi Slavia yang jahat dan berbahaya; yang paling berisiko menjadi demon ini setelah mati adalah bidan, perawan tua, ibu yang tidak menikah, perempuan hamil yang meninggal sebelum melahirkan, dan anak haram yang ditelantarkan.
statement.en: Dziwożona (or Mamuna or Boginka) is a malicious, dangerous female swamp demon of Slavic mythology; those thought most likely to become one after death were midwives, old maids, unmarried mothers, pregnant women who died before childbirth, and abandoned children born out of wedlock.

basis_claims.quote: Dziwożona was said to live in thickets near rivers, streams and lakes. According to some, she took the form of an ugly, old woman with a hairy body, long straight hair and breasts so huge that she used them to wash her clothes. On her head she wore a red hat with a fern twig attached to it.

statement.id: Dziwożona konon tinggal di semak dekat sungai, anak sungai, dan danau; menurut sebagian orang ia berwujud perempuan tua buruk rupa bertubuh berbulu, berambut panjang lurus, dan berpayudara begitu besar hingga dipakai mencuci pakaian, serta memakai topi merah berhias ranting pakis.
statement.en: Dziwożona was said to live in thickets near rivers, streams and lakes; some said she was an ugly old woman with a hairy body, long straight hair and breasts so huge she used them to wash her clothes, wearing a red hat with a fern twig.

basis_claims.quote: Dziwożona was said to kidnap human babies just after they were born and replace them with her own children, known as foundlings or changelings.

statement.id: Dziwożona konon menculik bayi manusia segera setelah lahir dan menggantinya dengan anaknya sendiri, yang disebut anak tukaran (changeling).
statement.en: Dziwożona was said to kidnap human babies right after birth and replace them with her own children, known as changelings.

visual_requirements: An immense destructive WHIRLWIND moving through an Estonian field and visibly lifting loose hay from a haystack. Its form is wind and dust only, coherent spiraling funnel rooted at ground and rising skyward. No person, human face, eyes, arms, monster silhouette or invented anthropomorphic body.
Destructive uncanny wild wind
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: Ebajalg (whirlwind) is a being found in Estonian mythology. It is a whirlwind, believed to be a malicious spirit or demon. They are described as having great strength, often leading to destruction.

statement.id: Ebajalg (angin puting) adalah makhluk dalam mitologi Estonia, berupa pusaran angin yang dipercaya sebagai roh atau iblis jahat; digambarkan sangat kuat dan sering merusak.
statement.en: Ebajalg (whirlwind) is a being of Estonian mythology, a whirlwind believed to be a malicious spirit or demon, described as very strong and often destructive.

basis_claims.quote: Tuulispask (ka vihur või ebajalg) on rahvapärane nimetus maismaa kohal liikuva tugeva tuulekeerise kohta.

statement.id: Tuulispask (juga vihur atau ebajalg) adalah nama rakyat untuk pusaran angin kuat yang bergerak di atas daratan.
statement.en: Tuulispask (also vihur or ebajalg) is the folk name for a strong whirlwind moving over land.

basis_claims.quote: Tuulispask võis olla ka nõia tehtud või saadetud olevus, setudel kurat, selle poeg või ema. Uskumuse järgi viis ta võõrastelt põldudelt ära vilja, heina jms, kuid võis ära viia ka õnne, tuua haigust ja teha muud halba.

statement.id: Pusaran angin juga bisa makhluk yang dibuat atau dikirim penyihir; di kalangan Seto ia iblis, anaknya, atau ibunya; ia membawa pergi gandum dan jerami dari ladang orang lain, juga keberuntungan, membawa penyakit, dan berbuat jahat lainnya.
statement.en: The whirlwind could also be a being made or sent by a witch; among the Seto it was the devil, his son or mother; it carried off grain and hay from others' fields, also luck, brought illness and did other harm.

basis_claims.quote: Lõuna pool nimetatakse tuulispaska ka ebajalaks. Ebajalg avaldab iseäranis suurt jõudu, viib isegi heinasaod ja -kuhjad kaasa.

statement.id: Menurut Matthias Johann Eisen, di selatan tuulispask disebut juga ebajalg; ebajalg menunjukkan kekuatan sangat besar, bahkan membawa pergi tumpukan jerami.
statement.en: According to Matthias Johann Eisen, in the south the tuulispask is also called ebajalg; the ebajalg shows great strength, even carrying off haystacks.

visual_requirements: A strange small forest creature with a gigantic OPEN WIDE MOUTH, disproportionately large predatory jaws, LONG CLAWS and body naturally covered in grass-like growth rather than clothing. Leaves wrapped modestly around torso. Beside hollow tree in Congo rainforest, one small brass bell in hand. Not a human dwarf portrait or person wearing grass costume.
Enchanted predatory forest menace
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: Eloko (pl. Biloko) is a term in a Mongo-Nkundo language referring to a kind of dwarf-like creature that lives in the forests. They are believed to be the spirits of ancestors of the people living there.

statement.id: Eloko (jamak Biloko), makhluk mirip kurcaci dalam bahasa Mongo-Nkundo, tinggal di hutan; roh leluhur.
statement.en: Eloko (pl. Biloko), a dwarf-like forest creature in a Mongo-Nkundo language; ancestral spirits.

basis_claims.quote: Biloko live in the densest and darkest part of the rain forest in central Zaïre, jealously and ferociously guarding their treasures: the game and the rare fruits of the forest.

statement.id: Hutan hujan Zaïre tengah (Kongo, Afrika); menjaga hewan buruan dan buah langka; dendam pada orang hidup.
statement.en: Rainforest of central Zaïre (Congo, Africa); guard game and rare fruits; grudge against the living.

basis_claims.quote: The Biloko live in hollow trees and are dressed only in leaves. They have no hair; only grass grows on their bodies; they have piercing eyes, snouts with mouths that can be opened wide enough to admit a human body

statement.id: Tinggal di pohon berongga, berpakaian daun, berumput, bermulut lebar, bercakar panjang.
statement.en: Live in hollow trees, dressed in leaves, grass-covered, wide mouths, long claws.

basis_claims.quote: They possess little bells, which, in Central Africa are believed to be able to cast a spell on passers-by. Possessing an amulet or a fetish can offer protection from this type of magic.

statement.id: Lonceng kecil penyihir di Afrika Tengah (Central Africa); jimat melindungi.
statement.en: Little bells that enchant in Central Africa; amulets protect.

goldhorn.depicted_variant: White Alpine chamois with golden horns
visual_requirements: A single WHITE Alpine CHAMOIS buck with TWO SHINING GOLDEN HORNS, four goatlike hooves, short chamois tail, no wings. Standing on Mount Triglav above Alpine mountain flowers. Recognizable chamois rather than deer with branched antlers or ordinary human god.
Proud sacred mountain guardian
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary white chamois buck, or alternatively, an Alpine ibex, that had his realm in the heights of Mount Triglav, the highest mountain in Slovenia and the highest peak of the Julian Alps.

statement.id: Goldhorn adalah chamois jantan putih legendaris, atau menurut versi lain ibex Alpen, yang wilayahnya di ketinggian Gunung Triglav, gunung tertinggi di Slovenia dan puncak tertinggi Alpen Julian.
statement.en: Goldhorn is a legendary white chamois buck, or alternatively an Alpine ibex, whose realm was the heights of Mount Triglav, Slovenia's highest mountain and the highest peak of the Julian Alps.

basis_claims.quote: Goldhorn's golden horns were the key to a treasure hidden in the mountains around Triglav.
basis_claims.locator: Summary of the story as written by Karl Deschmann

statement.id: Tanduk emas Goldhorn adalah kunci menuju harta yang tersembunyi di pegunungan sekitar Triglav.
statement.en: Goldhorn's golden horns were the key to a treasure hidden in the mountains around Triglav.

basis_claims.quote: The green hunter forced him on to catch the Goldhorn before it ate the magic Triglav flowers that grew from its blood, but it was too late. The Goldhorn had already eaten one and the flower gave it tremendous life power.
basis_claims.locator: Summary of the story as written by Karl Deschmann

statement.id: Pemburu hijau mendesaknya menangkap Goldhorn sebelum hewan itu memakan bunga ajaib Triglav yang tumbuh dari darahnya, tetapi terlambat: Goldhorn sudah memakan satu dan bunga itu memberinya daya hidup yang luar biasa.
statement.en: The green hunter pushed him to catch Goldhorn before it ate the magic Triglav flowers growing from its blood, but too late: Goldhorn had eaten one, gaining tremendous life power.

basis_claims.quote: Er hatte goldene Hörner, besaß hoch oben am Triglav einen Garten und war Hüter eines verborgenen Schatzes.

statement.id: Ia bertanduk emas, memiliki taman tinggi di Triglav, dan menjadi penjaga harta tersembunyi.
statement.en: He had golden horns, owned a garden high on Triglav and was guardian of a hidden treasure.

visual_requirements: A grotesque Guajona monster under a ragged black cloak, thin gnarled hands, yellow warted hairy monstrous face, tiny bright eyes, strongly HOOKED NOSE. Exactly ONE very long sharp BLACK TOOTH extends from mouth below chin. Bottom of cloak exposes unmistakable TWO BIRD FEET with long talons, no human feet or shoes. Quiet doorway at night, no victims, no blood.
Stealthy frightening nocturnal vampire
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: La Guajona o Lumia es un monstruo mitológico de la tradición oral de Cantabria.

statement.id: Guajona atau Lumia adalah monster mitologis dari tradisi lisan Cantabria.
statement.en: The Guajona or Lumia is a mythological monster of the oral tradition of Cantabria.

basis_claims.quote: La creencia estima que es una vieja delgada tapada de la cabeza a los pies con un manto negro; sus manos son sarmentosas y los pies patas de ave; su cara es amarilla, consumida, rugosa, peluda y con verrugas; sus ojos son diminutos y brillantes como estrellas

statement.id: Ia nenek kurus yang tertutup jubah hitam dari kepala sampai kaki, bertangan kurus berbonggol dan berkaki burung, berwajah kuning, kisut, berbulu, dan berkutil, bermata kecil berkilau seperti bintang.
statement.en: She is a thin old woman covered head to foot in a black cloak, with gnarled hands and bird's feet, a yellow, wasted, wrinkled, hairy, warty face, and tiny eyes bright as stars.

basis_claims.quote: la nariz aquilina y la boca provista de un único diente negro, largo y afilado que le llega hasta debajo de la barbilla y utiliza para sorber sangre.

statement.id: Hidungnya bengkok dan mulutnya bergigi tunggal hitam, panjang, dan tajam sampai ke bawah dagu, yang dipakai untuk mengisap darah.
statement.en: Her nose is hooked and her mouth holds a single long, sharp black tooth reaching below her chin, used to suck blood.

basis_claims.quote: Sólo sale de noche ocultándose entre las sombras y se desconoce dónde duerme de día, aunque se sospecha que se esconde bajo tierra.

statement.id: Ia hanya keluar pada malam hari, bersembunyi dalam bayangan, dan tidak diketahui di mana ia tidur pada siang hari, meski diduga bersembunyi di bawah tanah.
statement.en: She only comes out at night, hiding in the shadows; where she sleeps by day is unknown, though she is thought to hide underground.

visual_requirements: A single completely AVIAN bird perched in ancient German forest at night, plumage softly glowing like embers and a fallen luminous feather lighting the dark path below. Two bird legs and wings, one bird head, no human component. Feathers emit light but are not burning; no human spirit, flaming phoenix or magical runes.
Gentle luminous bestiary wonder
Creature-specific anatomy is clearly visible; no ordinary human dramatic portrait

basis_claims.quote: Hercinia is a legendary bird with glowing feathers that inhabited the Hercynian Forest of ancient Germany.

statement.id: Hercinia adalah burung legendaris berbulu bercahaya yang menghuni Hutan Hercynia di Germania kuno.
statement.en: The hercinia is a legendary bird with glowing feathers that lived in the Hercynian Forest of ancient Germany.

basis_claims.quote: The hercinia is depicted in Medieval bestiaries and was recorded in the 1st century by Pliny the Elder, who wrote, "In the Hercynian Forest, in Germany, we hear of a singular kind of bird, the feathers of which shine at night like fire".

statement.id: Hercinia digambarkan dalam bestiari Abad Pertengahan dan dicatat pada abad ke-1 oleh Plinius Tua: "Di Hutan Hercynia, di Germania, terdengar kabar tentang sejenis burung aneh yang bulunya bersinar seperti api pada malam hari."
statement.en: The hercinia appears in Medieval bestiaries and was recorded in the 1st century by Pliny the Elder: 'In the Hercynian Forest, in Germany, we hear of a singular kind of bird, the feathers of which shine at night like fire.'

basis_claims.quote: Writing in the 7th century, Isidore of Seville notes, "Their feathers sparkle so much in the shade that, however dark the night is with thick shadows, these feathers, when placed on the ground, give off light that helps to mark the way, and the sign of the glittering feathers makes clear the direction of the path".

statement.id: Pada abad ke-7 Isidorus dari Sevilla menulis bahwa bulunya begitu berkilau sehingga, segelap apa pun malam, bulu yang diletakkan di tanah memancarkan cahaya penunjuk jalan.
statement.en: Writing in the 7th century, Isidore of Seville notes that its feathers sparkle so that, however dark the night, feathers laid on the ground give off light that marks the path.

basis_claims.quote: Ellos se encontraban en el bosque Hercínico, en el sur de Alemania, donde sus plumas brillantes mantenían sendas encendidas en la espesura del bosque.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, burung-burung ini tinggal di Hutan Hercynia di Jerman selatan, tempat bulu bercahayanya menerangi jalan setapak di hutan lebat.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, they lived in the Hercynian Forest in southern Germany, where their glowing feathers lit the paths through the thick forest.

kulshedra.depicted_variant: Seven-headed Albanian female serpent-dragon with pendulous nonhuman mammary lobes
visual_requirements: Seven serpent heads on one body
Nonhuman pendulous mammary chest lobes
Fire and storm/spring context
Dark oppressive evil

basis_claims.quote: is a water, storm, fire and chthonic demon in Albanian mythology and folklore, usually described as a huge multi-headed female serpentine dragon. She is the archetype of darkness  and evil, the complementary and opposing force to drangue ... The kulshedra is believed to spit fire, cause drought, storms, flooding, earthquakes and other natural disasters against mankind.

statement.id: Kulshedra atau kuçedra adalah iblis air, badai, api, dan dunia bawah dalam mitologi Albania, biasanya naga ular betina raksasa berkepala banyak; arketipe kegelapan dan kejahatan, lawan drangue; dipercaya menyemburkan api dan menimbulkan kekeringan, badai, banjir, gempa, dan bencana lain.
statement.en: The kulshedra or kuçedra is a water, storm, fire and chthonic demon of Albanian myth, usually a huge many-headed female serpent-dragon; archetype of darkness and evil opposing the drangue; believed to spit fire and cause drought, storms, floods, earthquakes and other disasters.

basis_claims.quote: Kulshedra is generally considered to be a female dragon, like a multi-headed serpent form, but it is known to have pendulous drooping breasts touching the ground

statement.id: Kulshedra umumnya dianggap naga betina berwujud ular berkepala banyak dengan payudara menjuntai sampai ke tanah, berbulu merah, berekor panjang, dan berkepala tujuh sampai dua belas.
statement.en: The kulshedra is generally a female dragon like a many-headed serpent with drooping breasts touching the ground, red woolly hair, a long tail and seven to twelve heads.

basis_claims.quote: Kuçedra ose kulshedra është një figurë mitologjike e përrallave dhe miteve popullore shqiptare që përfytyrohej herë si një gjarpër i madh me 7 ose 12 koka, apo një dragua me shumë koka e me këmbë që zakonisht zinte burimet e ujit dhe hante njerëzit që i afroheshin burimeve.

statement.id: Kuçedra atau kulshedra adalah tokoh mitologis dongeng dan mitos rakyat Albania yang dibayangkan sebagai ular besar berkepala 7 atau 12 (tujuh, dua belas), atau naga berkepala banyak berkaki yang biasanya menguasai mata air dan memakan orang yang mendekat.
statement.en: Kuçedra or kulshedra is a mythological figure of Albanian folk tales and myths imagined as a great snake with 7 or 12 heads, or a many-headed legged dragon who usually seized water springs and ate people approaching them.

visual_requirements: Crowned dark-haired maiden head
Striped beast body
Four elephant-like legs ending in snake mouths
Dragon tail ending in snake mouth

basis_claims.quote: Meduza (Russian: Медуза), Meluza (Russian: Мелуза, literally "small", "little") or Meluzina (Russian: Мелузина) is a mythical creature in Russian folklore. She was depicted in a Russian lubok of the 17th or 18th century. She is described as half-woman, half-snake, or as the half-woman, half-fish creature. She is also said to be the deity of deception.

statement.id: Meduza (Медуза), Meluza (harfiah "kecil") atau Meluzina adalah makhluk mitis cerita rakyat Rusia yang digambarkan pada lubok Rusia abad ke-17 atau ke-18 sebagai setengah perempuan setengah ular atau ikan, dan disebut dewi tipu daya.
statement.en: Meduza (Медуза), Meluza (literally "little") or Meluzina is a mythical creature of Russian folklore depicted in a 17th- or 18th-century Russian lubok as half woman, half snake or fish, and said to be the deity of deception.

basis_claims.quote: She is represented as a sea monster with the head of a beautiful dark-haired maiden, having the body and belly of a striped beast, a dragon tail with a snake's mouth at the end, and legs resembling those of an elephant with the same snake mouths at the end. She also wears a crown.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai monster laut berkepala gadis cantik berambut gelap, bertubuh binatang belang, berekor naga dengan mulut ular di ujung, berkaki seperti gajah dengan mulut ular di ujungnya, dan bermahkota.
statement.en: She is shown as a sea monster with a beautiful dark-haired maiden's head, a striped beast's body, a dragon tail ending in a snake mouth, elephant-like legs ending in snake mouths, and a crown.

basis_claims.quote: According to belief, her snake mouths contained a deadly dragon poison. She was said to live in the Sea near the Ethiopian abyss, or in the Western Ocean.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan, mulut-mulut ularnya mengandung racun naga yang mematikan; ia tinggal di laut dekat jurang Ethiopia atau di Samudra Barat.
statement.en: According to belief her snake mouths held deadly dragon poison; she lived in the sea near the Ethiopian abyss or in the Western Ocean.

visual_requirements: One Catalan MULADONA clearly a FOUR LEGGED MULE with a WOMAN HEAD and long womanlike hair mane instead of ordinary equine head. basis_claims.quote: In Catalan mythology, a Muladona or Donamula (mule-woman or woman-mule in Catalan) is a female mule with a human woman's head. Legend has it that a young woman was cursed by the townspeople for being irreverent and irreligious, and the curse turned her into a mule.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Katalan, Muladona atau Donamula ("bagal-perempuan") adalah bagal betina berkepala perempuan; menurut legenda, seorang gadis yang tidak hormat dan tidak beragama dikutuk warga desanya menjadi bagal.
statement.en: In Catalan mythology the Muladona or Donamula ('mule-woman') is a female mule with a woman's head; by legend a young woman cursed by her townsfolk for being irreverent and irreligious was turned into a mule.

basis_claims.quote: According to legend, she wandered mountains, especially at night, joining mule trains. It was claimed that mules were frightened by her presence enough to stampede into ravines and die.

statement.id: Ia berkeliaran di pegunungan, terutama malam hari, dan bergabung dengan rombongan bagal, yang ketakutan hingga berlari ke jurang dan mati.
statement.en: She roamed the mountains, especially at night, joining mule trains, whose mules were so frightened they stampeded into ravines and died.

basis_claims.quote: The Muladona looks like a mule, but it is a mixture of human and animal, its mane is like a woman's hair and its face, while still appearing to be like that of an animal, is obviously human.

statement.id: Muladona tampak seperti bagal tetapi campuran manusia dan hewan: surainya seperti rambut perempuan dan wajahnya, walau seperti hewan, jelas manusia.
statement.en: The Muladona looks like a mule but is a mix of human and animal: her mane is like a woman's hair, and her face, though animal-like, is clearly human.

basis_claims.quote: It is always represented with the four legs of a mule, but sometimes the front two legs join a thorax, located where a mule would have its neck. In addition, the animal is always represented with breasts to underline that it is female.

statement.id: Ia selalu digambarkan berkaki empat bagal, kadang dengan kaki depan menyatu pada dada manusia di tempat leher bagal, dan selalu berpayudara untuk menegaskan bahwa ia perempuan.
statement.en: She is always shown with a mule's four legs, sometimes with the front legs joined to a chest where a mule's neck would be, and always with breasts to stress she is female.

basis_claims.quote: Nekomata (ねこまた) are Japanese yōkai said to have transformed from old and large cats.

statement.id: Nekomata adalah yōkai Jepang yang menurut cerita berasal dari kucing tua atau besar.
statement.en: Nekomata are Japanese yōkai said to transform from old or large cats.

basis_claims.quote: their tails split down the middle into two identical tails.

statement.id: Ekor nekomata digambarkan terbelah menjadi dua.
statement.en: Nekomata tails are depicted as splitting in two.

basis_claims.quote: speaking human languages as well as walking on their rear legs, causing mischief.

statement.id: Nekomata dikisahkan dapat berbicara, berjalan pada kaki belakang, dan mengganggu orang.
statement.en: Nekomata are said to speak, walk on their hind legs, and cause mischief.

basis_claims.quote: One sign of this, evidently, was dancing madly on two legs—this is how the nekomata is depicted in Toriyama Sekien’s Gazu hyakki yagyō

statement.id: Seni Toriyama Sekien menggambarkan nekomata menari dengan dua kaki.
statement.en: Toriyama Sekien’s art depicts nekomata dancing on two legs.

basis_claims.quote: 'great' and péist 'worm, fabulous beast, monster, reptile') is a sea serpent or dragon-like monster in Irish mythology and folklore.

statement.id: Oilliphéist (oll besar, péist cacing/monster) ular laut atau monster mirip naga mitologi Irlandia (Irish); di Irlandia.
statement.en: The Oilliphéist (oll great, péist worm/monster) is a sea serpent or dragon-like monster of Irish mythology.

basis_claims.quote: These monsters were believed to inhabit many lakes and rivers in Ireland and there are many legends of saints and heroes fighting them. One story has a girl named Sionnan, grand daughter of Manannán mac Lir, angered the Salmon of Knowledge by throwing stones at it.

statement.id: Menghuni danau dan sungai Irlandia (Ireland); Sionnan cucu Manannán mac Lir membuat marah Salmon of Knowledge.
statement.en: They live in Irish lakes and rivers; Sionnan, granddaughter of Manannán mac Lir, angered the Salmon of Knowledge.

basis_claims.quote: In one story, an Oilliphéist cuts the route of the River Shannon (as well as adjacent lakes) when it hears that Saint Patrick has come to drive out it and its kind. It started its journey in Shannon Pot, then carved out Lough Allen.

statement.id: Oilliphéist mengukir Sungai Shannon (River Shannon) saat Santo Patrick (Saint Patrick) datang; dari Shannon Pot, membentuk Lough Allen.
statement.en: An Oilliphéist carves the River Shannon when Saint Patrick comes; from Shannon Pot it carves Lough Allen.

pillywiggin.depicted_variant: Centimetre-scale spring-flower fairy with butterfly wings
visual_requirements: Tiny winged flora guardian
Actual butterfly wings integrated into back
Spring flowers and dew
Quiet benevolent plant-guardian aura

basis_claims.quote: Pillywiggins are tiny goblins and fairies, guardians of the flora, mentioned in English and Irish folklore. Tiny in size, they have the antennae and wings of a butterfly or dragonfly, live in groups and spend their time frolicking among the flowers.

statement.id: Pillywiggin, goblin dan peri mungil penjaga tumbuhan, folklor Inggris (English) dan Irlandia (Irish); sayap kupu-kupu atau capung; berkelompok di antara bunga.
statement.en: Pillywiggins, tiny goblins and fairies guarding flora, English and Irish folklore; butterfly or dragonfly wings; in groups among flowers.

basis_claims.quote: Pillywiggins are fairies from English folklore, associated with spring flowers and personifying the "divine essence of plants".

statement.id: Terkait bunga musim semi; esensi ilahi tumbuhan.
statement.en: Linked to spring flowers; the divine essence of plants.

basis_claims.quote: The name "Pillywiggin" appeared in 1977 in the American Nancy Arrowsmith's Field Guide to the Little People, who believes that the name of these creatures comes from the English county of Dorset.

statement.id: Nama Pillywiggin muncul 1977 dalam Field Guide to the Little People karya Nancy Arrowsmith; dari Dorset.
statement.en: The name Pillywiggin appeared in 1977 in Nancy Arrowsmith's Field Guide to the Little People; from Dorset.

basis_claims.quote: Winged, they usually measure a centimetre, but can change size. Their food consists of dew and pollen. They are trooping fairies, creatures that live in groups.

statement.id: Bersayap, satu sentimeter, dapat berubah ukuran; makan embun dan serbuk sari; ikut pesta pernikahan; tidak mengerjai manusia.
statement.en: Winged, a centimetre long, can change size; eat dew and pollen; join weddings; no tricks on humans.

visual_requirements: Dog head with one forehead eye
Iron teeth
Human torso and arms with two horse legs
Dark gem-rich cave and predatory aura

basis_claims.quote: (Serbian Cyrillic: Псоглав , literally "doghead") is a demonic mythical creature in Balkan mythology; belief about it existed in parts of Bosnia and Montenegro. Psoglav was described as having a human body with horse legs, a dog's head with iron teeth, and a single eye on the forehead.

statement.id: Psoglav (Псоглав, harfiah "kepala anjing") adalah makhluk mitis bersifat iblis dalam mitologi Balkan yang dipercaya di sebagian Bosnia dan Montenegro, bertubuh manusia berkaki kuda, berkepala anjing bergigi besi, dan bermata satu di dahi.
statement.en: The psoglav ("doghead") is a demonic creature of Balkan mythology believed in parts of Bosnia and Montenegro, with a human body and horse legs, a dog's head with iron teeth and one eye on the forehead.

basis_claims.quote: Psoglavs were described as living in caves or in a dark land which has plenty of gemstones, but no sun. They practice anthropophagy, by eating people, or even digging out corpses from graves to eat them. In Croatian the term is psoglavac, and in Slovene it is psoglavec. There are numerous legends about them, particularly on the Istrian peninsula in Croatia.

statement.id: Psoglav tinggal di gua atau negeri gelap yang kaya permata tanpa matahari, memakan manusia, bahkan menggali kuburan untuk memakan mayat; dalam bahasa Kroasia disebut psoglavac dan Slovenia psoglavec; banyak legenda tentangnya terutama di Semenanjung Istria, Kroasia.
statement.en: Psoglavs live in caves or a dark, gem-rich, sunless land, eat people and even dig up corpses; Croatian psoglavac, Slovene psoglavec; many legends exist, especially on the Istrian peninsula in Croatia.

basis_claims.quote: Ово биће је описивано као химера са људским телом, коњским ногама и псећом главом. Имало је гвоздене зубе и једно око, попут грчких киклопа.

statement.id: Makhluk ini digambarkan sebagai kimera bertubuh manusia, berkaki kuda, dan berkepala anjing, bergigi besi dan bermata satu seperti kiklop Yunani.
statement.en: This being was described as a chimera with a human body, horse legs and a dog's head, with iron teeth and one eye like the Greek cyclopes.

basis_claims.quote: Вук Караџић је у Српском рјечнику из 1818. записао реч псоглав у значењу: „човек са главом пса”.

statement.id: Vuk Karadžić dalam Kamus Serbia tahun 1818 mencatat kata psoglav dengan arti "manusia berkepala anjing".
statement.en: Vuk Karadžić recorded psoglav in his 1818 Serbian Dictionary as "a man with a dog's head".

basis_claims.quote: Прождирали су људе, а чак су откопавали и гробове како би се хранили њиховим лешевима.

statement.id: Mereka melahap manusia dan bahkan menggali kuburan untuk memakan mayat.
statement.en: They devoured people and even dug up graves to feed on corpses.

visual_requirements: Bull-like sea creature with exactly five horns
Full bull animal body
Coastal water
Formidable Frankish myth aura

basis_claims.quote: The Quinotaur (Latin: Quinotaurus) is a mythical sea creature mentioned in the 7th century Frankish Chronicle of Fredegar. Referred to as "the beast of Neptune which resembles a Quinotaur", it was held to have fathered Meroveus by attacking the wife of the Frankish king Chlodio and thus to have sired the line of Merovingian kings.

statement.id: Quinotaur (Latin: Quinotaurus) adalah makhluk laut mitis yang disebut dalam Kronik Fredegar abad ke-7 sebagai "binatang Neptunus yang menyerupai Quinotaur", yang dianggap menjadi ayah Meroveus dengan menyerang istri raja Frank Chlodio sehingga menurunkan raja-raja Merovingia.
statement.en: The Quinotaur (Latin Quinotaurus) is a mythical sea creature in the 7th-century Chronicle of Fredegar, 'the beast of Neptune which resembles a Quinotaur', held to have fathered Meroveus by attacking the wife of the Frankish king Chlodio and so sired the Merovingian kings.

basis_claims.quote: The "bull with five horns" was likened by Pseudo-Fredegar (interpolating Gregory of Tours, who authored an earlier record of the legend) to both Neptune and the Minotaur, as it was both seaborne and taurine.

statement.id: "Banteng bertanduk lima" ini oleh Pseudo-Fredegar, yang menambahkan catatan Gregorius dari Tours, disamakan dengan Neptunus dan Minotaurus karena berasal dari laut dan berwujud banteng.
statement.en: The 'bull with five horns' was likened by Pseudo-Fredegar, interpolating Gregory of Tours, to both Neptune and the Minotaur, being both seaborne and bull-like.

basis_claims.quote: It is not known whether one or both traits are original to the legend or if their combination is an accretion by one or both of the Christian authors. The clerical Latinity of the name does not indicate whether it is a translation of some genuine Frankish creature or a coining.

statement.id: Tidak diketahui apakah ciri laut dan banteng itu asli dari legenda atau tambahan penulis Kristen, dan nama Latinnya tidak menunjukkan apakah ia terjemahan makhluk Frank asli atau ciptaan baru.
statement.en: It is unknown whether the sea and bull traits are original or added by the Christian authors, and the clerical Latin name does not show whether it translates a genuine Frankish creature or is a coinage.

basis_claims.quote: Le Quinotaure (Lat. Quinotaurus, « taureau à cinq cornes ») est une créature marine légendaire mentionnée dans la Chronique de Frédégaire du VIIe siècle.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, nama Quinotaurus berarti "banteng bertanduk lima".
statement.en: According to the French article, the name Quinotaurus means 'bull with five horns'.

visual_requirements: Exactly two legs and two wings
Dragon head and long tail
No fire breath

basis_claims.quote: The wyvern ... sometimes spelled wivern ... is a type of mythical  dragon with two legs, two wings, and often a pointed tail.

statement.id: Wyvern atau wivern adalah sejenis naga mitis berkaki dua, bersayap dua, dan sering berekor runcing.
statement.en: The wyvern or wivern is a kind of mythical dragon with two legs, two wings and often a pointed tail.

basis_claims.quote: The concluding "–n" had been added by the beginning of the 17th century, when John Guillim in 1610 describes the "wiverne" as a creature that "partake[s] of a Fowle in the Wings and Legs ... and doth resemble a Serpent in the Taile".

statement.id: Akhiran -n sudah ditambahkan pada awal abad ke-17, ketika John Guillim pada 1610 menggambarkan "wiverne" sebagai makhluk bersayap dan berkaki burung dengan ekor seperti ular.
statement.en: The final -n was added by the early 17th century, when John Guillim in 1610 described the 'wiverne' as having a fowl's wings and legs and a serpent's tail.

basis_claims.quote: The Egyptian goddess Wadjet, depicted as a winged cobra or uraeus, exemplifies this tradition and served as a protective deity of Lower Egypt from the Predynastic period onwards.

statement.id: Konsep ular bersayap ada di banyak budaya kuno Mediterania dan Timur Dekat, misalnya dewi Mesir Wadjet, kobra bersayap pelindung Mesir Hilir sejak masa Pradinasti.
statement.en: Winged snakes appear across ancient Mediterranean and Near Eastern cultures, for example the Egyptian goddess Wadjet, a winged cobra protecting Lower Egypt from Predynastic times.

basis_claims.quote: 「二足の竜」の図像は、イギリスを除くヨーロッパではドラゴンの一般的な形態の一つとして扱われており、これをワイバーンとしてドラゴンから区別するのはイギリスおよびイギリスの旧植民地に特有のことである。

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jepang, di Eropa selain Inggris naga berkaki dua dianggap bentuk naga biasa; membedakannya sebagai wyvern adalah kekhasan Inggris dan bekas jajahannya.
statement.en: According to the Japanese article, outside Britain two-legged dragons are treated as ordinary dragons in Europe; distinguishing them as wyverns is peculiar to Britain and its former colonies.

statement.en: Its size, behaviour and shape closely resemble Nessie; Nahuelito is well known in Argentina, and the old 1-peso note showed it raising its neck from the lake.

basis_claims.quote: tusk of Yskithyrwyn Penbaedd to shave myself withal, neither shall I profit by its use if it be not plucked alive out of his head.

statement.id: Ördög (Ürdüng dalam bahasa Hungaria Kuno) adalah makhluk iblis pengubah wujud dari mitologi dan paganisme awal Hungaria yang menguasai kekuatan gelap dan jahat di dunia.
statement.en: Ördög (Ürdüng in Old Hungarian) is a shape-shifting demonic creature of Hungarian mythology and early paganism who controls the dark and evil forces of the world.

basis_claims.quote: Ördög looks somewhat like a satyr or faun, a humanoid with the upper torso of a human male and lower portions of a goat; usually pitch-black, with cloven hooves, ram-like horns, a long tail ending in a blade; and he carries a pitchfork.

statement.en: Ördög looks somewhat like a satyr or faun, man above and goat below, usually pitch-black, with cloven hooves, ram-like horns, a long blade-tipped tail, carrying a pitchfork.

basis_claims.quote: In other legends, when he comes to earth, he takes the form of a fox, a dark flame or a Hungarian shepherd with dark, sparkling eyes. It is his habit to make bets with humans to see if they become corrupted. His long-term goal is to collect more human souls

statement.id: Dalam legenda lain, saat ke bumi ia menjelma rubah, nyala api gelap, atau gembala Hungaria bermata gelap berkilat; ia biasa bertaruh dengan manusia untuk melihat apakah mereka menjadi rusak, dengan tujuan mengumpulkan jiwa; menurut legenda lain ia bersembunyi di dinding rumah korban.
statement.en: In other legends, on earth he becomes a fox, a dark flame or a Hungarian shepherd with dark, sparkling eyes; he habitually bets with humans to see if they become corrupted, aiming to collect souls; other legends have him hide in victims' walls.

basis_claims.quote: the Pesanta (Catalan pronunciation: [pəˈzantə]) is a creature Catalan legend and popular culture. It is generally in the shape of an enormous dog or cat and goes into people's houses in the night and steps on their chests, making it difficult for them to breathe and causing nightmares.

statement.id: Pesanta adalah makhluk legenda dan budaya populer Katalan, umumnya berwujud anjing atau kucing raksasa yang masuk ke rumah pada malam hari dan menginjak dada orang sehingga sulit bernapas dan bermimpi buruk.
statement.en: The Pesanta is a creature of Catalan legend and popular culture, usually a huge dog or cat that enters houses at night and treads on people's chests, making it hard to breathe and causing nightmares.

basis_claims.quote: The Pesanta is similar to the Portuguese Pisadeira. It is black and hairy, with steel paws, but its paws have holes in them.

statement.id: Pesanta mirip Pisadeira dari Portugal; ia hitam dan berbulu, berkaki baja, tetapi kakinya berlubang.
statement.en: The Pesanta is like the Portuguese Pisadeira; it is black and hairy, with steel paws that have holes in them.

basis_claims.quote: Su aspecto es peludo y negro, con patas de acero, pero agujereadas de tal forma que no puede coger nada de la tierra sin que se le caiga.

statement.id: Kakinya yang berlubang membuatnya tidak dapat memungut apa pun dari tanah tanpa terjatuh lagi.
statement.en: Its holed paws mean it cannot pick anything up from the ground without dropping it.

basis_claims.quote: is a conventional representation of an animal, distinct to the early medieval culture of the Picts of Scotland. The great majority of surviving examples are on Pictish stones.

statement.en: Pictish Beast (Pictish Dragon, Pictish Elephant): a stylised animal of the early medieval Picts of Scotland, on Pictish stones.

basis_claims.quote: One omission from Stuart's plate is the symbol in the Doo Cave at East Wemyss, recorded by Anderson in 1881. Anderson described it as "the symbolic animal, with the long jaws and the crest and the scroll-like feet".
