statement.en: Jill Harden: the figure is swimming; porpoise, dolphin or mythical creature?

basis_claims.quote: Die Figuren entstanden zwischen dem 7. und 9. Jahrhundert. Ob ein Tier oder eine Chimäre dargestellt wird, ist ungeklärt. Es ist eines der häufigsten Symbole im piktischen Repertoire und kommt 29 Mal auf Steinen der Klasse I, 25 Mal auf Steinen der Klasse II und fünf Mal auf Höhlenwänden vor.

statement.id: Abad ke-7 hingga ke-9; 29 kali pada batu Kelas (Klasse) I, 25 kali Kelas II, lima kali di dinding gua; hewan atau chimera belum jelas.
statement.en: 7th to 9th centuries; 29 times on Class I stones, 25 on Class II, five on cave walls; animal or chimera unclear.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Cantabria, ramidreju adalah makhluk yang konon menghuni gunung dan hutan Cantabria di Spanyol utara; hewan mirip musang ini lahir sekali setiap seratus tahun dari musang atau marten.
statement.en: In Cantabrian mythology the ramidreju is a creature said to live in the mountains and forests of Cantabria in northern Spain; this weasel-like animal is born once every hundred years from a weasel or a marten.

basis_claims.quote: These mythological creatures have a very long body, like a snake, and their fur is slightly green-colored. Its eyes are yellow, its nose is like that of a hog and its tusks are like those of the boar, which it uses to dig very deep holes.

statement.id: Tubuhnya sangat panjang seperti ular dengan bulu kehijauan, matanya kuning, hidungnya seperti babi, dan taringnya seperti babi hutan yang dipakai menggali lubang sangat dalam.
statement.en: Its body is very long like a snake's, its fur greenish, its eyes yellow, its nose like a hog's and its tusks like a boar's, which it uses to dig very deep holes.

basis_claims.quote: Ramidrejus are a very sought-after animal in Cantabrian folklore because their fur heals every sickness and the animal has a strong desire for gold.

statement.id: Ramidreju sangat diburu dalam cerita rakyat Cantabria karena bulunya menyembuhkan segala penyakit dan hewan ini sangat menginginkan emas.
statement.en: Ramidrejus are much sought after in Cantabrian folklore because their fur cures every illness and the animal has a strong craving for gold.

statement.en: In Slavic mythology the Raróg or Raróh is a fire demon, often depicted as a fiery falcon.

basis_claims.quote: According to Czech folklore, a raroh can hatch from an egg that was incubated on a stove for nine days and nights, and can appear either as a fiery falcon or a dragon. In Polish folklore, the rarog is a tiny bird that can be held in a pocket, and can bring people happiness.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat Ceko, raroh dapat menetas dari telur yang dierami di atas tungku selama sembilan hari dan malam, dan tampil sebagai elang api atau naga; dalam cerita rakyat Polandia raróg adalah burung mungil yang muat di saku dan membawa kebahagiaan.
statement.en: In Czech folklore a raroh can hatch from an egg incubated on a stove for nine days and nights and appear as a fiery falcon or dragon; in Polish folklore the rarog is a tiny pocket-sized bird bringing happiness.

statement.en: Proto-Slavic *rarogъ, "falcon, hawk" (?), goes back to Proto-Indo-European.

basis_claims.quote: в славянской мифологии огненный дух, связанный с культом очага. Рарога представляли в образе птицы (обычно хищной) или дракона с искрящимся телом, а также в виде огненного вихря.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia Raróg adalah roh api yang terkait pemujaan perapian, dibayangkan sebagai burung (biasanya pemangsa) atau naga bertubuh berpercikan, juga sebagai pusaran api.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology the Raróg is a fire spirit tied to the hearth cult, pictured as a bird (usually of prey) or a dragon with a sparkling body, or a fiery whirlwind.

basis_claims.quote: alternatively spelled as roux-ga-roux, rugaroo, or rugaru) is a legendary creature in Cajun and Creole diaspora and a trickster in oral traditions in Métis and Francophone communities linked to traditional concepts of the werewolf.

statement.id: Rougarou (juga roux-ga-roux, rugaroo, atau rugaru) adalah makhluk legenda diaspora Cajun dan Kreol serta tokoh penipu dalam tradisi lisan komunitas Métis dan berbahasa Prancis, yang terkait dengan konsep manusia serigala.
statement.en: The rougarou (also roux-ga-roux, rugaroo or rugaru) is a legendary creature of the Cajun and Creole diaspora and a trickster in Métis and Francophone oral traditions, linked to the werewolf.

basis_claims.quote: In the Creole and Cajun legends, the creature is said to prowl the swamps around Acadiana and Greater New Orleans, and the sugar cane fields and woodlands of the regions. The rougarou most often is described as a creature with a human body and the head of a wolf or dog, similar to the werewolf legend.

statement.id: Dalam legenda Kreol dan Cajun, rougarou berkeliaran di rawa-rawa sekitar Acadiana dan New Orleans serta ladang tebu dan hutan, dan biasanya bertubuh manusia berkepala serigala atau anjing.
statement.en: In Creole and Cajun legend the rougarou prowls the swamps around Acadiana and New Orleans and the cane fields and woods, usually with a human body and a wolf's or dog's head.

basis_claims.quote: Often the story-telling has been used to inspire fear and obedience. One such example is stories that have been told by elders to persuade Creole and Cajun children to behave.

statement.id: Kisahnya sering dipakai untuk menanamkan rasa takut dan kepatuhan, misalnya oleh orang tua agar anak-anak Kreol dan Cajun berkelakuan baik.
statement.en: The tales were often used to instil fear and obedience, for instance by elders to make Creole and Cajun children behave.

santoaderi.depicted_variant: ONE representative Romanian SANTOADER among the documented supernatural procession, humanlike male upper body with two arms wearing a dark cape and simple rustic tunic, but CLEARLY LONG EQUINE LOWER LEGS ending in exactly TWO HORSE HOOVES instead of human feet
visual_requirements: ONE representative Romanian SANTOADER among the documented supernatural procession, humanlike male upper body with two arms wearing a dark cape and simple rustic tunic, but CLEARLY LONG EQUINE LOWER LEGS ending in exactly TWO HORSE HOOVES instead of human feet. Hooves uncovered and unmistakably visible separated on village cobbles, no shoes; holding a plain hand drum, mouth open as if singing. Night Romanian village street, threatening uncanny nocturnal hoofbeat procession aura. Only one being pictured to avoid unsupported group counts, no human feet, horse head, wings, horns, victims, chains, violence or blood.
santoaderi.aura: ONE representative Romanian SANTOADER among the documented supernatural procession, humanlike male upper body with two arms wearing a dark cape and simple rustic tunic, but CLEARLY LONG EQUINE LOWER LEGS ending in exactly TWO HORSE HOOVES instead of human feet. Hooves uncovered and unmistakably visible separated on village cobbles, no shoes; holding a plain hand drum, mouth open as if singing. Night Romanian village street, threatening uncanny nocturnal hoofbeat procession aura. Only one being pictured to avoid unsupported group counts, no human feet, horse head, wings, horns, victims, chains, violence or blood.

basis_claims.quote: The Sântoaderi were a group of supernatural entities found in Romanian folklore. Viewed as either seven or nine young men with long feet and hooves, they were also thought of as wearing capes.

statement.id: Sântoaderi adalah sekelompok makhluk gaib dalam cerita rakyat Rumania, dibayangkan sebagai tujuh atau sembilan pemuda berkaki panjang dan berkuku kuda (hooves), yang juga dianggap mengenakan jubah.
statement.en: The Sântoaderi were a group of supernatural beings of Romanian folklore, pictured as seven or nine young men with long feet and hooves, also thought to wear capes.

basis_claims.quote: It was believed that they would mysteriously appear in a village, where they would sing, beat their drums, and cause illness for people; wrapping them up in chains causing rheumatism or stamping on their bodies.

statement.id: Diyakini mereka muncul secara misterius di sebuah desa, bernyanyi, menabuh genderang, dan membuat orang sakit: membelit mereka dengan rantai sehingga terkena rematik, atau menginjak-injak tubuh mereka.
statement.en: They were believed to appear mysteriously in a village, singing and beating drums, and to cause illness: wrapping people in chains, causing rheumatism, or stamping on their bodies.

basis_claims.quote: Upon hearing their music and the sound of hooves, people were advised to stay indoors, which was considered safe. Those that did not retreat indoors, could be kidnapped by the Sântoaderi and made part of the procession.

statement.id: Begitu mendengar musik dan derap kuku mereka, orang dianjurkan tetap di dalam rumah, yang dianggap aman; yang tidak masuk rumah bisa diculik Sântoaderi dan dijadikan bagian dari arak-arakan mereka.
statement.en: On hearing their music and hoofbeats, people were advised to stay indoors, which was thought safe; those who did not could be kidnapped by the Sântoaderi and made part of their procession.

sea-monk.depicted_variant: Historical piscis monachus fishlike monk-habit silhouette
visual_requirements: Fishlike sea creature outwardly resembles monk habit
Continuous aquatic body with fins and tail
Danish coastal marine setting
Uncanny historical wonder

basis_claims.quote: The sea monk (also monk-fish or monkfish) was a sea creature found off the eastern coast of the Danish island of Zealand in 1546. It was described as a "fish" that outwardly resembled a human monk in his habit.

statement.id: Biarawan laut adalah makhluk laut yang ditemukan di lepas pantai timur pulau Zealand, Denmark, pada 1546, digambarkan sebagai "ikan" yang dari luar mirip biarawan berjubah.
statement.en: The sea monk was a sea creature found off the east coast of the Danish island of Zealand in 1546, described as a 'fish' outwardly like a monk in his habit.

basis_claims.quote: The creature was called "monk fish" (Latin: piscis monachus) by Belon (1553), and piscis monachi habitu ("fish [wearing] the habit of a monk") by Rondelet (1554).

statement.id: Belon (1553) menyebutnya piscis monachus, "ikan biarawan", dan Rondelet (1554) piscis monachi habitu, "ikan berjubah biarawan".
statement.en: Belon (1553) called it piscis monachus, 'monk fish', and Rondelet (1554) piscis monachi habitu, 'fish in a monk's habit'.

basis_claims.quote: Christian III of Denmark sent an illustration of it to Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor. The creature is recorded in Vedel's Den danske Krønicke (1575) as measuring 4 ells long (15 ft; 4.6 m).

statement.id: Christian III dari Denmark mengirim gambarnya kepada Kaisar Charles V, dan Den danske Krønicke karya Vedel (1575) mencatat panjangnya 4 ell (4,6 m).
statement.en: Christian III of Denmark sent a picture of it to Emperor Charles V, and Vedel's Den danske Krønicke (1575) records it as 4 ells (4.6 m) long.

basis_claims.quote: Rondelet (1554) called it "the fish with the habit of a monk (piscis monachi habitu), and classed it as a merman (homo maris). But he did not think the pictorial representations he obtained could be taken at face value

statement.id: Rondelet menggolongkannya sebagai manusia laut (homo maris), tetapi meragukan bahwa gambar yang ia terima bisa dipercaya begitu saja.
statement.en: Rondelet classed it as a merman (homo maris) but doubted that the pictures he received could be taken at face value.

basis_claims.quote: Japetus Steenstrup interpretierte ihn 1855 als Tintenfisch, neuere Deutungen gehen zum Beispiel von Seeteufeln, Meerengeln oder Robben aus.

statement.id: Japetus Steenstrup pada 1855 menafsirkannya sebagai cumi-cumi, sedangkan tafsiran baru mengusulkan ikan sungut ganda, hiu malaikat, atau anjing laut.
statement.en: Japetus Steenstrup in 1855 read it as a squid, while newer readings suggest anglerfish, angelsharks or seals.

ratoncito-perez.depicted_variant: Animal little mouse exchanging a milk tooth for a coin in Spanish bedside folklore
visual_requirements: One small mouse with two round ears and pointed whiskered snout
Four mouse paws and one long bare tail; no human anatomy or clothing
Milk tooth and small coin beside pale bedside pillow
Benevolent quiet nighttime tooth-collector atmosphere
ratoncito-perez.aura: Gentle benevolent nocturnal visitor, reassuring childhood folklore wonder

basis_claims.quote: El Ratoncito Pérez or Ratón Pérez ... Perez the Little Mouse or Perez Mouse) is a fantasy figure of early childhood in Spanish and Hispanic American cultures.

statement.id: Ratoncito Pérez atau Ratón Pérez ("Tikus Kecil Pérez") adalah tokoh khayalan masa kanak-kanak dalam budaya Spanyol dan Amerika Hispanik.
statement.en: El Ratoncito Pérez or Ratón Pérez ('Pérez the Little Mouse') is a fantasy figure of early childhood in Spanish and Hispanic American cultures.

basis_claims.quote: The folklore states that when children lose one of their milk teeth, they should place it underneath their pillow or on their bedside table and he will visit while they sleep, replacing the lost tooth with a small payment or gift, as does the Tooth Fairy in other cultures.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi, anak yang tanggal gigi susunya menaruhnya di bawah bantal atau di meja samping tempat tidur, lalu Pérez datang saat mereka tidur dan menggantinya dengan uang atau hadiah kecil, seperti Peri Gigi di budaya lain.
statement.en: By tradition, children who lose a milk tooth put it under the pillow or on the bedside table, and he comes while they sleep and replaces it with a small payment or gift, like the Tooth Fairy elsewhere.

basis_claims.quote: In 1894, Queen Maria Christina commissioned Coloma to write a tale for King Alfonso XIII, who had just lost a tooth at the age of eight. Coloma's story follows Ratón Pérez, who lived with his family in a box of cookies at the basement of Prast confectionery store in Madrid

statement.id: Ratu Maria Christina memesan cerita itu untuk Alfonso XIII yang baru tanggal giginya; dalam cerita Coloma, Ratón Pérez tinggal bersama keluarganya di kotak biskuit di ruang bawah tanah toko kue Prast di Madrid.
statement.en: Queen Maria Christina commissioned the tale for Alfonso XIII, who had just lost a tooth; in Coloma's story Ratón Pérez lives with his family in a biscuit box in the basement of the Prast confectionery in Madrid.

basis_claims.quote: По традиции дарит ребёнку подарок вместо выпавшего молочного зуба, положенного под подушку.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Rusia juga menyebut ia memberi hadiah sebagai ganti gigi susu yang ditaruh di bawah bantal.
statement.en: The Russian article also says he gives a child a present in exchange for a milk tooth placed under the pillow.

sarkany-mythology.depicted_variant: Tarajos kígyó / crested-serpent folk variant, horse-like front and serpent-like rear
visual_requirements: One nonhuman winged hard-scaled serpent with elongated horse-like forebody
One head, two membranous wings, two clawed forelegs, continuous serpentine rear with no hind legs
Flaming crest, long teeth and claws, mouth emits sparks
Hungarian marsh and storm atmosphere

basis_claims.quote: ('dragon') is a legendary monster found in Hungarian mythology. It usually appears as a scaly, winged, reptilian beast, but in some cases it could be a mixture of other beings.

statement.id: Sárkány ("naga") adalah monster legendaris dalam mitologi Hungaria, biasanya berupa binatang reptil bersisik dan bersayap, kadang campuran makhluk lain.
statement.en: The sárkány ("dragon") is a legendary monster of Hungarian mythology, usually a scaly, winged, reptilian beast, sometimes a mixture of other beings.

basis_claims.quote: „A tarajos csúszó, tarajos kígyó félelmetes, természetfeletti erejű kígyó. Szárnyas alakú, elöl lóhoz, hátul kígyóhoz hasonlít, pikkelyes kemény bőrű, hosszú körmű, hosszú fogú, lángoló tarajú; szikrát fúj, lángot hány.

statement.id: Menurut Magyar néprajzi lexikon, tarajos kígyó ("ular berjengger") adalah ular menakutkan berkekuatan gaib, bersayap, depannya mirip kuda dan belakangnya mirip ular, bersisik keras, berkuku dan bergigi panjang, berjengger menyala, meniup percikan dan memuntahkan api.
statement.en: Per the Hungarian ethnographic lexicon, the tarajos kígyó ("crested serpent") is a dreadful, supernaturally strong winged snake, horse-like in front and snake-like behind, hard-scaled, long-clawed and long-toothed, with a flaming crest, blowing sparks and spewing flame.

basis_claims.quote: „Sárkány, mint a garabonciás lova, kapcsolatban áll a viharral, jégesővel és a kincsekkel. Olyan halból vagy kígyóból lesz, amelyet mocsárban, kőszirtben elbújva hét évig emberi szem nem látott.”

statement.id: Sárkány, sebagai kuda tunggangan garabonciás, berhubungan dengan badai, hujan es, dan harta; ia lahir dari ikan atau ular yang tersembunyi di rawa atau tebing batu dan tujuh tahun tidak terlihat mata manusia.
statement.en: The sárkány, as the garabonciás's steed, is linked with storms, hail and treasure; it comes from a fish or snake hidden in a marsh or rock cleft and unseen by human eyes for seven years.

basis_claims.quote: Általánosságban kijelenthető, hogy legtöbbször a pusztító, villámló viharokkal hozták összefüggésbe a sárkányok megjelenését, ahol a vihar mennydörgése tulajdonképpen a sárkányok tombolása volt az égben

statement.id: Kemunculan naga paling sering dikaitkan dengan badai petir yang merusak, dan gemuruh guntur dianggap amukan naga di langit.
statement.en: The appearance of dragons was most often linked with destructive lightning storms, the thunder being the dragons raging in the sky.

additional_sources.title: Magyar Néprajzi Lexikon — sárkány
additional_sources.purpose: Direct lexicon confirmation of tarajos kígyó anatomical variant and flaming crest; limb rendering is artistic interpretation of horse-like front and serpent rear.

surale.depicted_variant: Traditional horned woolly Şüräle forest spirit, not human peasant disguise
visual_requirements: Single horn on forehead
Woolly shaggy nonhuman forest body
Extremely long fingers on both hands
Mischievous threatening forest-spirit aura
surale.aura: Mischievous, threatening and mysterious ambivalent forest spirit

basis_claims.quote: is a forest spirit in Turkic mythology (especially Tatar and Bashkir). According to legends, Shurali lives in forests. He has long fingers, a horn on its forehead, and a woolly body. He lures victims into the thickets and can tickle them to death.

statement.id: Şüräle adalah roh hutan dalam mitologi Turkik, terutama Tatar dan Bashkir: berjari panjang, bertanduk di dahi, berbulu lebat, dan memikat korban ke semak lalu menggelitikinya sampai mati.
statement.en: Şüräle is a forest spirit of Turkic, especially Tatar and Bashkir, mythology with long fingers, a horn on its forehead and a woolly body, who lures victims into thickets and can tickle them to death.

basis_claims.quote: антропоморфное мифическое существо, описанное в татарском, башкирском, чувашском и марийском фольклорах, персонификация духа леса.

statement.id: Şüräle makhluk mitos mirip manusia dalam cerita rakyat Tatar, Bashkir, Chuvash, dan Mari, personifikasi roh hutan.
statement.en: Şüräle is a humanlike mythical being in Tatar, Bashkir, Chuvash and Mari folklore, the personification of the forest spirit.

basis_claims.quote: Имеет к себе двойственное отношение, либо почитаем, как дух леса, либо же ненавидим, как слишком конфликтное существо, нападающее на людей.

statement.id: Sikap orang terhadapnya mendua: dihormati sebagai roh hutan, atau dibenci sebagai makhluk suka berkonflik yang menyerang manusia.
statement.en: Attitudes toward it are mixed: honoured as the forest spirit, or hated as a quarrelsome creature that attacks people.

pricolici.depicted_variant: Romanian dead-risen wolf revenant variant of pricolici
visual_requirements: Entirely wolf-shaped quadruped revenant
Four distinct canine legs and paws
One wolf head, two ears and one bushy tail
Large fierce stealthy predator in Romanian cemetery woodland
pricolici.aura: Sinister, dangerous and stealthy undead wolf predator

basis_claims.quote: Pricolici are similar to a vârcolac, although the latter sometimes symbolises a goblin, whereas the pricolici always has wolf-like characteristics, they have the ability to transform into ordinary people or animals.

statement.id: Pricolici mirip vârcolac, tetapi selalu bercirikan serigala dan dapat berubah menjadi manusia biasa atau hewan.
statement.en: Pricolici resemble the vârcolac, but always have wolf traits and can turn into ordinary people or animals.

basis_claims.quote: While a strigoi possesses anthropomorphic qualities similar to the ones it had before death, a pricolici always resembles a wolf or dog. Malicious, violent men are often said to become pricolici after death, in order to continue harming other humans.

statement.id: Berbeda dari strigoi yang tetap mirip manusia, pricolici selalu mirip serigala atau anjing; lelaki jahat dan kejam sering dikatakan menjadi pricolici setelah mati untuk terus mencelakai manusia.
statement.en: Unlike the strigoi, which keeps a human look, the pricolici always resembles a wolf or dog; wicked, violent men are often said to become pricolici after death to keep harming people.

basis_claims.quote: Some Romanian folklore delineates that Pricolici are werewolves in life and after they die, return as vampires.

statement.id: Sebagian cerita rakyat Rumania menyebut pricolici adalah manusia serigala semasa hidup dan kembali sebagai vampir setelah mati.
statement.en: Some Romanian folklore holds that pricolici are werewolves in life and return as vampires after death.

basis_claims.quote: Even as recently as modern times, many people living in rural areas of Romania have claimed to have been viciously attacked by abnormally large and fierce wolves. Apparently, these wolves attack silently, unexpectedly and only solitary targets.

statement.id: Bahkan di zaman modern banyak warga pedesaan Rumania mengaku diserang serigala yang luar biasa besar dan buas, yang menyerang diam-diam, tiba-tiba, dan hanya orang yang sendirian.
statement.en: Even in modern times many rural Romanians have claimed to be attacked by unusually large, fierce wolves that strike silently, suddenly and only lone victims.

basis_claims.quote: Приколичами называли: мертвецов, вставших из могилы в образе волка или собаки, реже других диких животных; живых людей, способных на время превращаться в волков или собак

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Rusia, pricolici adalah sebutan untuk orang mati yang bangkit dari kubur berwujud serigala atau anjing, maupun orang hidup yang untuk sementara dapat berubah menjadi serigala atau anjing.
statement.en: According to the Russian article, pricolici were the dead risen from the grave as wolves or dogs, and also living people able to turn into wolves or dogs for a time.

sazakan.depicted_variant: Huge branching-horn dragon-like storm spirit manifesting from cloud into a whirlwind
visual_requirements: Huge nonhuman dragon-like head and cloud-bound body
Two visibly branched horn roots, one head and continuous body
Single storm vortex with rain, hail and lightning
Mountain-cloud setting and wild unpredictable elemental aura
sazakan.aura: Wild immense unpredictable elemental storm power; ambivalent rain and hail spirit

basis_claims.quote: In Turkic mythology, a Sazakan is a dragon, hawk, falcon, or fiery dwarf who turns himself into a whirlwind and causes storms.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Turkik, Sazakan adalah naga, elang, alap-alap, atau kurcaci api yang menjelma angin puting beliung dan menimbulkan badai.
statement.en: In Turkic mythology a Sazakan is a dragon, hawk, falcon or fiery dwarf that becomes a whirlwind and causes storms.

basis_claims.quote: Sazakan is a spirit associated with bringing rain and hail. His influence on these precipitations can be positive, resulting with the amount of rain beneficial for agriculture, or negative, with a drought, downpours, or hail.

statement.id: Sazakan roh pembawa hujan dan hujan es; pengaruhnya bisa baik, memberi hujan yang bermanfaat bagi pertanian, atau buruk, berupa kekeringan, hujan deras, atau hujan es.
statement.en: Sazakan is a spirit that brings rain and hail; its influence can be good, giving rain useful for farming, or bad, bringing drought, downpours or hail.

basis_claims.quote: Sazakans also have power over wind, which they use to intensify storms.

statement.id: Sazakan juga menguasai angin untuk memperkuat badai.
statement.en: Sazakans also command the wind, which they use to strengthen storms.

basis_claims.quote: Sazakans live around hills, mountains, and high mounds; in the wilderness; and sometimes in the clouds. In Nogai folklore, Sazakans are described as being noisy spirits, and are the patron of the clouds.

statement.id: Sazakan tinggal di sekitar bukit, gunung, gundukan tinggi, belantara, dan kadang di awan; dalam cerita rakyat Nogai mereka roh yang riuh dan pelindung awan.
statement.en: Sazakans live around hills, mountains and high mounds, in the wilderness and sometimes in the clouds; in Nogai folklore they are noisy spirits and patrons of the clouds.

basis_claims.quote: Sazakan – Türk ve Altay halk inancında ve mitolojisinde Kasırga Cini. Yaz mevsiminde bulutların arasında dolaşır. Baharda yağmurdan önce ortaya çıkar.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan Turki dan Altai, Sazakan adalah jin badai yang berkeliaran di antara awan pada musim panas dan muncul sebelum hujan pada musim semi.
statement.en: In Turkic and Altai belief Sazakan is the storm jinn that roams the clouds in summer and appears before the rain in spring.

basis_claims.quote: Ejderhaya benzeyen kocaman bir varlıktır. Budaklı boynuzları vardır.

statement.id: Ia makhluk besar mirip naga dengan tanduk bercabang.
statement.en: It is a huge, dragon-like being with branching horns.

additional_sources.title: Deniz Karakurt — Türk Söylence Sözlüğü, 2011, page 179, SAZAKAN
additional_sources.purpose: Direct dictionary passage confirms huge dragon-like being, branching horns, cloud residence, strengthened rain and lightning. Cloud-body depiction is artistic interpretation of transformation to whirlwind; no claim of a specific traditional limb count.

samca.depicted_variant: Documented big black spider shapeshifting form
visual_requirements: One huge black spider body with cephalothorax and rounded abdomen
Exactly eight segmented walking legs: four per side, all countable
No ordinary woman portrait or mixed traits from other shapeshifting forms
Malevolent nocturnal full-moon folkloric atmosphere near Romanian dwelling
samca.aura: Unsettling malevolent nocturnal presence, imposing black arachnid shapeshifter

basis_claims.quote: Samca is an evil spirit in Romanian mythology. She most commonly takes the appearance of a naked woman with disheveled hair growing down to her heels, with small eyes that shine as brightly as the stars, with iron hands and long nails sharp as knitting needles or hooked as sickles and a tongue of fire.

statement.id: Samca adalah roh jahat dalam mitologi Rumania yang paling sering tampil sebagai perempuan telanjang berambut kusut hingga tumit, bermata kecil berkilau seperti bintang, bertangan besi dengan kuku panjang setajam jarum rajut atau melengkung seperti sabit, dan berlidah api.
statement.en: Samca is an evil spirit of Romanian mythology who most often appears as a naked woman with dishevelled hair down to her heels, small eyes shining like stars, iron hands with long nails sharp as knitting needles or hooked like sickles, and a tongue of fire.

basis_claims.quote: Other forms Samca can take are: a very large and fierce pig, a grinning dog showing awful teeth, a hairless cat with fiery, bulging eyes, a crow with bloody eyes, and a big black spider.

statement.id: Samca juga bisa berwujud babi besar yang ganas, anjing menyeringai dengan gigi mengerikan, kucing tak berbulu bermata menyala dan melotot, gagak bermata darah, dan laba-laba hitam besar.
statement.en: Samca can also take the form of a huge fierce pig, a grinning dog with awful teeth, a hairless cat with fiery bulging eyes, a crow with bloody eyes and a big black spider.

basis_claims.quote: It can come out at the end of each month, around full moon, and it usually appears to children under the age of four, who are so frightened that they become sick immediately. The disease children develop after Samca appears to them is called "the children's malice". This demon can also appear to women who are about to give birth.

statement.id: Ia bisa keluar pada akhir setiap bulan, sekitar bulan purnama, biasanya menampakkan diri kepada anak di bawah empat tahun yang begitu ketakutan hingga langsung sakit; penyakit itu disebut "kedengkian anak-anak"; demon ini juga muncul kepada perempuan yang akan melahirkan.
statement.en: It may come out at the end of each month, around full moon, usually appearing to children under four, who are so frightened they fall ill at once; the illness is called "the children's malice"; the demon can also appear to women about to give birth.

basis_claims.quote: Samca este un personaj al legendelor românești, un spirit necurat, foarte urât și fioros

statement.id: Artikel Rumania menyebut Samca sebagai tokoh legenda Rumania, roh najis yang sangat buruk rupa dan ganas.
statement.en: The Romanian article calls Samca a figure of Romanian legends, an unclean spirit, very ugly and fierce.

q-ursha.depicted_variant: Georgian eagle-winged Q'ursha with colossal paws, gold lips and large eyes
visual_requirements: Dog head and body with black ears
Exactly two feathered eagle wings in addition to four canine legs
Colossal canine paws, golden lips and enlarged eyes
Loyal protective mighty mountain companion aura
q-ursha.aura: Loyal, protective, noble and powerful vigilant companion

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary dog from Georgian mythology. Although he appears in a number of different stories, he is best known as the loyal companion of the culture hero Amirani. His name means "black-ear", a common Georgian name for dogs.

statement.id: Q'ursha (ყურშა) adalah anjing legendaris mitologi Georgia, paling dikenal sebagai teman setia pahlawan budaya Amirani; namanya berarti "telinga hitam", nama anjing yang umum di Georgia.
statement.en: Q'ursha is a legendary dog of Georgian mythology, best known as the loyal companion of the culture hero Amirani; his name means "black-ear", a common Georgian dog name.

basis_claims.quote: He was said to be born of either a raven or an eagle and is sometimes depicted as having eagle's wings as a result. Apart from his wings, Q'ursha was sometimes described with other special features: colossal paws, "lips of gold, and eyes as big as sieves".

statement.id: Ia dikatakan lahir dari gagak atau elang sehingga kadang digambarkan bersayap elang, dengan kaki sangat besar, bibir emas, dan mata sebesar ayakan.
statement.en: He was said to be born of a raven or eagle and so sometimes shown with eagle wings, colossal paws, golden lips and eyes as big as sieves.

basis_claims.quote: He was attributed supernatural abilities such as a thunderous bark, a leap "as big as a great field" and an infallible ability to track prey.

statement.id: Ia diberi kemampuan gaib seperti gonggongan bak guntur, lompatan "sebesar padang luas", dan kemampuan melacak buruan yang tak pernah gagal.
statement.en: He was credited with a thunderous bark, a leap "as big as a great field" and infallible tracking of prey.

basis_claims.quote: God chains him to a pole inside a mountain for his defiance, and his faithful hound Q'ursha is trapped along with him. Q'ursha licks Amirani's chains constantly, weakening them more and more until Amirani is almost able to escape. However, every year they would be renewed just before Q'ursha could free Amirani.

statement.id: Tuhan merantai Amirani pada tiang di dalam gunung, dan Q'ursha ikut terkurung; Q'ursha terus menjilati rantai hingga Amirani hampir lolos, tetapi setiap tahun rantai itu diperbarui.
statement.en: God chains Amirani to a pole inside a mountain and Q'ursha is trapped with him; Q'ursha licks the chains until Amirani almost escapes, but every year they are renewed.

zaltys.depicted_variant: Sacred Lithuanian household guardian in wholly animal grass-snake form
visual_requirements: One natural grass-snake head and continuous legless body with one tapering tail
Recognizable grass-snake coloration and pale collar as artistic natural-species depiction
Calm guardian beside household stove; milk-offering bowl
Sacred benevolent solar household atmosphere, no transformed human prince
zaltys.aura: Quiet sacred benevolent household guardian warmed by sunlight

basis_claims.quote: is a household spirit in Lithuanian mythology. It is a sacred animal of the sun goddess Saulė, and was considered a guardian of the home and a symbol of fertility. People used to keep it as a pet by the stove or other special area of the house, believing that it would bring good harvest and wealth. Killing the žaltys was said to bring great misfortunes upon the household.

statement.id: Žaltys (ular rumput) adalah roh rumah dalam mitologi Lituania, binatang suci dewi matahari Saulė, penjaga rumah dan lambang kesuburan; orang memeliharanya di dekat tungku dan percaya ia membawa panen baik dan kekayaan; membunuhnya mendatangkan malapetaka; bila ditemukan di ladang ia diberi susu.
statement.en: The žaltys (grass snake) is a household spirit of Lithuanian mythology, sacred animal of the sun goddess Saulė, guardian of the home and symbol of fertility; people kept it by the stove believing it brought good harvests and wealth; killing it brought misfortune; one found in a field was given milk.

basis_claims.quote: Жалтис считался посланцем богов, любимцем Солнца, потому убийство Жалтиса приравнивалось к преступлению. В литовском языке существует пословица: «При виде мёртвого ужа и Солнце плачет».

statement.id: Žaltys dianggap utusan para dewa dan kesayangan Matahari, sehingga membunuhnya disamakan dengan kejahatan; pepatah Lituania berkata "Melihat ular rumput mati, Matahari pun menangis".
statement.en: The žaltys was considered a messenger of the gods and the Sun's favourite, so killing it was a crime; a Lithuanian proverb says "At the sight of a dead grass snake even the Sun weeps".

basis_claims.quote: божество в образе ужа в латышской и литовской мифологии.

statement.id: Žaltys (Latvia: Zalktis) adalah dewa berwujud ular rumput dalam mitologi Latvia dan Lituania.
statement.en: The žaltys (Latvian Zalktis) is a deity in the form of a grass snake in Latvian and Lithuanian mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Жальтис считался покровителем скота и сравнивается с Piena Māte (Молочная мать).

statement.id: Žaltys dianggap pelindung ternak dan dibandingkan dengan Piena Māte (Ibu Susu).
statement.en: The žaltys was considered a protector of livestock and compared with Piena Māte (the Milk Mother).

scitalis.depicted_variant: The dazzling serpent in the Aberdeen Bestiary prose account, shedding its skin in winter
visual_requirements: One limbless serpent with one head, one continuous body and tail
Glittering diverse back-scale markings captivate the viewer
Empty discarded snakeskin and winter frost
Warm thawed ground under serpent suggests exceptional bodily heat
scitalis.aura: Uncanny captivating jewel-like beauty with quiet predatory menace

basis_claims.quote: The Scitalis or Scytale is a serpent from Medieval bestiaries, such as the Aberdeen Bestiary, supposed to have such marvelous markings on its back that its appearance would stun the viewer, slowing the person down so that they could be caught.

statement.id: Scitalis atau Scytale adalah ular dalam bestiari abad pertengahan seperti Aberdeen Bestiary, yang punggungnya bercorak begitu indah sehingga orang yang melihatnya terpana dan melambat hingga dapat ditangkap.
statement.en: The Scitalis or Scytale is a serpent of medieval bestiaries such as the Aberdeen Bestiary, whose back markings were so marvellous that viewers were stunned and slowed down enough to be caught.

basis_claims.quote: Its bodily heat was so great that it shed its skin even in the winter.

statement.id: Tubuhnya begitu panas sehingga ia berganti kulit bahkan pada musim dingin.
statement.en: Its body heat was so great that it shed its skin even in winter.

basis_claims.quote: Lucan wrote in the 1st century AD, in his Pharsalia, book 9, verse 841-842, that "Sole of all serpents Scytale to shed / In vernal frosts his slough...".

statement.id: Lucanus pada abad ke-1 M menulis dalam Pharsalia buku 9, baris 841-842, bahwa Scytale satu-satunya ular yang berganti kulit di tengah embun beku musim semi.
statement.en: Lucan wrote in the 1st century AD, in Pharsalia book 9, lines 841-842, that the Scytale alone of all serpents sheds its slough in the spring frosts.

basis_claims.quote: It creeps slowly and cannot pursue its prey, so it stupifies with its marvelous appearance.

statement.id: Menurut Isidorus dari Sevilla, ia merayap pelan dan tak dapat mengejar mangsa, sehingga melumpuhkannya dengan penampilannya yang menakjubkan.
statement.en: According to Isidore of Seville it creeps slowly and cannot chase its prey, so it stupefies it with its marvellous appearance.

additional_sources.title: University of Aberdeen — Aberdeen Bestiary, folio 68v, Of the snake called scitalis
additional_sources.purpose: Primary manuscript text and university translation confirm diverse glittering back patterns, slow movement, heat and winter shedding. This artwork explicitly selects the prose serpent account, rather than the separately described dog-headed winged miniature.

monster-of-ravenna.depicted_variant: Landucci 1512 two-leg bat-wing omen-image, modestly covered; chest signs and genital anatomy omitted
visual_requirements: Single upright forehead horn
Two bat wings replace arms, with no hands or arms
Landucci two-leg variant with eye on anatomical right knee and eagle talon on anatomical left foot
Somber uncanny historical omen, explicit fictional reconstruction
monster-of-ravenna.aura: Uncanny, solemn and portentous Renaissance historical wonder

basis_claims.quote: The Monster of Ravenna was a possibly apocryphal late Renaissance-era monstrous birth whose appearance in early 1512 near the city of Ravenna was widely reported in contemporary European pamphlets and diaries.

statement.id: Monster Ravenna adalah kelahiran aneh dari akhir masa Renaisans, mungkin apokrif, yang kemunculannya di dekat Ravenna awal 1512 banyak dilaporkan dalam pamflet dan catatan harian Eropa masa itu.
statement.en: The Monster of Ravenna was a possibly apocryphal monstrous birth of the late Renaissance whose appearance near Ravenna in early 1512 was widely reported in European pamphlets and diaries of the time.

basis_claims.quote: Images of its grotesque features were interpreted symbolically by opponents of both the Catholic Church and the Protestant Reformation, although a more common explanation at the time was that the beast was an omen regarding the outcome of the Battle of Ravenna (1512).

statement.id: Gambaran rupanya yang aneh ditafsirkan secara simbolis oleh penentang Gereja Katolik maupun Reformasi Protestan, tetapi penjelasan yang lebih umum saat itu ialah bahwa makhluk itu pertanda hasil Pertempuran Ravenna (1512).
statement.en: Its grotesque features were read symbolically by opponents of both the Catholic Church and the Protestant Reformation, though the commoner explanation then was that it was an omen of the Battle of Ravenna (1512).

basis_claims.quote: Landucci described it to possess features such as a single horn, the wings of a bat, hermaphroditic genitalia, an eye on its right knee and a clawed left foot like an eagle's.

statement.id: Luca Landucci menggambarkannya bertanduk satu, bersayap kelelawar, berkelamin ganda, bermata di lutut kanan, dan berkaki kiri bercakar seperti elang.
statement.en: Luca Landucci described a single horn, bat wings, hermaphrodite genitals, an eye on the right knee and a clawed left foot like an eagle's.

additional_sources.title: Luca Landucci, A Florentine Diary from 1450 to 1516, translated by Alice de Rosen Jervis (1927)
additional_sources.purpose: Primary diary directly checked from downloaded PDF. Confirms two bat wings instead of arms, eye on right knee and eagle-like left foot; prevents mixing with later monopod variants.

shellycoat.depicted_variant: Long-haired shell-covered river prankster with visibly webbed feet
visual_requirements: Long coarse hair over whole body, covered with shells and sea debris
Two fully visible broad membrane-webbed feet establish source-supported nonhuman anatomy
Two shaggy arms and two legs, full body uncropped, no invented animal head
Scottish riverbank setting and mischievous relatively harmless trickster aura
shellycoat.aura: Strange playful and amused river trickster, mysterious but relatively harmless

basis_claims.quote: In Scottish and Northern English folklore, a shellycoat (also called spellycoat) is a prankster water spirit that haunts rivers and streams. They are mainly described on the east coast of Scotland.

statement.id: Shellycoat (spellycoat), roh air jahil folklor Skotlandia (Scottish, Scotland) dan Inggris Utara (Northern English); sungai; pesisir timur.
statement.en: Shellycoat (spellycoat), a prankster water spirit of Scottish and Northern English folklore; rivers; east coast.

basis_claims.quote: The shellycoat is said to have long hair all over its body, along with webbed feet. The hair is covered in shells and other ocean debris, making a clattering sound as it moves. They are similar to a tangie, which is covered in seaweed.

statement.id: Bulu panjang, kaki berselaput, tertutup cangkang yang berderak; mirip tangie.
statement.en: Long hair, webbed feet, covered in clattering shells; like a tangie.

basis_claims.quote: Shellycoats are considered to be relatively harmless compared to other water spirits like the kelpie. They may mislead wanderers, particularly those they think are trespassing upon the creature's territory, but without malice. A common tactic of a shellycoat would be to cry out as if drowning and then laugh like a horse at the distracted victim.

statement.id: Tak berbahaya dibanding kelpie; menyesatkan tanpa niat jahat; berteriak seperti tenggelam lalu tertawa seperti kuda.
statement.en: Harmless compared to the kelpie; misleads without malice; cries as if drowning, laughs like a horse.

basis_claims.quote: Das Klappern der Muscheln verrät dem aufmerksamen Wanderer seine Anwesenheit.

statement.id: Artikel de: derak cangkang menandakan kehadirannya.
statement.en: de article: the clatter of shells reveals its presence.

aloja-mythology.depicted_variant: Water-blackbird (dipper) animal transformation of Catalan aloja
visual_requirements: One natural dipper bird: one head, one beak, two folded wings, two feet, one short tail
Cold blue Pyrenean stream freshwater habitat
No human anatomy or invented avian hybrid
Generally kind nocturnal water-spirit aura
aloja-mythology.aura: Quiet kind mysterious freshwater fairy in animal guise

basis_claims.quote: In Catalan mythology an aloja ... also known as dona d'aigua, goja or paitida, is a feminine being that lives in places with fresh water. These "water-women" are said to be able to turn into water blackbirds.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Katalan, aloja (juga dona d'aigua, goja, atau paitida) adalah makhluk perempuan yang tinggal di tempat berair tawar dan konon dapat menjelma menjadi burung air (dipper).
statement.en: In Catalan mythology an aloja (also dona d'aigua, goja or paitida) is a female being living where there is fresh water, said to be able to turn into a water blackbird (dipper).

basis_claims.quote: According to myth, water-women are nocturnal; have shimmering gold or red hair, and emerald or deep blue eyes; wear fine, rich clothes; and enjoy viewing their reflections in lakes on full-moon nights.

statement.id: Mereka makhluk malam berambut emas atau merah berkilau, bermata hijau zamrud atau biru tua, berpakaian indah, dan suka bercermin di danau pada malam bulan purnama.
statement.en: They are nocturnal, with shimmering gold or red hair and emerald or deep blue eyes, wear fine clothes and like to see their reflection in lakes on full-moon nights.

basis_claims.quote: Son genios que favorecen los nacimientos y la fertilidad, dadoras de vida y regeneradoras constantes de la naturaleza. Son en general benévolas, aunque debe tenerse prudencia si uno se las encuentra.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, mereka roh yang mendukung kelahiran dan kesuburan, pemberi kehidupan dan pemulih alam, umumnya baik hati meski perlu berhati-hati bila bertemu mereka.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article they are spirits favouring births and fertility, life-givers and renewers of nature, generally kindly though one should be careful on meeting them.

basis_claims.quote: Habitan siempre cerca de aguas gélidas y azules: los estanques del Pirineo, torrentes y saltos de agua, fuentes de los bosques, pozas, manantiales, grutas húmedas, y corrientes y lagos subterráneos.

statement.id: Mereka selalu tinggal dekat air biru yang dingin: danau Pyrenees, sungai deras dan air terjun, mata air hutan, kolam, gua lembap, dan sungai serta danau bawah tanah.
statement.en: They always live near cold blue waters: Pyrenean tarns, torrents and waterfalls, forest springs, pools, damp caves and underground streams and lakes.

nonhuman_features: Wholly avian body with wings, beak, bird feet and feathered tail
aloja-mythology.historical_basis: Research explicitly describes aloja turning into water blackbird/dipper and dwelling near Pyrenean freshwater.
artistic_changes: Natural white-throated brown dipper plumage rendered as species interpretation
Moonlit river setting and painterly lighting

abada.depicted_variant: Research-attested blue-skinned two-horned green-haired forest-protector variant of Äbädä
visual_requirements: Blue-skinned humanoid forest guardian with exactly two large horns
Green hair and beard; one carried plain wooden club
One head, two arms and two legs; full uncropped horn/body silhouette
Harmless protective forest guardian aura
abada.aura: Watchful peaceful woodland protector rather than aggressive demon

basis_claims.quote: He protects the birds, trees, and animals of the forest; he appears in the shape of a human with blue skin, two great horns, green hair, and a long green beard across his face, carrying a club or whip indicating his mastery of the forest.

statement.id: Sumber yang sama juga menyebutnya pelindung burung, pohon, dan hewan hutan yang berwujud manusia berkulit biru, bertanduk dua besar, berambut dan berjanggut hijau, serta membawa gada atau cambuk.
statement.en: The same source also calls it a protector of the forest's birds, trees and animals, appearing as a blue-skinned human with two great horns, green hair and beard, carrying a club or whip.

basis_claims.quote: Əbədə — türk və tatar mifologiyasında ağac cini. Meşələrdə yaşayır. İnsanlara zərər verməz. Yaşlı bir qadın görümündədir.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Turki dan Tatar, Əbədə adalah jin pohon yang tinggal di hutan, tidak mencelakai manusia, dan berwujud perempuan tua.
statement.en: In Turkic and Tatar mythology Əbədə is a tree spirit that lives in forests, harms no one and looks like an old woman.

basis_claims.quote: Meşələrdə yerlərdəki qurumuş ağac yarpaqlarından gələn çıtırtılar onun ayaq səsləridir.

statement.id: Gemeresik daun kering di tanah hutan adalah suara langkah kakinya.
statement.en: The rustling of dry leaves on the forest floor is the sound of her footsteps.

nonhuman_features: Two large anatomical horns emerging from scalp
Blue nonhuman skin and green hair/beard in explicit alternate research description
abada.historical_basis: Current researched alternate description c02 specifies blue skin, two great horns, green hair/beard and club/whip. Other recorded variant is old woman; this depicts alternate, not universal form.
artistic_changes: Exact horn curve, garment and forest lighting are contemporary interpretation

selkie.depicted_variant: Scottish Northern Isles selkie in complete seal form
visual_requirements: Entire nonhuman seal anatomy
Two foreflippers and two hindflippers
Seal muzzle, whiskers and continuous marine body
selkie.aura: Otherworldly, watchful and melancholy maritime freedom

basis_claims.quote: Selkies are mythological creatures that can shapeshift between seal and human forms by removing or putting on their seal skin. They feature prominently in the oral traditions and mythology of various cultures, especially those of Celtic and Norse origin.

statement.id: Selkie makhluk mitologi yang berubah wujud antara anjing laut (seal) dan manusia dengan melepas atau memakai kulitnya; menonjol dalam tradisi Kelt dan Nordik (Celtic, Norse).
statement.en: Selkies shapeshift between seal and human by removing or donning their seal skin; prominent in Celtic and Norse tradition.

basis_claims.quote: Selkies are mainly associated with the Northern Isles of Scotland, where they are said to live as seals in the sea but shed their skin to become human on land.

statement.id: Selkie terutama dikaitkan dengan Northern Isles Skotlandia (Scotland), hidup sebagai anjing laut dan melepas kulit menjadi manusia di darat.
statement.en: Selkies are mainly tied to Scotland's Northern Isles, living as seals and shedding skin to be human on land.

basis_claims.quote: Selkies have a dual nature: they can be friendly and helpful to humans, but they can also be dangerous and vengeful. Selkies are often depicted as attractive and seductive in human form, and many stories involve selkies having romantic or sexual relationships with humans, sometimes resulting in children.

statement.id: Selkie bersifat ganda, ramah atau berbahaya dan pendendam; menarik dalam wujud manusia, sering berhubungan cinta dengan manusia dan beranak.
statement.en: Selkies are dual-natured, friendly or dangerous and vengeful; seductive in human form, often in love affairs with humans that produce children.

nonhuman_features: Entire nonhuman seal anatomy
Two foreflippers and two hindflippers
Seal muzzle, whiskers and continuous marine body
selkie.historical_basis: Reviewed claims describe selkie folk living as seals and shedding skin only to become human.
selkie.artistic_changes: Artist-selected rocky coast, lighting and composition; no added anatomical traits.

additional_sources.title: National Museums Scotland: selkie manuscript and folklore
additional_sources.purpose: Museum publishes 1800 manuscript seal illustration and confirms seal-form selkie folk.

galtxagorriak.depicted_variant: Source-attested winged red-trousered Basque household spirit; paired veined wing fans
visual_requirements: Two bilateral wing fans with four clearly visible veined wing panels, anatomical wings rooted behind shoulders
Red trousers, small worker house-spirit identity
One head, two arms/two legs, wing silhouette readable full body
Industrious energetic helpful but mischievous aura
galtxagorriak.aura: Energetic industrious mischievous Basque household helper

basis_claims.quote: Galtxagorriak (singular Galtxagorrii, Basque pronunciation: [ɡaltʃagoriak]), also called Galtzagorrii or Prakagorris, are a type of iratxoak (imp) or house spirit in Basque folklore. The name "Galtxagorriak" translates to "red-pants".

statement.id: Galtxagorriak (tunggal Galtxagorrii), disebut juga Galtzagorrii atau Prakagorris, adalah sejenis iratxoak (makhluk kecil) atau roh rumah dalam cerita rakyat Basque; namanya berarti "celana merah".
statement.en: Galtxagorriak (singular Galtxagorrii), also called Galtzagorrii or Prakagorris, are a kind of iratxoak (imp) or house spirit in Basque folklore; the name means "red pants".

basis_claims.quote: Galtxagorriak are described as tiny, sometimes winged, humanoids wearing red pants. In folklore, they can be kept in boxes, pincushions, and other containers.

statement.id: Mereka digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip manusia yang sangat kecil, kadang bersayap, bercelana merah, dan dapat disimpan dalam kotak, bantalan jarum, atau wadah lain.
statement.en: They are described as tiny, sometimes winged humanoids wearing red pants that can be kept in boxes, pincushions and other containers.

basis_claims.quote: They can complete tasks extremely quickly, and can become angry if they run out of chores or are given a truly impossible task.

statement.id: Mereka dapat menyelesaikan tugas dengan sangat cepat, tetapi marah bila kehabisan pekerjaan atau diberi tugas yang benar-benar mustahil.
statement.en: They complete tasks extremely quickly but get angry if they run out of chores or are given a truly impossible task.

nonhuman_features: Anatomical functional wings emerging from back, explicit winged variant
galtxagorriak.historical_basis: Current research c02 explicitly describes sometimes-winged small humanoids in red pants kept in boxes; c04 emphasizes fast work.
artistic_changes: Four-panel veined insect-wing arrangement interpreted because source says winged without specifying morphology or wing count
Workshop scene and small box establish household-worker setting

visual_requirements: Exactly one large central anatomical eye and no second eye
One youthful small yokai body with two arms and two legs
Broad bamboo kasa and paper lantern in rain
Mild uncanny rain-servant aura
amefurikozo.aura: Mild uncanny and dutiful rain-servant presence

basis_claims.quote: Amefurikozō (雨降小僧, 雨降り小僧) is a type of Japanese yōkai.

statement.id: Amefurikozō adalah jenis yōkai Jepang.
statement.en: Amefurikozō is a Japanese yōkai.

basis_claims.quote: There is a depiction of this yōkai in Sekien Toriyama's collection of yōkai drawing the Konjaku Gazu Zoku Hyakki, and they can also be seen in the kibyōshi among other publications of the same era.

statement.id: Makhluk ini digambar dalam koleksi Toriyama Sekien dan muncul pula dalam kibyōshi.
statement.en: It appears in Toriyama Sekien’s collection and in kibyōshi.

basis_claims.quote: In the kibyōshi "Gozonji no Bakemono (御存之化物)" by Jihinari Sakuragawa and illustrated by Utagawa Toyokuni published in Kansei 4 (1792), when a man walks on a rainy night, a one-eyed amefurikozō wearing a bamboo kasa would step up possessing something in both its hands.

statement.id: Salah satu kibyōshi tahun 1792 menggambarkannya bermata satu dan memakai topi bambu saat hujan.
statement.en: A kibyōshi from 1792 depicts it as one-eyed and wearing a bamboo hat in the rain.

nonhuman_features: Single large central cyclopean eye instead of normal paired human eyes
amefurikozo.historical_basis: 1792 Jihinari Sakuragawa/Utagawa Toyokuni kibyoshi describes a one-eyed Amefurikozō wearing bamboo kasa in the rain; lantern belongs to established rain-servant depictions.
artistic_changes: Composition, clothing colour and woodland setting are artistic rendering; the single-eye anatomy follows the documented variant.

toyotama-hime.depicted_variant: Nihon Shoki dragon manifestation of Toyotama-hime
visual_requirements: Complete nonhuman long serpentine Japanese sea-dragon body
One dragon head and one tapering tail
Four clawed dragon limbs, no human torso or face
Wingless maritime dragon silhouette

basis_claims.quote: Daughter of the sea kami Watatsumi, Toyotamabime was the consort of Hohodemi and mother of Ugayafukiaezu.

statement.id: Toyotama-hime adalah putri Watatsumi, istri Hohodemi, dan ibu Ugayafukiaezu.
statement.en: Toyotama-hime is Watatsumi’s daughter, Hohodemi’s consort, and Ugayafukiaezu’s mother.

basis_claims.quote: Detailed accounts of her marriage and motherhood are provided by both Kojiki and Nihongi.

statement.id: Perkawinan dan keibuannya dikisahkan dalam Kojiki dan Nihon Shoki.
statement.en: Her marriage and motherhood appear in the Kojiki and Nihon Shoki.

basis_claims.quote: Enraged and shamed that she had been seen in this form, Toyotamabime returned to her ocean home

statement.id: Karena malu terlihat dalam wujud itu, ia kembali ke laut.
statement.en: Shamed at being seen in that form, she returned to the sea.

basis_claims.quote: in Kojiki, this was her original form, but the main text of Nihongi states that she became a dragon

statement.id: Kojiki dan teks utama Nihon Shoki berbeda tentang wujudnya; yang terakhir menyebut naga.
statement.en: The Kojiki and main Nihon Shoki text differ; the latter says dragon.

nonhuman_features: Complete nonhuman long serpentine Japanese sea-dragon body
One dragon head and one tapering tail
Four clawed dragon limbs, no human torso or face
Wingless maritime dragon silhouette
toyotama-hime.historical_basis: Nihon Shoki explicitly describes Toyotama-hime transformed into a dragon; full marine dragon manifestation chosen instead of human princess or mixed wani/shark reading.
artistic_changes: Painterly long Japanese dragon anatomy, sea-shore staging, scale colors and twilight lighting interpret the named dragon manifestation; no childbirth or human figures.

additional_sources.title: Nihongi Part 1, W. G. Aston translation
additional_sources.locator: Toyo-tama-hime childbirth and return to sea passage

additional_sources.title: British Museum historic catalogue of Japanese and Chinese paintings

apsara.depicted_variant: Adrika, a high-ranking apsara transformed into a fish in the Mahabharata
visual_requirements: One entirely fish-bodied apsara in the Yamuna
One fish head, continuous fish body, paired pectoral fins, one caudal tail
River water and serene luminous but sorrowful transformation aura
No human upper torso or mermaid anatomy
apsara.aura: Serene luminous celestial grace within a sorrowful enchanted river transformation

basis_claims.quote: Apsaras (Sanskrit: अप्सरस्, IAST: Apsaras, Khmer: អប្សរា, Pali: अच्छरा, romanized: Accharā, Thai: อัปสร) are a class of celestial beings in Hindu and Buddhist culture. They were originally a type of female spirit associated with clouds and water, but, later came to play the role of a "nymph" or "fairy".

statement.id: Apsara adalah kelompok makhluk perempuan surgawi dalam tradisi Hindu dan Buddha.
statement.en: Apsaras are a class of celestial female beings in Hindu and Buddhist traditions.

basis_claims.quote: The apsaras are described as being beautiful, youthful and elegant, and are said to be able to change their shape at will; making anyone fall for their beauty. There are two types of apsaras—laukika (worldly) and daivika (divine). They are said to excel at dancing, and are often considered the wives of the gandharvas, the court musicians of Indra.

statement.id: Sebagian kisah memberi mereka kemampuan mengubah wujud.
statement.en: Some accounts give them the ability to change shape.

basis_claims.quote: Famous apsaras include Urvashi, Menaka, Rambha, Tilottama and Ghritachi.

statement.id: Urvashi, Menaka, Rambha, Tilottama, dan Ghritachi termasuk apsara yang dikenal.
statement.en: Urvashi, Menaka, Rambha, Tilottama, and Ghritachi are among the known apsaras.

nonhuman_features: Complete fish-body transformation rather than humanlike dancer
Aquatic fins and caudal tail with no arms/legs
apsara.historical_basis: Mahabharata Adi Parva identifies high-ranking apsara Adrika living in Yamuna waters, transformed into a fish by a Brahmana's curse; later freed. Existing apsara c04 documents shapeshifting, with this specific form supplied by primary text.
artistic_changes: Fish species, warm olive/gold scales, lighting and pose are unspecified aesthetic choices; no anthropomorphic hybrid anatomy added.

additional_sources.title: Mahabharata, Ganguli translation, Adi Parva p175 (1884)
additional_sources.evidence: Direct primary epic translation explicitly names Adrika as a high-ranking Apsara transformed into a fish.

Wary mysterious cursed-dwarf transformation aura
dwarf-folklore.aura: Wary secretive supernatural freshwater dweller under ancient curse

basis_claims.quote: Diversity in appearance is not only seen between dwarfs throughout time and region but also with individual dwarfs, who can be capable of changing their shape and size, such as in Reginsmál, in which the dwarf Andvari lived as a pike in the water due to curse from a Norn

statement.id: Kurcaci dapat berubah bentuk dan ukuran; dalam Reginsmál kurcaci Andvari hidup sebagai ikan tombak (pike) karena kutukan Norn.
statement.en: Individual dwarfs can change shape and size; in Reginsmál the dwarf Andvari lived as a pike due to a Norn's curse.

nonhuman_features: Wholly piscine pike form of named dwarf Andvari
dwarf-folklore.historical_basis: Category research explicitly names Andvari pike transformation. Reginsmál primary text independently describes same named dwarf in pike form, so this is one named category example rather than universal dwarf anatomy.
artistic_changes: Natural northern-pike olive markings and underwater lighting
No human face, crown or hybrid features added

additional_sources.title: Reginsmál, Guðni Jónsson edition
additional_sources.supports: Andvari is a dwarf who lives in the waterfall in pike form (í geddu líki).

hobgoblin.depicted_variant: Puck/Robin Goodfellow transformed into a hound in Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream
visual_requirements: One entirely canine hound body
One head, four legs/paws, one tail
Lively mischievous night-roaming woodland appearance
No human-form Puck or hybrid invented anatomy
hobgoblin.aura: Playful trickster mischief and alert nocturnal fairy energy

basis_claims.quote: A hobgoblin is a household spirit, appearing in English folklore, once considered helpful, but which since the spread of Christianity has often been considered mischievous. Shakespeare identifies the character of Puck in his A Midsummer Night's Dream as a hobgoblin.

statement.id: Hobgoblin roh rumah tangga cerita rakyat Inggris (English folklore), dulu penolong, sejak Kristen (Christianity) dianggap jahil; Shakespeare menyebut Puck dalam A Midsummer Night's Dream hobgoblin; di Britania Raya.
statement.en: A hobgoblin is a household spirit of English folklore, once helpful, since Christianity seen as mischievous; Shakespeare calls Puck in A Midsummer Night's Dream a hobgoblin.

basis_claims.quote: While brownies are more peaceful creatures, hobgoblins are more fond of practical jokes. They also seem to be able to shapeshift, as seen in one of Puck's monologues in A Midsummer Night's Dream.

statement.id: Hobgoblin lebih gemar bercanda daripada brownie dan tampaknya bisa berubah wujud, seperti monolog Puck.
statement.en: Hobgoblins like pranks more than brownies and seem able to shapeshift, as in a monologue by Puck.

basis_claims.quote: De même Hob est le diminutif de Robert/Robin, rattachant peut-être le hobgoblin au Robin Goodfellow (Puck).

statement.id: Hob nama kecil Robert/Robin, mungkin mengaitkan hobgoblin dengan Robin Goodfellow (Puck).
statement.en: Hob is a diminutive of Robert/Robin, perhaps linking the hobgoblin to Robin Goodfellow (Puck).

nonhuman_features: Fully canine transformation: quadruped body, muzzle, paws and tail
hobgoblin.historical_basis: Shakespeare identifies Robin Goodfellow/Puck as a hobgoblin; Act 3 Scene 1 explicitly lists hound among his chosen forms.
artistic_changes: Hound breed is unspecified in the text; generic lean hound, walnut coat, pose, forest path and moonlight are aesthetic choices.

additional_sources.title: Folger Shakespeare Library — A Midsummer Night's Dream, Act 3 Scene 1
additional_sources.evidence: Puck says he will appear as a horse, hound, hog, headless bear or fire; this image selects hound.

obake.depicted_variant: Animated object obake: one-legged umbrella artifact-spirit subtype
visual_requirements: One open old Japanese paper/bamboo umbrella as main living body
Exactly one leg ending in one foot/sandal, full silhouette
No ordinary actor or human face/torso
Mischievous old-object spirit aura
obake.aura: Playful uncanny mischievous abandoned object awakened

basis_claims.quote: In the literal sense, bakemono are things that change, referring to a state of transformation or shapeshifting.

statement.id: Makna harfiah bakemono mengacu pada sesuatu yang berubah.
statement.en: Bakemono literally refers to things that change or transform.

basis_claims.quote: There are many kinds of ghosts in Japan, including household objects that come to life, animals with supernatural powers, wicked demons and the vengeful spirits of cruelly-wronged women.

statement.id: Museum mencakup benda hidup, hewan gaib, setan, dan roh pendendam dalam penjelasannya.
statement.en: The museum lists animated objects, supernatural animals, demons, and vengeful spirits.

basis_claims.quote: People, animals, even inanimate objects such as neglected or abandoned containers can become obake (this type of obake is known as a tsukumogami and appears often in Japanese folklore).

statement.id: Manusia, hewan, dan benda yang ditinggalkan dapat menjadi obake; jenis benda itu disebut tsukumogami.
statement.en: People, animals, and neglected objects can become obake; the object form is called tsukumogami.

nonhuman_features: Umbrella object replaces torso/head
Single functional leg rather than human anatomy
obake.historical_basis: Research obake category includes transformed objects/tsukumogami. Met museum catalog documents specific one-legged umbrella-monster artifact spirit, generally mischievous.
artistic_changes: Render animated umbrella itself rather than historical kabuki actor
Paper texture, one simple foot and scene are contemporary interpretation; no unspecified face/eye added

additional_sources.title: One-Legged Umbrella Monster (Kasa ippon ashi)
additional_sources.supports: 1857 artifact-spirit umbrella monster; the article explains abandoned objects become ghosts/monsters and one-legged role is mischievous.

wiederganger.depicted_variant: Rhineland Aufhocker werewolf form of returning-dead spirit
visual_requirements: One distinctly lupine head with long wolf muzzle and pointed ears
Coherent furry werewolf body with two arms and two legs
Four limbs and one body, no extra heads/limbs or horns
Uncanny threatening revenant nighttime aura
wiederganger.aura: Dreadful oppressive returning-dead werewolf manifestation stalking a night path

basis_claims.quote: is a term for a revenant and different ghost phenomena from different cultural areas, meaning "re-walker", or by extension, "one who walks again"; cognate to Scandinavian gjenganger ("again-walker"). ... They usually cause problems and frighten living people.

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Jerman, Wiedergänger adalah istilah untuk mayat hidup dan berbagai fenomena hantu dari beragam budaya, berarti "yang berjalan lagi", sekerabat dengan kata Skandinavia gjenganger; mereka biasanya menimbulkan masalah dan menakuti orang hidup.
statement.en: In German, Wiedergänger is a term for revenants and various ghost phenomena from different cultures, meaning 're-walker' or 'one who walks again', cognate with Scandinavian gjenganger; they usually cause problems and frighten the living.

basis_claims.quote: Als Wiedergänger, auch in der Schreibweise Widergänger belegt, werden verschiedene Gespenstererscheinungen aus diversen Kulturräumen bezeichnet. ... Der Kern des Wiedergänger-Mythologems ist die Vorstellung von Verstorbenen, die – oft als körperliche Erscheinung („Untote“) – in die Welt der Lebenden zurückkehren. Sie sind den Lebenden unheimlich und meist böse gesinnt

statement.id: Wiedergänger, juga ditulis Widergänger, adalah sebutan untuk berbagai penampakan hantu dari beragam budaya; inti mitosnya adalah orang mati yang kembali ke dunia orang hidup, sering dalam wujud jasmani (Untote), dan mereka menyeramkan serta biasanya berniat jahat.
statement.en: Wiedergänger, also spelled Widergänger, denotes various ghostly apparitions from many cultures; its core is the idea of the dead returning to the living, often in bodily form (undead), uncanny and usually ill-disposed.

basis_claims.quote: Andere Untote stiegen dem Volksglauben nach aus den Gräbern und sprangen nächtlichen Wanderern auf den Rücken. Diesen Aufhocker, der auch verschiedene Gestalten annehmen konnte, zum Beispiel im Rheinland die des Werwolfs, musste der Mensch tragen ... Dabei wurde der Aufhocker (auch „Huckop“ oder „Huckupp“ genannt) immer schwerer, und das Opfer brach schließlich erschöpft oder gar tot zusammen.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, mayat hidup lain keluar dari kubur dan melompat ke punggung pengembara malam; Aufhocker ini, yang bisa berubah rupa, misalnya menjadi manusia serigala di Rheinland, harus digendong dan makin berat sampai korban ambruk kelelahan atau mati.
statement.en: In folk belief other undead rose from graves and jumped onto night walkers' backs; this Aufhocker, which could take various shapes such as a werewolf in the Rhineland, had to be carried and grew heavier until the victim collapsed exhausted or dead.

nonhuman_features: Wolf head and furry lupine anatomy in source-attested werewolf manifestation
wiederganger.historical_basis: Research c04 specifically states back-riding Aufhocker returning dead could take werewolf form in Rhineland. Depict that same documented subtype, not unrelated wolf companion.
artistic_changes: Furry upright werewolf anatomy and exact head/body proportions interpreted from unspecified werewolf form
No visible victim/back-riding attack; stalking posture instead

aufhocker.depicted_variant: Aufhocker in explicitly attested wholly canine dog guise
visual_requirements: One complete dog body, one head, two ears, four canine legs/paws, one tail
No human body or costume
Ominous deceptive night-path pressure-spirit atmosphere
aufhocker.aura: Guarded ominous deceptive nocturnal pressure spirit

basis_claims.quote: The aufhocker ( German: [ˈaʊfˌhɔkɐ] ) or huckup ( German: [ˈhʊkˌʔʊp] ) is a shapeshifter in German folklore.

statement.id: Aufhocker atau huckup adalah makhluk pengubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat Jerman (German).
statement.en: The aufhocker or huckup is a shapeshifter of German folklore.

basis_claims.quote: The victims often die of exhaustion because the Aufhocker cannot be shaken off or killed. However, it is believed that travelers can free themselves if they are able to make it home before being killed. These attacks often occur in specific locations such as bridges, crossroads, springs, woods, on a path through a hollow, and cemeteries.

statement.id: Korban sering mati kelelahan karena Aufhocker tak bisa dienyahkan atau dibunuh, tetapi pejalan bisa bebas bila sempat sampai di rumah; serangan terjadi di jembatan, persimpangan, mata air, hutan, jalan cekung, dan pemakaman.
statement.en: Victims often die of exhaustion as the Aufhocker cannot be shaken off or killed, but travellers can free themselves by reaching home; attacks occur at bridges, crossroads, springs, woods, hollow paths and cemeteries.

basis_claims.quote: Der Aufhocker (niederdeutsch Huckup, sorbisch Bubak) ist in der Mythologie ein koboldartiger Druckgeist, der Wanderern, die nachts noch unterwegs sind, auf die Schultern oder den Rücken springt und mit jedem Schritt schwerer wird. ... Der Aufhocker bleibt auf dem Wanderer sitzen, bis dieser durch das heraufbrechende Licht, ein Gebet oder Glockenläuten von ihm erlöst wird

statement.id: Aufhocker (Jerman Hilir Huckup, Sorbia Bubak) adalah roh penekan mirip kobold yang melompat ke bahu atau punggung pejalan malam dan makin berat di setiap langkah; ia tetap duduk di sana sampai pejalan dibebaskan oleh cahaya fajar, doa, atau dentang lonceng.
statement.en: The Aufhocker (Low German Huckup, Sorbian Bubak) is a kobold-like pressure spirit that leaps onto the shoulders or back of night travellers and grows heavier each step; it stays there until the traveller is freed by dawn light, a prayer or bells.

basis_claims.quote: Manchmal treten die Aufhocker zunächst als mitleiderregende alte Frauen in Erscheinung; sie können aber auch Tiergestalten wie Bär, Kalb (wie beim Bahkauv), Werwolf (wie beim Stüpp) oder Hund (wie beim Sürthgens Mossel) annehmen.

statement.id: Aufhocker kadang muncul sebagai perempuan tua yang memancing iba, tetapi juga bisa berwujud hewan seperti beruang, anak sapi (Bahkauv), manusia serigala (Stüpp), atau anjing.
statement.en: Aufhockers sometimes first appear as pitiable old women, but can also take animal forms such as a bear, calf (Bahkauv), werewolf (Stüpp) or dog.

nonhuman_features: Complete quadruped canine anatomy instead of human apparition
aufhocker.historical_basis: Reviewed research records Aufhocker animal guises including dog; nighttime crossings and oppressive malevolent activity are also documented. This selects one animal guise, not a universal fixed form.
artistic_changes: Black shaggy canine coat, watchful posture, moonlit stone-bridge staging and painterly texture are artistic choices.

puck-folklore.depicted_variant: Robin Goodfellow/Puck in filly-foal animal likeness from A Midsummer Night's Dream 2.1
visual_requirements: Complete young horse animal form
Four equine legs and hooves
One horse head, two ears, one mane and tail

basis_claims.quote: In English folklore, The Puck (/ˈpʌk/), also known as Goodfellows, are demons or fairies which can be domestic sprites or nature sprites.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Inggris (English folklore), Puck (Goodfellows) demon atau peri, roh rumah atau roh alam; di Britania Raya.
statement.en: In English folklore, the Puck (Goodfellows) are demons or fairies, domestic or nature sprites.

basis_claims.quote: Puck may also be called The Goodfellows or Hobgoblin, in which Hob may substitute for Rob or Robin. This goes back to the character "Robin Goodfellow" and his name.

statement.id: Puck juga disebut Goodfellows atau Hobgoblin, Hob pengganti Rob atau Robin, dari Robin Goodfellow; seperti the good folk, untuk menyenangkan peri.
statement.en: Puck is also called the Goodfellows or Hobgoblin, Hob for Rob or Robin, from Robin Goodfellow.

nonhuman_features: Complete young horse animal form
Four equine legs and hooves
One horse head, two ears, one mane and tail
puck-folklore.historical_basis: Folger primary Shakespeare text identifies Robin Goodfellow as Puck and describes him neighing in likeness of a filly foal.
artistic_changes: Chestnut coat, playful pose, woodland path and muted walnut/gold/green painterly color are artistic choices; no satyr traits, wings or borrowed púca horror variant.

additional_sources.title: William Shakespeare, A Midsummer Night's Dream, Act 2 scene 1
additional_sources.purpose: Primary play explicitly describes Robin Goodfellow's filly-foal likeness.

ikiryo.depicted_variant: Lady Rokujō's living spirit transformed into hannya ogre in Aoi no Ue
visual_requirements: Actual horned hannya ogre face
Two brow horns and two prominent fangs
Two arms and two legs, no extra limbs
Living spirit's bodily demonic transformation, not human wearing mask
ikiryo.aura: Tormented, fiercely jealous and vengeful aristocratic spirit

basis_claims.quote: It was believed that a soul could leave the body of a living person, do mischief and return. Such occurrence was called ikiryō.

statement.id: Ikiryō adalah jiwa orang hidup yang diyakini dapat keluar, mengganggu, lalu kembali.
statement.en: Ikiryō was believed to be a living person’s soul that could leave, cause trouble, and return.

basis_claims.quote: Aoi-no-ue (Lady Aoi), the formal wife of Hikaru Genji and a daughter of the Sadaijin (the Senior Minister of State) family, has been possessed by a phantom and seriously ill.

statement.id: Dalam Aoi no Ue, Lady Aoi sakit karena kerasukan roh.
statement.en: In Aoi no Ue, Lady Aoi is gravely ill after possession by a phantom.

basis_claims.quote: The phantom, who is trapped by the priestess's prayer and appears, is the vengeful spirit of Rokujō-no-miyasudokoro (Lady Rokujō)

statement.id: Roh yang muncul adalah roh pendendam Lady Rokujō.
statement.en: The phantom is Lady Rokujō’s vengeful spirit.

basis_claims.quote: When the priest starts a sacred invocation, the jealousy in Lady Rokujō's heart embodies itself as a female ogre.

statement.id: Dalam lakon, kecemburuan Rokujō menjelma raksasa perempuan.
statement.en: In the play, Rokujō’s jealousy takes the form of a female ogre.

nonhuman_features: Actual horned hannya ogre face
Two brow horns and two prominent fangs
Two arms and two legs, no extra limbs
Living spirit's bodily demonic transformation, not human wearing mask
ikiryo.historical_basis: Reviewed c08 and firsthand Noh performance documentation depict Lady Rokujō's ikiryō changing into terrifying hannya demon in Aoi no Ue.
artistic_changes: Painterly literal rendering of dramatic demon visage rather than photograph of an actor; full figure, palette and setting artistic. Horns and fangs follow hannya iconography.

additional_sources.title: Aoi no Ue PhotoStory, Toshiro Morita performance photographs
additional_sources.purpose: Primary performance documentation explicitly identifies living spirit Lady Rokujō's transformation into hannya.

additional_sources.title: Tokyo National Museum: Noh Masks and Costumes for Lady Aoi
additional_sources.purpose: Museum identifies Hannya mask in Aoi no Ue iconography.

bergmonch.depicted_variant: Bergmönch long-necked horse apparition recorded by the Brothers Grimm
visual_requirements: Complete nonhuman horse body
Abnormally long horse neck
Four equine legs with hooves and one horse tail
Wild frightening horse eyes
bergmonch.aura: Dangerous, erratic and uncanny mine guardian

basis_claims.quote: The Bergmönch ("mountain monk"; German: [ˈbɛʁkˌmœnç] ) is a mountain spirit from German folklore. He is also known as Meister Hämmerling ("master hammering guy").

statement.id: Bergmönch ("biarawan gunung") adalah roh gunung dari cerita rakyat Jerman (German), juga dikenal sebagai Meister Hämmerling.
statement.en: The Bergmönch ('mountain monk') is a mountain spirit of German folklore, also called Meister Hämmerling.

basis_claims.quote: He has white hair and fiery looking eyes as large as dining plates. The mountain spirit wears a black hooded cowl as used by monks; this gave rise to his name Bergmönch. He also can be dressed like a miner. As such he is called Meister Hämmerling. Additionally, he can take the shape of a horse with long neck and terrible looking eyes, and is also able to become invisible.

statement.id: Bergmönch berambut putih, bermata menyala sebesar piring, berjubah bertudung hitam seperti biarawan; ia bisa berpakaian penambang (Meister Hämmerling), menjelma kuda berleher panjang, dan menjadi tak terlihat.
statement.en: The Bergmönch is white-haired, with fiery plate-sized eyes and a black monk's hooded cowl; he can dress as a miner (Meister Hämmerling), become a long-necked horse and turn invisible.

basis_claims.quote: The residence of the Bergmönch are pits and mines in the mountains. There he is active as well deep in the pits as up on the surface. Especially on Fridays this mountain spirit is very busy. He fills the excavated ores from one bucket to another.

statement.id: Bergmönch tinggal di lubang dan tambang di pegunungan, aktif di kedalaman maupun permukaan, terutama sibuk pada hari Jumat (Fridays) memindahkan bijih dari satu ember ke ember lain.
statement.en: The Bergmönch dwells in mountain pits and mines, active deep down and at the surface, busiest on Fridays, moving ore from one bucket to another.

basis_claims.quote: The mountain spirit generally is an erratic and dangerous being. His breath is poisonous, able to kill twelve people at once.

statement.id: Roh gunung ini umumnya makhluk yang tak menentu dan berbahaya; napasnya beracun dan dapat membunuh dua belas orang sekaligus.
