statement.id: Dōsojin adalah kelompok dewa pelindung Shinto yang dihormati di Jepang timur.
statement.en: Dōsojin are protective Shinto deities venerated in eastern Japan.

basis_claims.quote: Dōsojin are often represented as a human couple, carved male or female genitals, large stones or statues, or even tall poles along a road.

statement.id: Wujudnya dapat berupa pasangan manusia, batu, arca, atau tiang di tepi jalan.
statement.en: They may be represented by a human couple, stones, statues or roadside poles.

basis_claims.quote: Dōsojin are sometimes housed in small roadside Shinto shrines called hokora.

statement.id: Sebagiannya ditempatkan di kuil kecil pinggir jalan yang disebut hokora.
statement.en: Some are housed in small roadside shrines called hokora.

basis_claims.quote: In rural areas Dōsojin can be found at village boundaries, in mountain passes, or along byways, and in urban areas they can be seen at street corners or near bridges.

statement.id: Dōsojin dapat ditemui di batas desa, celah gunung, persimpangan, dan dekat jembatan.
statement.en: Dōsojin are found at village borders, mountain passes, crossroads and bridges.

nonhuman_features: Protective roadside deities represented by carved human couple at village border; no anatomical deformation claimed
dosojin.historical_basis: Dōsojin may be represented by a human couple carved on roadside stones and venerated at village boundaries, crossroads or mountain passes. Depicts this documented symbolic form rather than inventing an anthropomorphic monster.
artistic_changes: Exact facial features, costume folds, stone carving composition, architecture, spectral rendering and illumination are artistic choices; documented morphology retained.

yume-no-seirei.depicted_variant: Sawaki Suushi 1737 Hyakkai Zukan thin aged dream spirit with cane and fading lower body
visual_requirements: Very thin old man with sparse flowing hair
Loose white robe leaving upper ribs visible; cane and beckoning hand
Lower body clearly fading away
yume-no-seirei.aura: Eerie quiet dream intrusion and dissolving apparition

basis_claims.quote: He appears in the Hyakkai zukan (Illustrated volume of a hundred demons) created by Sawaki Sūshi in 1737.

statement.id: Hyakkai Zukan karya Sawaki Suushi tahun 1737 memuat sosok ini.
statement.en: Sawaki Suushi’s 1737 Hyakkai Zukan includes this figure.

basis_claims.quote: Artists depict yume no seirei as an emaciated, elderly man.

statement.id: Sosok ini berwujud lelaki tua sangat kurus.
statement.en: The figure has the appearance of a very thin old man.

basis_claims.quote: He wears a loose white robe, which reveals his frail body and exposed ribcage.

statement.id: Pakaian putihnya yang longgar membiarkan rusuk terlihat.
statement.en: His loose white clothing leaves the ribs visible.

basis_claims.quote: His thin wispy hair flows behind him in a ghostly motion.

statement.id: Ia memiliki rambut jarang yang terurai.
statement.en: He has flowing sparse hair.

basis_claims.quote: In his right hand he holds a cane and with his left he reaches out, beckoning.

statement.en: He carries a cane and beckons with his other hand.
statement.id: Ia membawa tongkat dan melambaikan tangan lainnya.

basis_claims.quote: The bottom half of his body eerily fades away as if he is disappearing.

statement.en: His lower body appears to fade away.
statement.id: Tubuh bagian bawahnya tampak memudar.

nonhuman_features: Nightmare spirit depicted as thin aged man whose lower body fades away; no anatomical deformation beyond documented fading claimed
yume-no-seirei.historical_basis: Based on Sawaki Suushi's 1737 Hyakkai Zukan dream-spirit depiction described by BYU: gaunt old man, sparse flowing hair, loose white clothing with visible ribs, cane and beckoning hand, fading lower body. No added monstrous traits.
artistic_changes: Exact facial features, costume folds, stone carving composition, architecture, spectral rendering and illumination are artistic choices; documented morphology retained.

additional_sources.title: YUME NO SEIREI | BYU BAKEMONO | BYU Library

abcan.depicted_variant: Irish Tuatha Dé Danann dwarf poet-musician in bronze boat with tin sail
visual_requirements: One compact human-shaped Irish dwarf musician
Bronze boat and visibly silvery tin sail
Otherworld waters without unsupported physical deformation
abcan.aura: Quiet resonant Irish Otherworld river journey

basis_claims.quote: In Irish mythology, Abcán (modern spelling: Abhcán) was the dwarf poet and musician of the Tuatha Dé Danann, the early Celtic divinities of Ireland. He was said to have a bronze boat with a tin sail.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Irlandia (Irish), Abcán (Abhcán) penyair dan musisi kerdil Tuatha Dé Danann, dewa Kelt (Celtic) Irlandia (Ireland); perahu perunggu berlayar timah; di Irlandia.
statement.en: In Irish mythology Abcán (Abhcán) was the dwarf poet and musician of the Tuatha Dé Danann, early Celtic gods of Ireland; he had a bronze boat with a tin sail.

basis_claims.quote: Se le describe como un poeta y músico enano al servicio de los Tuatha Dé Danann, las primeras deidades celtas de Irlanda.

statement.id: Penyair dan musisi kerdil (poeta y músico enano) yang melayani Tuatha Dé Danann.
statement.en: A dwarf poet and musician (poeta y músico enano) serving the Tuatha Dé Danann.

nonhuman_features: Tuatha Dé Danann dwarf poet-musician with bronze boat and tin sail; no anatomical deformation claimed
abcan.historical_basis: Abcán is documented as dwarf poet and musician of the Tuatha Dé Danann who has a bronze boat with a tin sail. A small harp is an artistic musician attribute, not a claim about a prescribed historical instrument.
artistic_changes: Specific faces, clothing, bronze boat/tin sail construction, harp choice, cave geometry and lighting are artistic visualization; harp is not asserted as a historical prescribed instrument.

treuer-eckart.depicted_variant: Elderly staff-bearing guardian spirit warning at Hörselberg/Venusberg entrance
visual_requirements: One elderly human-shaped guardian with staff
Hörselberg cave entrance
Warning gesture rather than violence
treuer-eckart.aura: Stern protective warning at an uncanny mountain gate

basis_claims.quote: The rich treasure of the Harlungs, the Harlungenhort, is said to be enchanted and hidden inside the mountain Bürglenberg near Breisach. This treasure is guarded by the spirit of treuer Eckart who warns every treasure seeker that this treasure is fated to fall into the hands of the true heir of the Harlungs

statement.id: Harta Harlung (Harlungenhort) konon disihir dan disembunyikan di gunung Bürglenberg dekat Breisach, dijaga arwah Eckart yang memperingatkan setiap pemburu harta bahwa harta itu ditakdirkan bagi ahli waris sejati; dari sini lahir pepatah "Du bist der treue Eckart, du warnest jedermann".
statement.en: The Harlungs' treasure (Harlungenhort) is said to be enchanted in the Bürglenberg near Breisach, guarded by Eckart's spirit, who warns every treasure-seeker that it is fated for the true heir; hence the saying 'Du bist der treue Eckart, du warnest jedermann'.

basis_claims.quote: In Thuringia, der treue Eckart is connected with the wild hunt, locally called wütendes Heer or furious host. Leader of the wild hunt is Frau Holle ... who roams the countryside with the furious host during Christmas, namely the Zwölften, that is the Twelve Nights of Christmas. Der treue Eckart goes ahead of the wild hunt, warning the people to step out of the way so they will suffer no harm.

statement.id: Di Thüringen (Thuringia), Eckart terkait dengan Perburuan Liar (wild hunt; wütendes Heer) yang dipimpin Frau Holle pada Dua Belas Malam Natal (Twelve Nights of Christmas); ia berjalan di depannya, menyuruh orang menyingkir agar tidak celaka.
statement.en: In Thuringia Eckart is tied to the Wild Hunt (wütendes Heer) led by Frau Holle over the Twelve Nights of Christmas; he goes ahead of it, telling people to step aside so they come to no harm.

basis_claims.quote: His appearance is that of an old man with a staff. When the furious host doesn’t travel and stays inside Hörselberg Mountain, der treue Eckart sits outside the cave, warning everybody against entering the realm of Frau Venus from where there is no return.

statement.id: Ia berwujud lelaki tua bertongkat; saat rombongan itu tinggal di dalam gunung Hörselberg, Eckart duduk di luar gua memperingatkan semua orang agar tidak memasuki alam Frau Venus (Venusberg), tempat tiada jalan kembali.
statement.en: He looks like an old man with a staff; when the host stays inside the Hörselberg, Eckart sits outside the cave warning all against entering the realm of Frau Venus (the Venusberg), whence none return.

nonhuman_features: Faithful guardian spirit warning travellers away from Venusberg/Wild Hunt; no anatomical deformation claimed
treuer-eckart.historical_basis: German legend portrays faithful Eckart as an old man with staff guarding the Hörselberg/Venusberg cave and warning travellers. Uses that source-described appearance without converting him into a physical monster.
artistic_changes: Specific aged face, rough medieval costume, staff shape, cave geometry and warm interior light are artistic visualization of the documented old-man guardian.

ysatters-kajsa.depicted_variant: Lagerlöf joyful Närke wind witch at whirlwind centre with cloud-whirling hair and duststorm skirt
visual_requirements: One joyful human-shaped wind witch/troll
Hair swirling among clouds and skirt sweeping like dust storm
Swedish gale landscape, no invented troll anatomy
ysatters-kajsa.aura: Exuberant mischievous wind and vigorous Swedish weather

basis_claims.quote: In bygone days there was something in Närke the like of which was not to be found elsewhere: it was a witch, named Ysätter-Kaisa.

statement.id: Lagerlöf: dahulu di Närke ada sesuatu yang tak ditemukan di tempat lain, yaitu penyihir (witch) bernama Ysätter-Kaisa.
statement.en: Lagerlöf: in bygone days Närke had something found nowhere else, a witch named Ysätter-Kaisa.

basis_claims.quote: She would then stand in the centre of the whirlwind. Her long hair would whirl among the clouds, while her skirt would drag on the ground like a dust storm.

statement.id: Ia berdiri di tengah angin puyuh (whirlwind), rambutnya berputar di antara awan (clouds), roknya menyeret seperti badai debu (dust storm).
statement.en: She stood in the centre of the whirlwind, her hair whirling among the clouds, her skirt dragging like a dust storm.

basis_claims.quote: Ysätters-Kajsa was not a dark and gloomy troll, but a happy and playful one. What she liked most was a real gale.

statement.id: Ysätters-Kajsa bukan troll muram, melainkan riang dan suka bermain (playful), dan paling menyukai angin badai (gale).
statement.en: Ysätters-Kajsa was not a gloomy troll but a happy, playful one who most liked a real gale.

basis_claims.quote: People noticed that she was hardest on people who were quarrelsome, mean and wicked, but she would often take honest folks and small poor children into her care.

statement.id: Ia paling keras terhadap orang yang suka bertengkar dan jahat, tetapi melindungi orang jujur dan anak-anak miskin.
statement.en: She was hardest on the quarrelsome and wicked, but cared for honest folk and poor children.

nonhuman_features: Playful supernatural wind being standing at whirlwind centre with hair in clouds and duststorm skirt; no anatomical deformation claimed
ysatters-kajsa.historical_basis: Lagerlöf's literary account of Närke's Ysätter-Kaisa describes her joyful gale-loving nature, hair among clouds and skirt dragging like a duststorm. Physical interpretation retains normal woman-shaped form; does not invent modern troll horns or tails.
artistic_changes: Specific woman face and dress, whirlwind shape, distant farm landscape and illumination are artistic interpretation. Enlarged visual presentation against landscape conveys wind personification and is not asserted as a separate literal giant-height claim.

additional_sources.title: The Wonderful Adventures of Nils (terj. Velma Swanston Howard)
additional_sources.author: Lagerlöf

half-elf.depicted_variant: Skuld of Hrólf Kraki's saga, human-elf offspring with returning-army magic
visual_requirements: Skuld represented as human-shaped Danish princess
Saga magic raising warriors depicted discreetly in distance
No modern pointy-ear hybrid convention invented
half-elf.aura: Cold resolute saga sorcery and uncanny returning army

basis_claims.quote: In Norse mythology, a half-elf is the offspring of an elf and a human. Major examples include Skuld and Högni. Högni was a hero in Thidreks saga, born to a human queen when an elf visited her while the king was away. Skuld was a Danish princess, as told in Hrólf Kraki's saga.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, setengah-elf adalah keturunan elf dan manusia; contoh utamanya Skuld dan Högni. Högni adalah pahlawan Thidreks saga yang lahir dari ratu manusia setelah elf mendatanginya saat raja pergi, dan Skuld adalah putri Denmark dalam saga Hrólf Kraki.
statement.en: In Norse mythology a half-elf is the offspring of an elf and a human; major examples are Skuld and Högni. Högni was a Thidreks saga hero born to a human queen visited by an elf while the king was away, and Skuld a Danish princess in Hrólf Kraki's saga.

basis_claims.quote: King Helgi, sleeping alone as he had not been invited to King Adils's wedding, let in a ragged person on a midwinter night. ... She told him he had freed her from a curse and asked to leave. ... three years later the woman, an elf, returned and left a daughter at his door. She told him that the child's name was Skuld, which means "what you should do".

statement.id: Raja Helgi, yang tidur sendirian, membukakan pintu bagi sosok berpakaian compang-camping pada malam pertengahan musim dingin; perempuan itu berkata ia telah dibebaskan dari kutukan, dan tiga tahun kemudian perempuan elf itu kembali dan meninggalkan seorang putri di pintu raja bernama Skuld, yang berarti "apa yang harus kaulakukan".
statement.en: King Helgi, sleeping alone, let in a ragged person on a midwinter night; she said he had freed her from a curse, and three years later the elf-woman returned and left a daughter at his door named Skuld, meaning 'what you should do'.

basis_claims.quote: The scholar Hilda Ellis describes Skuld as evil, recalling that in the saga, Skuld used magic to raise an army against Hrólf, her half-brother. As quickly as Hrólf's warriors kill Skuld's men, they spring up, fighting more strongly than ever.

statement.id: Sarjana Hilda Ellis menggambarkan Skuld sebagai jahat: dalam saga ia memakai sihir untuk membangkitkan pasukan melawan Hrólf, saudara tirinya, dan prajuritnya yang dibunuh segera bangkit dan bertarung lebih kuat.
statement.en: The scholar Hilda Ellis describes Skuld as evil: in the saga she used magic to raise an army against her half-brother Hrólf, and her men sprang up again as fast as they were killed, fighting harder.

nonhuman_features: Elf-human offspring Skuld with saga magic enabling fallen warriors to return; no anatomical deformation claimed
half-elf.historical_basis: Uses saga half-elf Skuld, daughter of human Helgi and elf woman, documented by Hilda Ellis discussion as using magic so her army rises repeatedly. No source claim of pointed ears, wings or hybrid deformities is added.
artistic_changes: Exact human faces, costumes/trim/brooch, landscape, coffin construction, spectral rendering, gesture and illumination are artistic visualization of documented identity and behavior.

nachzehrer.depicted_variant: German underground shroud-chewing human revenant remaining in its coffin
visual_requirements: One undead human-shaped figure staying inside buried coffin
Clearly biting and chewing own shroud edge
No vampire fangs or gore invented

basis_claims.quote: literally "after-consumer" (a creature that consumes from the afterlife) in German; also spelt Nachtzehrer, literally "night-consumer") is a type of Wiedergänger (revenant), which was believed to be able to drag the living after it into death, either through malice or through the desire to be closer to its loved ones through various means.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Jerman, Nachzehrer (harfiah "pemakan sesudah"; juga Nachtzehrer, "pemakan malam") adalah sejenis Wiedergänger (mayat hidup) yang diyakini dapat menyeret orang hidup menyusulnya ke kematian, karena dengki atau karena ingin dekat dengan orang yang dicintainya.
statement.en: In German folklore the Nachzehrer (literally 'after-consumer'; also Nachtzehrer, 'night-consumer') is a type of Wiedergänger (revenant) believed able to drag the living after it into death, from malice or a wish to be closer to loved ones.

basis_claims.quote: This could involve devouring their own funeral shrouds and clothing – thought to be a very common sign of a nachzehrer. The danger was thought to be particularly great if the living had given the deceased some of their own possessions (e.g. as grave goods).

statement.id: Hal ini bisa berupa memakan kain kafan dan pakaiannya sendiri, yang dianggap tanda Nachzehrer yang sangat umum; bahayanya dianggap sangat besar bila orang hidup memberi jenazah sebagian barang miliknya, misalnya sebagai bekal kubur.
statement.en: This could involve eating its own shroud and clothes, thought a very common sign of a Nachzehrer; the danger was held to be especially great if the living had given the dead some of their own possessions, e.g. as grave goods.

basis_claims.quote: Nachzehrer ist eine früher vor allem in der Mark übliche Bezeichnung im deutschen Volksglauben für einen Wiedergänger oder Untoten, der den Vampiren nah verwandt ist

statement.id: Nachzehrer adalah sebutan dalam kepercayaan rakyat Jerman, dulu terutama di Mark, untuk mayat hidup atau Untote yang berkerabat dekat dengan vampir.
statement.en: Nachzehrer is a German folk-belief term, formerly common especially in the Mark, for a revenant or undead being closely related to vampires.

basis_claims.quote: Im Gegensatz zum Vampir, der sein Grab verlassen müsse, liege oder sitze der Nachzehrer unter der Erde und sauge den Lebenden – meistens seinen Hinterbliebenen oder den Bewohnern seines Dorfes – die Lebenskraft ab.

statement.id: Berbeda dari vampir yang harus meninggalkan kubur, Nachzehrer berbaring atau duduk di bawah tanah dan menyedot daya hidup orang hidup, biasanya keluarga yang ditinggalkannya atau warga desanya.
statement.en: Unlike the vampire, which must leave its grave, the Nachzehrer lies or sits underground and drains the life-force of the living, usually its survivors or fellow villagers.

nonhuman_features: Revenant consuming own shroud while remaining underground and draining living; no additional anatomical deformation claimed
nachzehrer.historical_basis: German Nachzehrer belief describes an undead human lying or sitting underground, eating its shroud or clothes, unlike a grave-leaving vampire. This scene depicts that distinctive act without imported fangs, bats or bodily mutilation.
artistic_changes: Exact human faces, costumes/trim/brooch, landscape, coffin construction, spectral rendering, gesture and illumination are artistic visualization of documented identity and behavior.

vard-ger.depicted_variant: Kindly Scandinavian human-shaped spirit predecessor arriving before its matching person
visual_requirements: Human-shaped spirit predecessor at doorway
Matching real person still approaching down path
Neutral benevolent tone, no ominous monster anatomy
vard-ger.aura: Quiet kindly déjà-vu mystery of arrival before arrival

basis_claims.quote: Vardøger, also known as vardyvle or vardyger, is a spirit predecessor in Scandinavian folklore.

statement.id: Vardøger, juga dikenal sebagai vardyvle atau vardyger, adalah roh pendahulu dalam cerita rakyat Skandinavia.
statement.en: Vardøger, also known as vardyvle or vardyger, is a spirit predecessor in Scandinavian folklore.

basis_claims.quote: nearly déjà vu in substance, but in reverse, where a spirit with the subject's footsteps, voice, scent, or appearance and overall demeanor precedes them in a location or activity ... This bears a subtle difference from a doppelgänger, with a less sinister connotation. It has been likened to being a phantom double, or form of bilocation. In Finnish folklore, the concept is known as etiäinen.

statement.id: Kisahnya mirip déjà vu terbalik: roh dengan langkah, suara, bau, atau rupa seseorang mendahuluinya di suatu tempat; berbeda tipis dari doppelgänger dan kurang seram, ia disamakan dengan kembaran gaib atau bilokasi, dan dalam cerita rakyat Finlandia disebut etiäinen.
statement.en: Its stories are like déjà vu in reverse: a spirit with a person's footsteps, voice, scent or looks precedes them; subtly different from the doppelgänger and less sinister, it is likened to a phantom double or bilocation, and in Finnish folklore is called etiäinen.

basis_claims.quote: Si ves un vardøger, según el folclore noruego, eso significa que te estas cruzando en el camino de una persona. A menudo solo quiere decir que esa persona de la cual has visto su vardøger está en camino.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat Norwegia, melihat vardøger berarti kau berpapasan di jalan seseorang, dan sering hanya berarti orang itu sedang dalam perjalanan.
statement.en: According to Norwegian folklore, seeing a vardøger means you are crossing someone's path, and often only that the person is on the way.

basis_claims.quote: originalmente, un vardøger era considerado un fylgja, una especie de espíritu guardián de esa persona.

statement.id: Semula, vardøger dianggap sebuah fylgja, sejenis roh pelindung orang itu.
statement.en: Originally a vardøger was considered a fylgja, a kind of guardian spirit of that person.

basis_claims.quote: Debido a que el vardøger es un tipo de espíritu guardián, se suele decir de aquellos que tienen un vardøger que son buenas personas, ya que un espíritu benéfico les protege. En resumen, podríamos decir que un vardøger es la contraparte de un doppelgänger.

statement.id: Karena vardøger sejenis roh pelindung, orang yang memilikinya biasa disebut orang baik yang dilindungi roh baik; singkatnya vardøger adalah lawan doppelgänger.
statement.en: Since the vardøger is a kind of guardian spirit, people who have one are usually called good people protected by a kindly spirit; in short, the vardøger is the counterpart of a doppelgänger.

nonhuman_features: Premonitory spirit double arriving before the actual person with matching appearance; no anatomical deformation claimed
vard-ger.historical_basis: Scandinavian Vardøger is a spirit predecessor bearing the appearance or footsteps/voice of a person before they arrive, with less sinister and sometimes guardian connotations. Matching human figures visualize temporal precedence; no animal form or demonic deformity inferred.
artistic_changes: Exact human faces, costumes/trim/brooch, landscape, coffin construction, spectral rendering, gesture and illumination are artistic visualization of documented identity and behavior.

al-basty.depicted_variant: Turkic/Caucasus ugly female nightmare spirit with long yellow hair
visual_requirements: Preserve aged female human anatomy, long yellow hair and pressing hand on adult sleeper chest.
Preserve modest hair/shadow concealment and existing pose/counts/scene.
No emitted generic aura, crimson fog or outline; presence from natural moonlight/chamber shadow.
al-basty.aura: Oppressive nightmare presence through gaunt stare, looming posture, chest pressing, deep chamber shadows and natural moonlight.

basis_claims.quote: or Al Kardai is an ancient female spirit, the personification of guilt, found in folklore throughout the Caucasus mountains, with origins going as far back as Sumerian mythology.

statement.id: Al Basty atau Al Kardai adalah roh perempuan kuno, personifikasi rasa bersalah, dalam cerita rakyat di seluruh Pegunungan Kaukasus, dengan asal-usul yang ditarik hingga mitologi Sumeria.
statement.en: Al Basty or Al Kardai is an ancient female spirit, the personification of guilt, in folklore across the Caucasus, with origins traced back to Sumerian mythology.

basis_claims.quote: злые женские духи в мифологии тюркских и некоторых соседних с ними народов.

statement.id: Albasty adalah roh perempuan jahat dalam mitologi bangsa Turkik dan beberapa bangsa tetangganya.
statement.en: Albasty are evil female spirits in the mythology of Turkic and some neighbouring peoples.

basis_claims.quote: Обычно представляется в виде уродливой обнажённой женщины с длинными распущенными жёлтыми волосами и обвислыми грудями.

statement.id: Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan telanjang buruk rupa dengan rambut kuning panjang tergerai dan payudara menggantung.
statement.en: She is usually pictured as an ugly naked woman with long loose yellow hair and sagging breasts.

basis_claims.quote: Является во снах и душит сдавливая грудь.

statement.id: Ia muncul dalam mimpi dan mencekik dengan menekan dada.
statement.en: She appears in dreams and smothers people by pressing on the chest.

al-basty.aura_policy: Character presence through positioning, framing, expression, scene atmosphere and natural lighting. No generic magical envelope, emitted halo, neon outline, energy ribbons or luminous colored mist. Magical effects only where source-described physical traits, manifestations or documented abilities warrant them, and only to an appropriate degree.

aura_revision.rationale: Original actually inspected: unsupported dense crimson luminous fog curls around female body; source nightmare pressing/red name do not justify emitted aura.

artistic_changes: Character presence conveyed by pose, composition, scene atmosphere and natural lighting; effects only where the source supports them.

slavic-dragon.depicted_variant: General single-headed winged-serpent dragon form, excluding regional multihead and human variants
visual_requirements: one snake-like head
long serpentine body and paired wings
Preserve existing source anatomy, count, scale and modest framing.
Character presence through pose, composition, atmosphere and natural scene lighting; no generic emitted aura.
Storm/weather and tail lake siphoning supported c05/c09; no emitted aura.
slavic-dragon.aura: Majesty through massive winged-serpent silhouette and violent storm over lake.

basis_claims.quote: A Slavic dragon is any dragon in Slavic mythology, including the Polish żmij, Russian zmei (or zmey;

statement.id: Naga Slavia adalah naga mana pun dalam mitologi Slavia, termasuk żmij dari Polandia dan zmei (zmey, змей) dari Rusia.
statement.en: A Slavic dragon is any dragon in Slavic mythology, including the Polish żmij and the Russian zmei (zmey, змей).

basis_claims.quote: The physiognomy resembles a combination of the classical dragon and a snake (as a winged serpent), less often depicted with two legs and/or more than one head.

statement.id: Wujudnya menyerupai perpaduan naga klasik dan ular (sebagai ular bersayap), lebih jarang digambarkan berkaki dua dan/atau berkepala lebih dari satu.
statement.en: Its appearance combines the classical dragon and a snake (a winged serpent), less often shown with two legs and/or more than one head.

basis_claims.quote: Some of the common motifs concerning Slavic dragons include their identification as masters of weather or water sources; that they start life as snakes; and that both the male and female can be romantically involved with humans.

statement.id: Motif umum tentang naga Slavia antara lain perannya sebagai penguasa cuaca atau sumber air, asal-usulnya sebagai ular, dan bahwa naga jantan maupun betina bisa menjalin cinta dengan manusia.
statement.en: Common motifs include Slavic dragons as masters of weather or water sources, their start in life as snakes, and both males and females having romances with humans.

basis_claims.quote: There is the notion (thought to be inspired by the tornado) of a Slavic dragon that dips its tail into a river or lake and siphons up the water, ready to cause floods.

statement.id: Ada gagasan (yang diduga diilhami angin puting beliung) tentang naga Slavia yang mencelupkan ekornya ke sungai atau danau dan menyedot airnya, siap menimbulkan banjir.
statement.en: There is a notion (thought to be inspired by tornadoes) of a Slavic dragon that dips its tail into a river or lake and siphons up water, ready to cause floods.

slavic-dragon.aura_policy: Character presence through positioning, framing, expression, scene atmosphere and natural lighting. No generic magical envelope, emitted halo, neon outline, energy ribbons or luminous colored mist. Magical effects only where source-described physical traits, manifestations or documented abilities warrant them, and only to an appropriate degree.

statement.id: Menurut kebanyakan cerita, arwah perempuan muda yang mati di atau dekat sungai atau danau kembali menghantui perairan itu; rusalka mayat hidup ini tidak selalu jahat dan dapat mati dengan tenang bila kematiannya dibalas.
statement.en: Most stories say the soul of a young woman who died in or near a river or lake returns to haunt it; this undead rusalka is not always malevolent and may die in peace if her death is avenged.

basis_claims.quote: Her main purpose is, however, to lure young men, seduced by either her looks or her voice, into the depths of said waterways where she would entangle their feet with her long hair and submerge them.

statement.id: Tujuan utamanya adalah memikat pemuda dengan rupa atau suaranya ke kedalaman perairan, lalu menjerat kaki mereka dengan rambut panjangnya dan menenggelamkan mereka.
statement.en: Her main purpose is to lure young men with her looks or voice into the depths, entangle their feet in her long hair and drown them.

basis_claims.quote: The rusalki were believed to be at their most dangerous during the 'Rusalka week' ... in early June. At this time, they were supposed to have left their watery depths in order to swing on branches of birch and willow trees by night.

statement.id: Rusalka dipercaya paling berbahaya pada Pekan Rusalka di awal Juni, ketika mereka keluar dari air untuk berayun di dahan pohon birch dan willow pada malam hari.

statement.id: Artikel es: Tzitzimite, kurcaci bertopi besar yang memberi serenade; mengepang rambut di malam hari.
statement.en: es article: Tzitzimite, a dwarf with a huge hat who serenades women; braids hair at night.

basis_claims.quote: is a mythological giant hero who lived on the Estonian island of Saaremaa.

statement.id: Tõll yang Agung adalah pahlawan raksasa mitologis yang tinggal di Pulau Saaremaa, Estonia.
statement.en: Toell the Great is a mythological giant hero who lived on the Estonian island of Saaremaa.

basis_claims.quote: Suur Tõll lived with his wife Piret in the coastal village of Tõlluste (Tölluste) by the Baltic Sea. He tossed huge rocks everywhere, mostly aiming for his archenemy Vanatühi (The Devil) or other enemies of the local Saaremaa islanders.

statement.id: Suur Tõll tinggal bersama istrinya, Piret, di desa pesisir Tõlluste di tepi Laut Baltik, dan melemparkan batu besar ke mana-mana, terutama ke arah musuh bebuyutannya Vanatühi (Iblis) atau musuh lain penduduk Saaremaa.
statement.en: Suur Tõll lived with his wife Piret in the coastal village of Tõlluste by the Baltic Sea and tossed huge rocks everywhere, mostly at his archenemy Vanatühi (the Devil) or other enemies of the Saaremaa islanders.

basis_claims.quote: Although Tõll was the king of Saaremaa, he lived as a common farmer. He often visited his brother Leiger on the neighboring Hiiumaa (Dagö) island.

statement.id: Walaupun raja Saaremaa, Tõll hidup sebagai petani biasa; ia sering mengunjungi saudaranya Leiger di pulau tetangga Hiiumaa (Dagö).
statement.en: Though king of Saaremaa, Tõll lived as a common farmer; he often visited his brother Leiger on neighbouring Hiiumaa (Dagö).

basis_claims.quote: He was so tall that he could almost walk there (the Soela Strait has passageways only 2-3m deep, and is about 6km across). His walking stick was a 5 fathom spruce tree trunk.

statement.id: Ia begitu tinggi sehingga hampir bisa berjalan ke sana (Selat Soela hanya sedalam 2–3 m di beberapa jalur dan lebarnya sekitar 6 km); tongkatnya batang cemara sepanjang 5 depa.
statement.en: He was so tall he could almost walk there (the Soela Strait has passages only 2–3 m deep and is about 6 km across); his walking stick was a 5-fathom spruce trunk.

basis_claims.quote: Tõll was always kind and ready to help, but very hot-tempered. He loved to eat cabbage, drink beer, and go to the sauna

statement.id: Tõll selalu baik hati dan siap menolong, tetapi sangat mudah marah; ia gemar makan kubis, minum bir, dan mandi sauna.
statement.en: Tõll was always kind and ready to help but very hot-tempered; he loved cabbage, beer and the sauna.

basis_claims.quote: The wulver or wullver is a kind of wolf-like humanoid creature in the folklore of the Shetland Islands of Scotland.  In modern times, the origin of the wulver has been disputed.

statement.id: Wulver atau wullver adalah makhluk mirip manusia berwujud serigala dalam cerita rakyat Kepulauan Shetland, Skotlandia, yang asal-usulnya kini diperdebatkan.
statement.en: The wulver or wullver is a wolf-like humanoid of the folklore of the Shetland Islands of Scotland, whose origin is now disputed.

basis_claims.quote: The wulver is said by the Shetland folklorist Jessie Saxby to be benevolent, although later accounts state that they became violent if provoked. They were generally friendly to locals, however, and were known to share the fish they caught with them.

statement.id: Menurut folkloris Shetland Jessie Saxby, wulver baik hati, meski kisah lain menyebutnya menjadi buas bila diusik; mereka umumnya ramah kepada warga dan berbagi ikan tangkapannya.
statement.en: The Shetland folklorist Jessie Saxby calls the wulver benevolent, though later accounts say it turned violent if provoked; wulvers were usually friendly to locals and shared the fish they caught.

basis_claims.quote: The Wulver was a creature like a man with a wolf's head. He had short brown hair all over him. His home was a cave dug out of the side of a steep knowe, half-way up a hill.

statement.id: Saxby menulis bahwa wulver seperti lelaki berkepala serigala, berbulu cokelat pendek di seluruh tubuh, dan tinggal di gua di lereng bukit yang curam.
statement.en: Saxby wrote that the wulver was like a man with a wolf's head, covered in short brown hair, living in a cave dug into a steep knoll halfway up a hill.

basis_claims.quote: He was fond of catching and eating fish, and had a small rock in the deep water which is known to this day as the "Wulver's Stane". There he would sit fishing sillaks and piltaks for hour after hour. He was reported to have frequently left a few fish on the window-sill of some poor body.

statement.id: Ia suka menangkap dan memakan ikan dari batu kecil di air dalam yang sampai kini disebut Wulver's Stane, dan sering meninggalkan beberapa ekor ikan di ambang jendela orang miskin.
statement.en: He liked catching and eating fish from a little rock in deep water still called the Wulver's Stane, and often left a few fish on a poor person's windowsill.

basis_claims.quote: On the third blast of his horn the intensity of the force of the sound caused the horn to be broken into small pieces.

basis_claims.quote: is a household divine serpent (gjarpër or bollë) in Albanian mythology and folklore, associated with human destiny, good fortune and the souls of the ancestors. In folk beliefs the household serpent is strongly related to the cult of the hearth (vatër) and it is especially considered the guardian of the family and the house.

statement.id: Vitore adalah ular ilahi penjaga rumah dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Albania, terkait dengan nasib manusia, keberuntungan, dan jiwa para leluhur; dalam kepercayaan rakyat ular rumah ini erat dengan pemujaan perapian (vatër) dan terutama dianggap pelindung keluarga dan rumah.
statement.en: Vitore is a household divine serpent of Albanian mythology and folklore, linked with human destiny, good fortune and the souls of the ancestors; in folk belief the household serpent is closely tied to the cult of the hearth (vatër) and is above all the guardian of the family and house.

basis_claims.quote: The serpent is an animal totem of the Albanians, especially in the north. The belief of the personification of the souls of the ancestors in household serpents has been handed down from prehistoric times.

statement.id: Ular adalah totem hewan orang Albania, terutama di utara, dan kepercayaan bahwa jiwa leluhur menjelma dalam ular rumah diwariskan sejak zaman prasejarah.
statement.en: The serpent is an animal totem of the Albanians, especially in the north, and the belief that ancestral souls are personified in household serpents has come down from prehistoric times.

basis_claims.quote: Vitorja is usually described as a small, colourful and benign golden horned serpent. However, in some traditions Vitorja is described also as an old woman, a mythological figure similar to Nëna e Vatrës. Vitorja is also identified with Fatia in southern folklore and Ora in central and northern folklore.

statement.id: Vitorja biasanya digambarkan sebagai ular kecil berwarna-warni yang baik hati dan bertanduk emas, tetapi dalam sebagian tradisi juga sebagai perempuan tua mirip Nëna e Vatrës; ia juga disamakan dengan Fatia dalam folklor selatan dan Ora dalam folklor tengah dan utara.
statement.en: Vitorja is usually described as a small, colourful, benign golden-horned serpent, but in some traditions also as an old woman similar to Nëna e Vatrës; she is also identified with Fatia in southern folklore and Ora in central and northern folklore.

basis_claims.quote: Si gjarpër, kur Vitorja banon në muret e një shtëpie, besohet se sjell fat, kështu që banorët e trajtojnë me shumë respekt. Pëshpëritja e saj lajmëron ngjarje të rëndësishme për familjen.

statement.id: Sebagai ular, bila Vitorja tinggal di dinding rumah ia dipercaya membawa keberuntungan sehingga penghuni memperlakukannya dengan sangat hormat, dan desisannya menandakan peristiwa penting bagi keluarga.
statement.en: As a serpent, when Vitorja lives in a house's walls she is believed to bring luck, so the household treats her with great respect, and her whispering announces important family events.

basis_claims.quote: meaning "serpent", is a form of dragon in Russian folktales and epic poetry; sometimes, a human-like character with dragon-like traits.

statement.id: Zmei (laki-laki, змей) dan zmeya (perempuan), yang berarti "ular", adalah bentuk naga dalam dongeng dan epos Rusia, kadang tokoh mirip manusia bersifat naga.
statement.en: Zmei (masculine) and zmeya (feminine), meaning "serpent", is a form of dragon in Russian folktales and epic poetry, sometimes a human-like character with dragon traits.

basis_claims.quote: Despite meaning serpent, when referring to dragons, the term zmei always implicitly refers to the flying kind all over Russia.

statement.id: Walau berarti ular, bila merujuk naga istilah zmei di seluruh Rusia selalu menyiratkan jenis yang terbang.
statement.en: Despite meaning serpent, when used of dragons zmei always implies the flying kind all over Russia.

basis_claims.quote: Змей Горы́ныч — русский фольклорный змей (дракон), похищающий женщин. Змей Горыныч обитает обычно в горах, нередко у огненной реки и стережёт «Калинов мост», по которому попадают в царство мёртвых.

statement.id: Zmey Gorynych adalah naga cerita rakyat Rusia yang menculik perempuan; ia biasanya tinggal di pegunungan, sering dekat sungai api, dan menjaga Jembatan Kalinov menuju alam orang mati.
statement.en: Zmey Gorynych is a Russian folk dragon who abducts women; he usually lives in the mountains, often by a fiery river, guarding the Kalinov Bridge to the realm of the dead.

basis_claims.quote: Многоголовость Змея — непременная его черта. Число голов обычно кратно трём, чаще всего их бывает 3, 6, 9 или 12 ... Чаще всего Змей предстаёт трёхглавым. ... В большинстве случаев у Змея отмечается способность к полёту, но о крыльях его, как правило, ничего не говорится. Так, во всём сборнике русских народных сказок Александра Афанасьева лишь один раз сообщается об «огненных крыльях»

statement.id: Kepala banyak adalah ciri tetap Zmey, biasanya kelipatan tiga (3, 6, 9, 12); paling sering berkepala tiga; umumnya dapat terbang tetapi sayapnya jarang disebut; dalam seluruh kumpulan dongeng Afanasyev "sayap api" hanya disebut sekali.
statement.en: Many heads are the Zmey's constant trait, usually multiples of three (3, 6, 9, 12); most often three-headed; he usually flies but his wings are rarely mentioned; in Afanasyev's whole collection "fiery wings" appear only once.

basis_claims.quote: According to Asturian mythology, the Nuberu (also known in Western Asturias as Reñubeiru or Xuan Cabritu) is the divinity of clouds and storms.

statement.id: Menurut mitologi Asturias, Nuberu (di Asturias barat juga Reñubeiru atau Xuan Cabritu) adalah dewa awan dan badai.
statement.en: In Asturian mythology the Nuberu (in western Asturias also Reñubeiru or Xuan Cabritu) is the god of clouds and storms.

basis_claims.quote: Fishermen fear the Nuberu because they blame him for the strong north-western winds of the Cantabrian Sea, which forces them to return hurriedly to port, where worried people await them.

statement.id: Para nelayan takut pada Nuberu karena menyalahkannya atas angin barat laut kencang di Laut Cantabria yang memaksa mereka bergegas pulang ke pelabuhan.
statement.en: Fishermen fear the Nuberu, blaming him for the strong north-westerly winds of the Cantabrian Sea that drive them hurriedly back to port.

basis_claims.quote: In Cantabrian mythology, the Nuberus are often a multitude of little creatures, not a single one. They are described as small, chubby and mischievous, with devilish grins in their demonic faces and little black wings.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Cantabria, nuberu sering berupa banyak makhluk kecil yang gemuk dan nakal, berwajah iblis menyeringai dan bersayap hitam kecil.
statement.en: In Cantabrian mythology the Nuberus are often many little creatures, small, chubby and mischievous, with devilish grins and little black wings.

basis_claims.quote: In Slavic mythology, a werewolf is a human-shapeshifter who temporarily takes the form of a wolf. Werewolves were often described as ordinary wolves, though some accounts noted peculiarities in appearance or behavior that hinted at their human origin. Werewolves retain human intelligence but cannot speak.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, manusia serigala adalah manusia pengubah wujud yang untuk sementara berwujud serigala; ia sering digambarkan seperti serigala biasa dengan beberapa keanehan yang menandakan asal manusianya, tetap berakal manusia tetapi tidak dapat berbicara.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology a werewolf is a human shapeshifter who temporarily takes wolf form; often described as an ordinary wolf with some oddities betraying its human origin, it keeps human intelligence but cannot speak.

basis_claims.quote: Ваўкалак, ваўкалака — чалавек, ператвораны ў ваўка, пярэварацень.

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Belarus, vaŭkalak atau vaŭkalaka adalah manusia yang diubah menjadi serigala, sang pengubah wujud.
statement.en: In Belarusian, the vaŭkalak or vaŭkalaka is a person turned into a wolf, a shapeshifter.

basis_claims.quote: These werewolves were believed to lack control in wolf form, attacking livestock and even humans, including loved ones, and were sometimes associated with cannibalism. Ancient beliefs linked werewolves to celestial events like eclipses.

statement.id: Manusia serigala jenis ini dipercaya tidak dapat mengendalikan diri dalam wujud serigala, menyerang ternak bahkan manusia, termasuk orang terkasih, dan kadang dikaitkan dengan kanibalisme; kepercayaan kuno juga mengaitkannya dengan gerhana.
statement.en: Such werewolves were thought to lose control in wolf form, attacking livestock and even people, loved ones included, and were sometimes tied to cannibalism; ancient beliefs also linked them with eclipses.

basis_claims.quote: is a bathhouse (banya) spirit in Slavic mythology. He is usually described as a small, naked old man with a long beard, his body covered in the birch leaves left over from well used bath brooms.

statement.id: Bannik adalah roh rumah mandi (banya) dalam mitologi Slavia, biasanya digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua kecil telanjang berjanggut panjang yang tubuhnya tertutup daun birch sisa sapu mandi.
statement.en: The bannik is a bathhouse (banya) spirit of Slavic mythology, usually a small naked old man with a long beard, covered in birch leaves from used bath brooms.

basis_claims.quote: Er soll hinter oder unter dem Ofen leben. Normalerweise ist er unsichtbar und manchmal hat er die Form eines kleinen, schmutzigen alten Mannes mit langen Haaren und einem Bart und großen Händen. Es kann sich in Tiere wie Katzen, Hunde, Hasen und Frösche verwandeln.

statement.id: Ia konon tinggal di belakang atau di bawah tungku; biasanya tak kasatmata, kadang berwujud lelaki tua kecil yang kotor berambut panjang, berjanggut, dan bertangan besar, serta bisa berubah menjadi kucing, anjing, kelinci, dan katak.
statement.en: He is said to live behind or under the stove; he is usually invisible, sometimes a small dirty old man with long hair, a beard and big hands, and can turn into cats, dogs, hares and frogs.

basis_claims.quote: Da die Banja ein dunkler, potenziell gefährlicher Ort ist, wird der Bannik als schelmisches, manchmal schädliches Wesen angesehen.

statement.id: Karena banya tempat yang gelap dan berpotensi berbahaya, bannik dipandang sebagai makhluk usil yang kadang mencelakai.
statement.en: Because the banya is a dark, potentially dangerous place, the bannik is seen as a mischievous, sometimes harmful being.

basis_claims.quote: Dormarch or possibly Dormarth is a hound, normally used to assist hunters by tracking or chasing the animal that is being hunted, however in Welsh mythology Dormarch's master is Gwynn ap Nudd although formerly owned by Maelgwn Gwynedd, a 6th-century king of Gwynedd.

statement.id: Dormarch atau mungkin Dormarth adalah seekor anjing pemburu; dalam mitologi Welsh tuannya adalah Gwynn ap Nudd, walau dulu dimiliki Maelgwn Gwynedd, raja Gwynedd abad ke-6.
statement.en: Dormarch, or possibly Dormarth, is a hound; in Welsh mythology Dormarch's master is Gwynn ap Nudd, though it was formerly owned by Maelgwn Gwynedd, a 6th-century king of Gwynedd.

basis_claims.quote: Dormarch has a single head, two front legs, and a body that narrows rapidly from the chest and terminates in three fish-like tails.

statement.id: Dormarch berkepala satu, berkaki depan dua, dan tubuhnya cepat menyempit dari dada lalu berakhir pada tiga ekor mirip ekor ikan.
statement.en: Dormarch has a single head, two front legs, and a body that narrows rapidly from the chest and ends in three fish-like tails.

basis_claims.quote: The Dormarch's natural habitat is described in Welsh as being 'ar wybir', that is 'riding on the clouds' which haunt the mountain peaks.

statement.id: Habitat alami Dormarch dilukiskan dalam bahasa Welsh sebagai 'ar wybir', yaitu 'menunggang awan' yang menyelimuti puncak-puncak gunung.
statement.en: The Dormarch's natural habitat is described in Welsh as 'ar wybir', 'riding on the clouds' that haunt the mountain peaks.

basis_claims.quote: gathering the souls of fallen British warriors with the help of his hounds, thereby making Dormarch a member of the Cŵn Annwn, the 'Hounds of Annwn'.

statement.id: Gwyn mengumpulkan arwah prajurit Britania yang gugur dengan bantuan anjing-anjingnya, sehingga Dormarch tergolong Cŵn Annwn, 'Anjing-Anjing Annwn'.
statement.en: Gwyn gathers the souls of fallen British warriors with the help of his hounds, making Dormarch a member of the Cŵn Annwn, the 'Hounds of Annwn'.

basis_claims.quote: Kikimora is a legendary creature, a female house spirit in Slavic mythology. Her role in the house is usually juxtaposed with that of the domovoy.

statement.id: Kikimora adalah makhluk legenda, roh rumah perempuan dalam mitologi Slavia, yang perannya di rumah biasanya disandingkan dengan domovoi.
statement.en: The kikimora is a legendary creature, a female house spirit in Slavic mythology, whose role in the house is usually set beside the domovoy's.

basis_claims.quote: The kikimora might have the snout of a dog, a chicken beak or can even resemble a goat-like entity with glowing eyes and horns. In fact, it can take any part of an animal's face or body. It is always feminine and can appear as an old woman or a beautiful girl.

statement.id: Kikimora bisa bermoncong anjing, berparuh ayam, atau menyerupai makhluk mirip kambing bermata menyala dan bertanduk; ia bisa memiliki bagian wajah atau tubuh hewan mana pun, selalu perempuan, dan bisa tampak sebagai nenek tua atau gadis cantik.
statement.en: The kikimora may have a dog's snout, a chicken's beak or resemble a goat-like being with glowing eyes and horns; she can have any animal's face or body part, is always female, and may appear as an old woman or a beautiful girl.

basis_claims.quote: When the house is in order, a kikimora looks after the chickens and housework. If not, she whistles, breaks dishes, and makes noises at night. She also comes out at night to spin thread.

statement.id: Bila rumah teratur, kikimora menjaga ayam dan pekerjaan rumah; bila tidak, ia bersiul, memecahkan piring, dan membuat keributan pada malam hari; ia juga keluar pada malam hari untuk memintal benang.
statement.en: When the house is in order a kikimora looks after the chickens and housework; if not, she whistles, breaks dishes and makes noise at night; she also comes out at night to spin thread.

basis_claims.quote: adalah makhluk perempuan dalam mitologi Slavia. Kikimora termasuk dalam makhluk penghun rumah dan kadang-kadang dikatakan menikah dengan Domovoi. Kikimora biasanya tinggal di balik kompor atau di gudang bawah tanah.

statement.id: Kikimora adalah makhluk perempuan mitologi Slavia penghuni rumah, kadang dikatakan menikah dengan Domovoi, dan biasanya tinggal di balik tungku atau di ruang bawah tanah.
statement.en: The kikimora is a female being of Slavic mythology who dwells in houses, is sometimes said to be married to the Domovoi, and usually lives behind the stove or in the cellar.

basis_claims.quote: Barang siapa yang melihat Kikimora sedang menenun maka dia akan segera mati. Untuk menentramkan Kikimora, seseorang harus mencuci semua panci dan wajan dengan teh pakis.

statement.id: Siapa pun yang melihat kikimora sedang menenun akan segera mati; untuk menenangkannya, semua panci dan wajan harus dicuci dengan teh pakis.
statement.en: Whoever sees the kikimora weaving will soon die; to calm her, all pots and pans must be washed with fern tea.

basis_claims.quote: is usually a female demon in Slavic mythology, which stems from the mythological Strix of ancient Rome and ancient Greece. The demon is similar to a vampire, and is predominantly found in Polish and Silesian folklore.

statement.id: Strzyga (jamak strzygi, laki-laki strzygoń; kadang diterjemahkan striga) biasanya iblis perempuan dalam mitologi Slavia yang berasal dari Strix Romawi dan Yunani kuno, mirip vampir, dan terutama ditemukan dalam cerita rakyat Polandia dan Silesia.
statement.en: The strzyga (plural strzygi, male strzygoń; sometimes striga) is usually a female demon of Slavic mythology stemming from the Strix of ancient Rome and Greece, vampire-like, found mainly in Polish and Silesian folklore.

basis_claims.quote: After the 18th century, there was a distinction between strzyga and upiór; the first one was more connected to witchcraft, while the latter was more of a flying, vampiric creature.

statement.id: Setelah abad ke-18 dibedakan antara strzyga dan upiór: yang pertama lebih terkait sihir, yang kedua lebih berupa makhluk vampir yang terbang.
statement.en: After the 18th century strzyga and upiór were distinguished: the first tied more to witchcraft, the second more a flying vampiric creature.

basis_claims.quote: В отличие от вампиров, стрыгоем, согласно силезским поверьям, человек рождался сразу. При жизни стрыга имеет два сердца, две души и два ряда зубов ... Известны случаи, когда за стрыг принимали младенцев, рождавшихся с развитыми зубами. Считалось, что после смерти стрыги одна душа покидала тело, а другая оставалась в нём и продолжала жить в теле в гробу

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan Silesia, strzyga lahir sebagai strzyga; semasa hidup ia punya dua hati, dua jiwa, dan dua baris gigi; bayi yang lahir dengan gigi kadang disangka strzyga; setelah mati satu jiwa pergi dan yang lain tetap hidup di dalam jasad di peti.
statement.en: In Silesian belief a person was born a strzyga; in life she has two hearts, two souls and two rows of teeth; babies born with developed teeth were sometimes taken for strzygi; after death one soul leaves and the other lives on in the body in the coffin.

statement.en: Though some sources call it a dragon, the zmeu is distinct for its human-like traits: legs, arms, making and using weapons, riding a horse and wishing to marry young girls; some commentators class it as a giant (ogre), a devil or a vampire.

basis_claims.quote: In some stories, Zmeu appears in the sky and spits fire, or has the ability to change form. In other stories, it has a magical precious stone on its head that shines like the sun.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa cerita zmeu muncul di langit dan menyemburkan api, atau dapat berubah wujud; dalam cerita lain ia punya batu permata ajaib di kepala yang bersinar seperti matahari.

statement.en: In Romanian mythology the zmeu is a giant being with supernatural powers, the embodiment of evil, always defeated by the forces of good.

basis_claims.quote: Monacello (Italian: [monaˈtʃɛlːo]), or Munaciello (Neapolitan: [munaˈtʃjelːə]), is a sprite from the traditional oral folklore of Naples, Italy.

statement.id: Monacello atau Munaciello (bahasa Neapolitan) adalah peri dari cerita rakyat lisan Napoli, Italia.
statement.en: Monacello, or Munaciello in Neapolitan, is a sprite of the oral folklore of Naples, Italy.

basis_claims.quote: Its name means "little monk" in the Neapolitan language. It gets often described as a "benevolent man, short, stocky, very spiteful" and enjoys visiting houses in the Historic center of Naples. It is thought to wear a long robe with a broad hood on top of it.

statement.id: Namanya berarti "biarawan kecil" dalam bahasa Neapolitan; ia sering digambarkan sebagai "lelaki baik hati, pendek, kekar, sangat usil" yang suka mengunjungi rumah di pusat bersejarah Napoli, mengenakan jubah panjang bertudung lebar.
statement.en: Its name means 'little monk' in Neapolitan; it is often described as a 'benevolent man, short, stocky, very spiteful' who likes visiting houses in Naples' historic centre, wearing a long robe with a broad hood.

basis_claims.quote: According to many tales, he was the caretaker (or "pozzari") of the city's underground aqueducts, canals, and water wells. Monaciello knew every twist and turn in these underground passages and could use the wells to secretly enter the piazzas and homes of Naples.

basis_claims.quote: The asrai is a type of aquatic fairy in English folklore and literature. They are usually depicted as female, live in lakes and are similar to the mermaid and nixie. Rather than originating from folklore, the asrai may have been invented by the Scottish poet Robert Williams Buchanan.

statement.id: Asrai, peri air folklor dan sastra Inggris (English), perempuan, tinggal di danau, mirip putri duyung dan nixie; mungkin ciptaan penyair Skotlandia (Scottish) Robert Williams Buchanan.
statement.en: The asrai, an aquatic fairy of English folklore and literature, female, lake-dwelling, like the mermaid and nixie; possibly invented by Scottish poet Robert Williams Buchanan.

basis_claims.quote: In Buchanan's poetry, the asrai are pale, gentle beings, older than humanity, who fear light and live beneath a lake.

basis_claims.quote: By the time the fisherman reached the shore, the asrai had melted away leaving nothing but a puddle of water in the boat, for the asrai perish if directly exposed too long to the sun.

statement.en: The asrai melted into a puddle when exposed too long to the sun.

basis_claims.quote: Ruth Tongue attributed stories of the asrai to Cheshire, Shropshire, and the Welsh Border. In her collected work, the asrai are timid and shy, very beautiful, and have webbed feet and green hair.

statement.id: Ruth Tongue: Cheshire, Shropshire, perbatasan Wales (Welsh Border); pemalu, cantik, kaki berselaput, rambut hijau; muncul sekali seabad mandi cahaya bulan; nelayan terbakar sentuhannya.
statement.en: Ruth Tongue: Cheshire, Shropshire, the Welsh Border; shy, beautiful, webbed feet, green hair; surfaces once a century to bathe in moonlight; a fisherman burned by its touch.

basis_claims.quote: Om en Asrai nuddar solljuset eller fångas så dör den, och faller ihop i en vattenpöl.

basis_claims.quote: This illusion warns the inhabitants to beware of fire, and the friendly demon, while he terrifies those who see him, puts by his coming the ignorant on their guard.

basis_claims.quote: Marțolea is a demonic entity in Romanian mythology (especially in the regions of Bucovina and Maramureș). The entity's gender is unclear, as it can shapeshift at will. It lives up in the mountains and descends on Tuesday nights to lure with its singing and punish the women caught working.

statement.id: Marțolea adalah entitas demonik dalam mitologi Rumania, terutama di Bucovina dan Maramureș; jenis kelaminnya tidak jelas karena ia bisa berubah wujud sesuka hati, ia tinggal di pegunungan dan turun pada malam Selasa untuk memikat dengan nyanyiannya dan menghukum perempuan yang kedapatan bekerja.
statement.en: Marțolea is a demonic entity of Romanian mythology, especially in Bucovina and Maramureș; its gender is unclear since it can shapeshift at will, and it lives in the mountains and comes down on Tuesday nights to lure with its singing and punish women caught working.

basis_claims.quote: Also known as Marț-sara or Marți Seara (the old Romanian words for "Tuesday Evening"), it is a malefic entity who demands the semi-holy day of Tuesday to be respected and who forbids four women's chores: spinning of the wool, sowing, boiling laundry and baking bread.

statement.id: Dikenal juga sebagai Marț-sara atau Marți Seara ("Selasa Malam" dalam bahasa Rumania lama), ia entitas jahat yang menuntut hari Selasa yang setengah suci dihormati dan melarang empat pekerjaan perempuan: memintal wol, menjahit, merebus cucian, dan memanggang roti.
statement.en: Also called Marț-sara or Marți Seara (old Romanian for "Tuesday Evening"), it is a malefic entity that demands the semi-holy day of Tuesday be respected and forbids four women's chores: spinning wool, sowing, boiling laundry and baking bread.

basis_claims.quote: Usually its form is of a goat with a human-like head, horns and hooves. It can shapeshift into an ugly, old woman dressed all in white, a soldier or as a handsome man. To married women, it shows as an old woman; to married men as a virgin, and to unmarried women as a young charming man.

statement.id: Biasanya ia berwujud kambing berkepala mirip manusia, bertanduk dan berkuku belah; ia bisa menjadi perempuan tua buruk rupa berpakaian serba putih, prajurit, atau lelaki tampan; kepada perempuan bersuami ia tampil sebagai perempuan tua, kepada lelaki beristri sebagai perawan, dan kepada perempuan lajang sebagai pemuda memikat.
statement.en: Usually it has the form of a goat with a human-like head, horns and hooves; it can become an ugly old woman all in white, a soldier or a handsome man; to married women it appears as an old woman, to married men as a virgin, and to unmarried women as a charming young man.

basis_claims.quote: În Dicționar de teme și simboluri de Doina Ruști, Marțolea apare și ca îndrăgostit malefic, care mănâncă inima fetelor de care se îndrăgostește. Zoomorfismele sale îl apropie de Silen, de Pan și de Marte.

statement.id: Dalam Dicționar de teme și simboluri karya Doina Ruști, Marțolea juga tampil sebagai kekasih jahat yang memakan jantung gadis yang ia cintai, dan wujud hewannya mendekatkannya pada Silenus, Pan, dan Mars (Silen, Pan, Marte).
statement.en: In Doina Ruști's Dicționar de teme și simboluri, Marțolea also appears as a malefic lover who eats the hearts of the girls it falls for, and its animal forms bring it close to Silenus, Pan and Mars (Silen, Pan, Marte).

basis_claims.quote: The Ora (Albanian: orë, definite form: ora, pl.: orë/t) is an Albanian mythological figure that every human possesses from birth, associated with human destiny and fate. The essential function of the ora is to maintain the order of the universe and to enforce its laws.

statement.id: Ora (bahasa Albania orë, bentuk takrif ora) adalah tokoh mitologi Albania yang dimiliki setiap manusia sejak lahir, terkait nasib dan takdir; fungsi utamanya menjaga tatanan alam semesta dan menegakkan hukumnya.
statement.en: The Ora (Albanian orë, definite form ora) is an Albanian mythological figure that every human has from birth, tied to destiny and fate; its essential function is to maintain the order of the universe and enforce its laws.

basis_claims.quote: Within Albanian folklore and poetry, the Ora is a protective spirit that every human possesses from birth. The Ora's appearance alters according to the personality and attributes of the human – “a white Ora for the brave and industrious, or a black Ora for the lazy or cowardly.”

statement.id: Dalam folklor dan puisi Albania, Ora adalah roh pelindung yang dimiliki setiap manusia sejak lahir, dan rupanya berubah menurut watak orangnya: Ora putih bagi yang berani dan rajin, Ora hitam bagi yang malas atau pengecut.
statement.en: In Albanian folklore and poetry the Ora is a protective spirit everyone has from birth, and its appearance changes with the person's character: a white Ora for the brave and industrious, a black Ora for the lazy or cowardly.

basis_claims.quote: The Ora reside towards the north of the Drin River in Northern Albania. Within Central Albania it was believed that the Ora were present everywhere, “listening to people’s blessings and curses, which they would then aim to quickly fulfil”. Outside of Central Albania Oras live in forests and mountains, residing in streams, lakes, and caves.

statement.id: Ora berdiam di utara Sungai Drin di Albania Utara; di Albania Tengah mereka dipercaya hadir di mana-mana, mendengarkan berkat dan kutuk orang lalu berusaha cepat mewujudkannya, sedangkan di luar Albania Tengah mereka tinggal di hutan dan gunung, di sungai kecil, danau, dan gua.
statement.en: The Ora dwell north of the Drin River in Northern Albania; in Central Albania they were believed to be everywhere, listening to people's blessings and curses and trying to fulfil them quickly, while outside Central Albania they live in forests and mountains, in streams, lakes and caves.

basis_claims.quote: Within Albanian folklore and poetry, Ora had the ability to take any form they pleased, including “birds, beasts, women, or serpents.” ... In Northern Albania, Oras “often appear as serpents.” – similarly to the Southern Albanian deity Vitore. Both the Ora and Vitore are “widely represented as a serpent with golden horns who brings gold.”

statement.id: Ora bisa mengambil wujud apa pun, termasuk burung, binatang buas, perempuan, atau ular; di Albania Utara mereka sering muncul sebagai ular, seperti dewi Vitore di Albania Selatan, dan keduanya digambarkan sebagai ular bertanduk emas yang membawa emas.
statement.en: The Ora could take any form, including birds, beasts, women or serpents; in Northern Albania they often appear as serpents, like the Southern Albanian deity Vitore, and both are depicted as a golden-horned serpent that brings gold.

statement.en: The Sihuanaba is a supernatural entity of Central American folklore with regional variants in parts of Mexico.

basis_claims.quote: the entity functions as a shapeshifting spirit that adopts the appearance of an attractive, long haired woman to deceive observers from a distance.

statement.id: Ia roh pengubah wujud yang tampil sebagai perempuan menarik berambut panjang untuk menipu orang dari kejauhan.
statement.en: It is a shapeshifting spirit that appears as an attractive long-haired woman to deceive people from afar.

basis_claims.quote: it entices solitary men into isolated or hazardous environments prior to revealing a grotesque true form, commonly represented as a fleshless skull or the head of a horse.

statement.id: Ia memikat pria yang sendirian ke tempat terpencil atau berbahaya, lalu menampakkan wujud aslinya: tengkorak tanpa daging atau kepala kuda.
statement.en: It lures lone men to isolated or dangerous places before revealing its true form, a fleshless skull or a horse's head.

basis_claims.quote: She is commonly encountered washing clothing or bathing in rivers, streams, and other bodies of water.

statement.id: Ia sering dijumpai sedang mencuci pakaian atau mandi di sungai dan perairan lain.
statement.en: She is often met washing clothes or bathing in rivers and other waters.

basis_claims.quote: This sudden revelation is said to induce severe shock, causing victims to either die of fright or descend into madness.

statement.id: Wajah aslinya yang tiba-tiba terlihat konon membuat korban mati ketakutan atau menjadi gila.
statement.en: The sudden sight of her face is said to make victims die of fright or go mad.

basis_claims.quote: Tiddy Mun was a legendary bog spirit in England, who was believed to have the ability to control the waters and mists of The Fens of South Lincolnshire, The Carrs of North Lincolnshire and fens of the Isle of Ely.

statement.id: Tiddy Mun adalah roh rawa legendaris di Inggris yang dipercaya mampu mengendalikan air dan kabut di rawa-rawa South Lincolnshire, The Carrs di North Lincolnshire, dan rawa Isle of Ely.
statement.en: Tiddy Mun was a legendary bog spirit in England believed able to control the waters and mists of the Fens of South Lincolnshire, the Carrs of North Lincolnshire and the fens of the Isle of Ely.

basis_claims.quote: The Tiddy Mun was described, by folklorist M.C. Balfour in 1891, as being no bigger than a three-year-old child, but looking like an old man with long, tangled white hair and a matted white beard.

statement.id: Balfour pada 1891 menggambarkan Tiddy Mun tidak lebih besar daripada anak tiga tahun tetapi berpenampilan seperti lelaki tua berambut putih panjang kusut dan berjanggut putih kusut.
statement.en: Balfour in 1891 described Tiddy Mun as no bigger than a three-year-old child but looking like an old man with long, tangled white hair and a matted white beard.

basis_claims.quote: He is said to have worn a grey gown so that at dusk he was difficult to see. His laughter was said to resemble the call of the peewit.

statement.id: Ia dikatakan mengenakan jubah abu-abu sehingga sulit terlihat saat senja, dan tawanya konon menyerupai panggilan burung peewit.
statement.en: He is said to have worn a grey gown so that at dusk he was difficult to see, and his laughter was said to resemble the call of the peewit.

basis_claims.quote: Tiddy Mun dwelt i' tha watter-holes, an' noo tha Dutchies wor a emptyin' 'em out
basis_claims.locator: Legends of the Cars, Tiddy Mun

statement.id: Dalam teks dialek Balfour, Tiddy Mun tinggal di lubang-lubang air (watter-holes), dan orang Belanda (Dutchies) sedang mengosongkannya.
statement.en: In Balfour's dialect text Tiddy Mun dwelt in the water-holes (watter-holes), and the Dutch (Dutchies) were emptying them out.

basis_claims.quote: for a wor none bigger 'n a three year's bairn, but a hadn't rightly no sort of a name
basis_claims.locator: Legends of the Cars, Tiddy Mun

statement.id: Ia disebut Tiddy Mun karena tidak lebih besar daripada anak berumur tiga tahun (three year's bairn), tetapi sebenarnya tidak punya nama.
statement.en: He was called Tiddy Mun because he was none bigger than a three-year-old child (three year's bairn), but had no real name.

basis_claims.quote: a've seen un mysel, limpin' by i' tha fog, all grey an' white an' screechin' like tha pyewipe
basis_claims.locator: Legends of the Cars, Tiddy Mun

statement.id: Si penutur lama mengaku pernah melihatnya berjalan pincang di kabut, abu-abu dan putih, menjerit seperti burung pyewipe (peewit).
statement.en: The old teller claims to have seen him limping by in the fog, all grey and white and screeching like the pyewipe (peewit).

basis_claims.quote: is a warlock or male witch, the female equivalent (witch) being vedma. This role greatly focuses on the Shamanic aspects of Slavic paganism.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, vedmak adalah dukun atau penyihir laki-laki, padanan perempuannya vedma; peran ini menekankan sisi syamanistik paganisme Slavia: mengobati manusia dan hewan, tetapi juga dianggap terhubung dengan iblis dan mampu mencelakai dengan penyakit, membunuh ternak, atau merusak panen.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology a vedmak is a warlock or male witch, the female equivalent being the vedma; the role stresses the shamanic side of Slavic paganism: treating people and animals, yet thought linked to the devil and able to harm by sickness, killing cattle or spoiling harvests.

basis_claims.quote: персонаж славянской мифологии и демонологии, колдун. Является начальником над ведьмами определённой местности; может действовать заодно с ними или, наоборот, защищать людей от проделок ведьм и заложных покойников, заговорами лечить болезни людей и животных.

statement.id: Vedmak (Ведьмак, Polandia wiedźmak) adalah tokoh mitologi dan demonologi Slavia, seorang penyihir, pemimpin para penyihir di suatu daerah, yang bisa bekerja sama dengan mereka atau melindungi orang dari ulah mereka dan dari arwah penasaran, serta menyembuhkan penyakit manusia dan hewan dengan mantra.
statement.en: The vedmak is a figure of Slavic mythology and demonology, a sorcerer heading the witches of a district, who may side with them or protect people from witches and restless dead, healing people and animals with charms.

basis_claims.quote: По поверьям, ведьмак, как и другие колдуны, может быть «прирождённым» или «наученным». У «прирождённого» ведьмака может не быть бороды, усов, зато присутствует маленький хвостик

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan, vedmak seperti penyihir lain bisa "terlahir" atau "terlatih"; vedmak yang terlahir mungkin tak berjanggut dan berkumis, tetapi memiliki ekor kecil.
statement.en: By belief a vedmak, like other sorcerers, may be "born" or "taught"; a born vedmak may lack beard and moustache but have a small tail.

basis_claims.quote: They abide in shadows and darkness, especially places that never see sunlight, such as inside water wells, old ruins, and caves. They have a frightening visage and are extremely violent.

statement.id: Mereka berdiam di bayang-bayang dan kegelapan, terutama tempat yang tak pernah terkena sinar matahari seperti dalam sumur, reruntuhan tua, dan gua; rupa mereka menakutkan dan mereka sangat ganas.

basis_claims.quote: A lugat can fly and ride the winds, and assails his victims in their sleep. He also lures people, especially children, to himself while he is concealed in darkness.

statement.id: Lugat bisa terbang dan menunggang angin, menyerang korbannya saat tidur, dan memikat orang, terutama anak-anak, sambil bersembunyi dalam gelap.
statement.en: A lugat can fly and ride the winds, attacks its victims in their sleep, and lures people, especially children, while hidden in darkness.

basis_claims.quote: As undead they can't be killed during night but if they are caught in their graves, they can be burnt to death. Lugats are often believed to wear the skin of a dead person and have long fingernails.

statement.id: Sebagai mayat hidup mereka tak bisa dibunuh pada malam hari, tetapi bila tertangkap di makamnya mereka bisa dibakar sampai mati; lugat sering dipercaya mengenakan kulit orang mati dan berkuku panjang.
statement.en: As undead they cannot be killed at night, but if caught in their graves they can be burnt to death; lugats are often believed to wear a dead person's skin and to have long fingernails.

basis_claims.quote: Mullo (Muli: female, Mulo: male) is an undead, revenant, or vampire of Roma folklore. 'Mullo' means 'one who is dead'.

statement.id: Mullo (Muli untuk perempuan, Mulo untuk laki-laki) adalah mayat hidup, revenant, atau vampir dalam cerita rakyat Roma; namanya berarti "orang yang sudah mati".
statement.en: The mullo (Muli for a female, Mulo for a male) is an undead, revenant or vampire of Roma folklore; the name means 'one who is dead'.

basis_claims.quote: A mullo is created when a person dies suddenly of some unnatural cause or the person did not have proper funeral rites.

statement.id: Mullo tercipta bila seseorang mati mendadak karena sebab tidak wajar atau tidak mendapat upacara pemakaman yang layak.
statement.en: A mullo arises when someone dies suddenly of an unnatural cause or does not receive proper funeral rites.

basis_claims.quote: A mullo is described as having white clothes, hair that reaches to their feet, and one physical oddity (a trait which varies from geographic region to region). A mullo's existence is in seeking out people it did not like in life and harassing that person.

statement.id: Mullo digambarkan berpakaian putih, berambut sampai ke kaki, dan memiliki satu keanehan fisik yang berbeda menurut daerah; ia mencari dan mengganggu orang yang tidak disukainya semasa hidup.
statement.en: A mullo is described with white clothes, hair to its feet and one physical oddity that varies by region; it seeks out and harasses people it disliked in life.

basis_claims.quote: Mullo are believed to return and do malicious things and/or attack by strangling and suck the blood of a person (usually a relative who had caused their death, or hadn't properly observed the burial ceremonies, or who kept the deceased's possessions instead of destroying them as was proper).

statement.id: Mullo dipercaya kembali untuk berbuat jahat atau menyerang dengan mencekik dan mengisap darah, biasanya kerabat yang menyebabkan kematiannya, tidak menjalankan upacara pemakaman dengan benar, atau menyimpan barang milik almarhum yang semestinya dimusnahkan.
statement.en: Mullos are believed to return to do harm or attack by strangling and sucking blood, usually from a relative who caused their death, neglected the burial rites, or kept the dead person's belongings instead of destroying them.

basis_claims.quote: Верује се да може бити невидљив, изгледати потпуно нормално, недостајати му прсти или имати животињске делове тела. У Индији се описује са жутом или пламеном косом, док у Шведској поседује способност промене облика.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Serbia menyebut mullo dipercaya bisa tak terlihat, tampak normal, tak berjari, atau berbagian tubuh hewan; di India ia digambarkan berambut kuning atau menyala, di Swedia ia dapat berubah wujud.
statement.en: The Serbian article says the mullo is believed able to be invisible, look wholly normal, lack fingers or have animal body parts; in India it is described with yellow or flaming hair, and in Sweden it can change shape.

basis_claims.quote: is a Slavic fairy similar to a nymph.

basis_claims.quote: According to Natalie Kononenko, the vilas are female spirits of nature who have an ambivalent relationship with humans.

statement.en: According to Natalie Kononenko, vilas are female nature spirits with an ambivalent relationship with humans.

basis_claims.quote: There are three kinds, those living on land and in forests ... water nymphs ... and cloud or air nymphs

statement.id: Ada tiga jenis vila: yang hidup di darat dan hutan, nimfa air, serta nimfa awan atau udara.
statement.en: There are three kinds of vile: those living on land and in forests, water nymphs, and cloud or air nymphs.

basis_claims.quote: They possess supernatural powers and are able in the art of healing. They build splendid castles at the edges of clouds.

statement.id: Vila memiliki kekuatan gaib dan pandai menyembuhkan; mereka membangun istana megah di tepi awan.
statement.en: Vilas have supernatural powers and are skilled in healing; they build splendid castles at the edges of clouds.

basis_claims.quote: In den Volkserzählungen sind Wilen schöne Mädchen mit durchsichtigem Körper und langen Haaren. Verlieren sie auch nur ein einziges Haar, bedeutet dies ihren Tod.

statement.id: Dalam kisah rakyat, vila adalah gadis cantik bertubuh tembus pandang dan berambut panjang; kehilangan sehelai rambut saja berarti kematian baginya.
statement.en: In folk tales vile are beautiful girls with translucent bodies and long hair; losing even one hair means their death.

basis_claims.quote: Den Menschen gegenüber sind sie meist wohlgesinnt, auch Hochzeiten zwischen einer Wila und einem Menschen kommen in den Erzählungen vor.

statement.id: Vila umumnya bersikap baik kepada manusia, dan pernikahan antara vila dan manusia juga muncul dalam kisah-kisah.
statement.en: Vile are mostly well-disposed towards humans, and marriages between a vila and a human also occur in the tales.

basis_claims.quote: is one of the most famous vampires in Balkan and Serbian folklore.

statement.id: Sava Savanović (Сава Савановић) adalah salah satu vampir paling terkenal dalam cerita rakyat Balkan dan Serbia.
statement.en: Sava Savanović is one of the most famous vampires in Balkan and Serbian folklore.

basis_claims.quote: Sava Savanović was said to have lived in an old watermill on the Rogačica river, at Zarožje village in the municipality of Bajina Bašta. It was said that he killed and drank the blood of the millers when they came to mill their grains.

statement.id: Sava Savanović konon tinggal di kincir air tua di Sungai Rogačica, desa Zarožje, wilayah Bajina Bašta, dan membunuh serta meminum darah para penggiling yang datang menggiling biji-bijian.
statement.en: Sava Savanović was said to have lived in an old watermill on the Rogačica river at Zarožje village, Bajina Bašta, killing and drinking the blood of millers who came to mill grain.

basis_claims.quote: Sie wurden ausschließlich mündlich überliefert und unterscheiden sich bezüglich Ort und den beteiligten Akteuren, haben aber alle eine gemeinsame Kerngeschichte: in allen Geschichten geht es um einen Mann aus dem Dorf Zarožje

statement.id: Kisah-kisahnya hanya diwariskan secara lisan dan berbeda soal tempat dan pelaku, tetapi semuanya punya inti yang sama: seorang laki-laki dari desa Zarožje.
statement.en: The stories were passed down only orally and differ in place and actors, but all share a core: a man from the village of Zarožje.

basis_claims.quote: Allen Versionen ist gleich, dass das Grab von Sava Savanović geöffnet wurde und man darin einen unverwesten Leichnam vorfand. Um den Fluch zu brechen, wurde dem Vampir ein spitzer Pfahl durch das Herz geschlagen.

statement.id: Dalam semua versi, kubur Sava Savanović dibuka dan di dalamnya ditemukan jasad yang tidak membusuk; untuk mematahkan kutukan, sebuah pancang runcing ditancapkan ke jantung vampir itu.
statement.en: In all versions Sava Savanović's grave was opened and an undecayed corpse found; to break the curse a sharpened stake was driven through the vampire's heart.
